zh.tag: 真实工程师的 AI 技能包，小而可组合
zh.what: 这是一个面向真实工程实践的 AI 代理技能集合，来自作者日常使用的 .agents 目录。它强调可组合、易修改，而非大而全的流程框架，旨在帮助开发者用 AI 完成实际编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能文件，每个技能针对特定工程任务（如代码审查、调试等），并附带安装脚本和说明文档。支持通过 Claude Code 插件或 npx 安装，可选择性安装到不同代理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本，依赖 Claude Code 插件系统或 npx 工具，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Codex）。
zh.hot: 24.7k stars 且日增 1601，位居日榜第二，因其提供了一种轻量、可控的 AI 工程实践方式，区别于流行的重流程框架，受到开发者欢迎。
uses: 希望用 AI 辅助实际编码但不想被复杂流程束缚的开发者
需要可定制、可组合技能来适配不同项目的工程师
对 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理工具感兴趣，想扩展其能力的用户

en.tag: AI skills for real engineers, small and composable
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills for real engineering work, sourced from the author's daily .agents directory. It emphasizes composability and adaptability over monolithic frameworks, helping developers use AI for practical coding tasks.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill files, each targeting a specific engineering task (e.g., code review, debugging), along with installation scripts and documentation. It can be installed via Claude Code plugin or npx, with selective installation to different agents.
en.stack: Primarily Shell scripts, leveraging Claude Code plugin system or npx tool, compatible with various AI agents (e.g., Codex).
en.hot: With 247k stars and +1601 today, ranking #2 on daily trending, it's popular for offering a lightweight, controllable approach to AI engineering, contrasting with heavy process frameworks.
uses: Developers who want AI assistance for real coding without being constrained by heavy workflows
Engineers needing customizable, composable skills to fit different projects
Users interested in extending the capabilities of agent tools like Claude Code or Codex

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，快速安全的 printf/iostream 替代品
zh.what: {fmt} 是一个开源格式化库，提供快速且安全的 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 替代方案。它实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print，并支持类似 Python 的格式字符串语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、示例和测试，核心文件包括 base.h、format.h 等，支持用户自定义类型和可移植的 Unicode。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖少，支持 C++11 及以上标准，使用 Dragonbox 算法进行快速浮点格式化。
zh.hot: 今日新增 963 星，总星数达 25081，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。作为 C++ 标准库格式化功能的基础，其高性能和安全性备受开发者青睐。
uses: C++ 开发者需要比 printf 或 iostream 更安全、更快速的格式化输出时使用
库作者希望实现或扩展 C++20/23 格式化功能，或为自定义类型提供格式化支持
需要高精度浮点格式化且要求正确舍入和往返保证的数值计算场景

en.tag: A modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. It implements C++20's std::format and C++23's std::print, with a format string syntax similar to Python's.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, examples, and tests, with core files like base.h and format.h, supporting user-defined types and portable Unicode.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with minimal dependencies, supports C++11 and later, uses the Dragonbox algorithm for fast floating-point formatting.
en.hot: With 963 stars added today and 25,081 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. As the foundation for C++ standard formatting, its high performance and safety are widely appreciated.
uses: For C++ developers needing safer and faster formatting than printf or iostreams
For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types
For numerical computing scenarios requiring high-precision floating-point formatting with correct rounding and round-trip guarantees

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: Claude Agent Skills 官方示例与规范库
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方仓库，包含 Claude 的 Agent Skills 实现示例，涵盖创意、技术、企业工作流等。每个技能以文件夹形式提供 SKILL.md 指令和资源，帮助 Claude 在特定任务上表现更好。
zh.content: 仓库包含 skills 示例目录、Agent Skills 规范（spec）、技能模板（template），以及驱动 Claude 文档功能的 docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx 技能源码。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，技能以 Markdown 指令和脚本形式组织，遵循 agentskills.io 规范。
zh.hot: 17.3 万星，今日新增 281，位列日榜第 5。作为 Anthropic 官方仓库，它展示了 Agent Skills 标准，是开发者学习构建可复用 AI 技能的首选参考。
uses: 开发者学习如何为 Claude 创建自定义技能，提升自动化效率。
企业团队参考企业级技能示例，如品牌文档生成和通信工作流。
AI 爱好者探索创意技能，如艺术、音乐和设计应用。
技术团队利用文档技能源码，集成到生产级 AI 应用中。

en.tag: Official Agent Skills examples and spec for Claude
en.what: This is Anthropic's official repository containing example implementations of Agent Skills for Claude, covering creative, technical, and enterprise workflows. Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file and resources that enable Claude to perform specialized tasks more effectively.
en.content: The repo includes example skills, the Agent Skills specification, a skill template, and the source for document skills (docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx) that power Claude's document capabilities.
en.stack: Primarily Python, skills are organized as Markdown instructions and scripts following the agentskills.io spec.
en.hot: 173k stars, +281 today, #5 on daily trending. As Anthropic's official repo, it demonstrates the Agent Skills standard and serves as the go-to reference for developers building reusable AI skills.
uses: Developers learning to create custom skills for Claude to boost automation.
Enterprise teams referencing business skills like branded document creation and communication workflows.
AI enthusiasts exploring creative skills for art, music, and design.
Technical teams leveraging document skill source code for production AI integrations.

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，可通过 skills CLI 或手动安装到任何支持技能指令的代理框架中。支持全局或项目级安装，并可作为 Claude Code 插件使用。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 技能文件，无外部依赖，可在任何支持技能指令的代理框架中运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1504 星，总星数 31573，排名 Python 周榜第 16。因其解决了 AI 写作“一眼假”的痛点，且安装使用极其简单，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 将 AI 草稿润色为自然的人类风格，避免被检测
开发者 —— 集成到代理工作流中，自动优化 AI 生成的文本输出
学术写作者 —— 确保论文或报告中的 AI 辅助内容更符合人类写作习惯

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.
en.content: The repo contains a single SKILL.md file that can be installed via skills CLI or manually into any agent harness supporting skill-style instructions. Supports global or project-local install and can be used as a Claude Code plugin.
en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 自我进化的 AI 代理，跨平台、跨会话持续学习
zh.what: Hermes Agent 是一款由 Nous Research 构建的自我进化 AI 代理，内置学习循环，能从经验中创建技能、在应用中改进技能，并持续构建用户模型。它支持在多种平台（Telegram、Discord、Slack 等）和多种模型提供商之间无缝运行，且不锁定特定环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的代理代码库、终端 TUI 界面、跨平台网关、技能创建与改进机制、记忆管理、定时自动化（cron）、以及多语言 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖包括 FTS5 搜索、LLM 集成（支持 Nous Portal、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等）、以及 Honcho 用户建模库。
zh.hot: 凭借 24 万+ 星标和日增 774 星，其独特的自我改进学习循环和跨平台、跨会话的持久记忆能力引发了广泛关注，成为 AI 代理领域的热门项目。
uses: 开发者和 AI 爱好者希望部署一个能自主学习和适应用户行为的个人 AI 代理。
需要跨平台（如 Telegram、Discord）与 AI 交互并保持对话连续性的团队或个人。
研究者探索代理记忆、技能自动化和用户建模等前沿方向。

en.tag: Self-improving AI agent that learns from experience across sessions and platforms
en.what: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research, featuring a built-in learning loop that creates skills from experience, improves them during use, and builds a deepening model of the user. It runs seamlessly across platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc.) and model providers without lock-in.
en.content: The repository contains the full agent codebase, a terminal TUI, cross-platform gateway, skill creation and improvement mechanisms, memory management, scheduled automations (cron), and multilingual READMEs and docs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with dependencies on FTS5 search, LLM integrations (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.), and the Honcho user modeling library.
en.hot: With over 240K stars and 774 stars added today, its unique self-improving learning loop and persistent cross-session memory have captured attention, making it a trending project in the AI agent space.
uses: Developers and AI enthusiasts seeking a personal AI agent that autonomously learns and adapts to user behavior.
Teams or individuals needing cross-platform AI interaction (e.g., Telegram, Discord) with conversation continuity.
Researchers exploring cutting-edge topics like agent memory, skill automation, and user modeling.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程代理用原始人语言省 65% token 的 Claude Code 技能
zh.what: Caveman 是一个针对 Claude Code 等 AI 编程代理的技能（skill），通过将代理的回复转换为简洁的原始人风格语言，大幅减少 token 消耗。它保留了代码、命令和错误信息等关键内容，仅精简冗余的叙述性文字，从而在保持诊断准确性的同时降低成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能文件（SKILL.md）、安装脚本、代理包装配置（支持 30+ 代理，原生包装 10 种）、文档和示例，以及一个可选的代理模式用于进一步压缩 token。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Go，用于实现代理包装和代理功能；技能本身是纯提示词工程，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等 30 多种 AI 代理。
zh.hot: 在 token 计费时代，直接节省 65% 成本极具吸引力，上线即获 10 万+ star，日增 543，登上 GitHub 热榜第 7 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code 等按 token 计费的 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望降低 API 成本
需要处理大量代码生成任务、追求效率的团队，可减少 token 消耗而不牺牲输出质量
对 AI 提示工程感兴趣，想了解如何通过语言风格优化来压缩 token 的爱好者

en.tag: Claude Code skill that cuts 65% tokens by making AI talk like a caveman
en.what: Caveman is a skill for AI coding agents like Claude Code that converts agent responses into terse caveman-style language, significantly reducing token usage. It preserves code, commands, and error messages while trimming verbose explanations, cutting costs without losing diagnostic accuracy.
en.content: The repo includes skill files (SKILL.md), install scripts, proxy wrap profiles for 30+ agents (10 native), docs, examples, and an optional proxy mode for further token reduction.
en.stack: Primarily Go for the proxy and wrapper; the skill itself is pure prompt engineering, compatible with 30+ agents like Claude Code and Codex.
en.hot: In the token-billing era, saving 65% costs is compelling; it gained 100k+ stars quickly, +543 today, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers using token-billed AI coding agents like Claude Code who want to reduce API costs
Teams handling large code generation tasks seeking efficiency, cutting token usage without sacrificing output quality
Enthusiasts interested in prompt engineering and how language style optimization compresses tokens

zh.tag: 本地模型推理服务器，让 AI 代理离线运行
zh.what: Magnitude 是一个开源推理服务器，能自动检测你的硬件配置，推荐并运行最适合的本地模型，并接入你正在使用的 AI 代理（如 Pi、OpenCode、Claude Code 等）。它让代理完全离线、私密且免费地运行，无需 API 密钥或令牌费用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具（@magnitudedev/cli）、推理服务器核心、模型管理功能（下载、调优、运行），以及支持多种代理的集成层。提供交互式设置向导和文档，帮助用户快速配置本地模型。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，通过 npm 分发 CLI。支持 macOS、Linux（Windows 通过 WSL），依赖本地硬件资源进行模型推理，兼容多种代理框架。
zh.hot: 今日新增 161 星，总星数达 1950，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了 AI 代理依赖云端 API 的痛点，提供免费、私密、离线的本地推理方案，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者希望让 Claude Code、Codex 等代理完全本地运行，保护代码隐私并节省 API 成本。
硬件配置不高的用户，需要自动推荐并优化适合自己设备的本地模型。
追求离线工作的场景，如无网络环境或对数据安全要求高的团队。

en.tag: Open-source inference server to run local models with your existing AI agents
en.what: Magnitude is an open-source inference server that profiles your hardware, recommends and runs the best local models, and plugs into the AI agents you already use (e.g., Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code). It enables fully offline, private, and free agent operation without API keys or token costs.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool (@magnitudedev/cli), the inference server core, model management (download, tune, run), and integrations for multiple agents. It offers an interactive setup wizard and documentation for quick configuration.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, distributed via npm. Supports macOS and Linux (Windows via WSL), leverages local hardware for inference, and integrates with various agent frameworks.
en.hot: Gained 161 stars today, reaching 1,950 total, and hit #14 on GitHub Trending. It addresses the pain point of cloud-dependent AI agents by offering free, private, offline local inference, attracting many developers.
uses: Developers who want agents like Claude Code or Codex to run fully locally, protecting code privacy and saving API costs.
Users with modest hardware who need automatic recommendations and tuning of local models for their devices.
Offline-first scenarios, such as no-network environments or teams with strict data security requirements.

zh.tag: 公开漏洞 PoC 与漏洞研究合集，吸引新人入行
zh.what: 这是一个公开的漏洞利用概念验证（PoC）和漏洞研究文章的合集仓库。作者发布这些内容时均未被报告，鼓励他人自行报告并获取 CVE 编号。其目的是吸引更多人进入安全领域，并认为这是最有效的方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个独立文件夹，每个文件夹对应一个漏洞的 PoC，例如 7-Zip、AnyDesk、c-ares、curl、Discord、Discourse、Docker、Firefox、Flowise、FFmpeg 等。每个文件夹保留原始 README 和跟踪文件，新研究直接作为自包含文件夹添加。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，但 PoC 可能涉及多种语言。作者使用 AI（GPT-5.3）辅助模糊测试工作流，但 PoC 本身为手写，README 由 AI 生成。
zh.hot: 该仓库因公开了多个未披露漏洞的 PoC 而迅速走红，今日新增 74 星，总星数达 4509，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 10 名。其争议性（AI 辅助发现漏洞）和实用性吸引了大量关注。
uses: 安全研究人员：可参考这些 PoC 学习漏洞利用技术，或用于漏洞报告和 CVE 申请。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中，可借鉴这些 PoC 验证目标系统的安全性。
安全学习者：通过实际漏洞案例了解漏洞成因和利用方法，快速入门漏洞研究。

en.tag: A consolidated archive of public exploit PoCs and vuln research writeups to lure newcomers into security.
en.what: This is a consolidated archive of public exploit PoCs and vulnerability research writeups. At the time of posting, none have been reported, so the author encourages others to report them and take credit for CVEs. The goal is to allure people into the security field, which the author finds the most efficient way.
en.content: The repo contains multiple folders, each corresponding to a PoC for a specific vulnerability, such as 7-Zip, AnyDesk, c-ares, curl, Discord, Discourse, Docker, Firefox, Flowise, FFmpeg, etc. Each folder preserves the original README and tracked files, and new research is added as self-contained folders.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but PoCs may involve various languages. The author used AI (GPT-5.3) to automate fuzzing workflows, but PoCs are hand-typed, and READMEs are AI-generated.
en.hot: The repo went viral for publishing PoCs for multiple undisclosed vulnerabilities, gaining 74 stars today and reaching 4509 total, ranking 10th on GitHub Trending daily. Its controversial use of AI in fuzzing and practical value drew significant attention.
uses: Security researchers: Reference these PoCs to learn exploitation techniques or for vulnerability disclosure and CVE assignment.
Penetration testers: Use these PoCs to validate the security of target systems in authorized engagements.
Security learners: Understand vulnerability root causes and exploitation methods through real-world cases to quickly enter the field.

zh.tag: 翻墙工具与教程大全，覆盖多平台多协议
zh.what: 这是一个收集翻墙（科学上网）工具、教程和资源的项目库，包含安卓、iOS、Windows、Mac、Linux等平台的软件与配置指南，以及自建服务器教程和免费账号信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个子目录和wiki页面，如fqnews2（新闻APP）、android、ios、windows、ChromeGoMac、EdgeGo等，提供一键翻墙包、教程文档和免费账号列表。
zh.stack: 主要语言为Kotlin，涉及安卓APP开发；同时包含多种浏览器扩展和脚本，以及V2ray、Shadowsocks等代理协议的使用教程。
zh.hot: 拥有超过5.2万星标，今日新增522星，位列日榜第11，因其提供实用的翻墙解决方案而持续受到关注。
uses: 需要访问被屏蔽网站的用户，可获取一键翻墙包和教程。
开发者或运维人员可参考自建V2ray/SS服务器教程。
寻找免费代理账号的用户可查看免费ss/v2ray账号列表。
关注翻墙新闻的用户可下载FQNews安卓APP。

en.tag: Comprehensive circumvention tools and tutorials for multiple platforms and protocols
en.what: This is a repository collecting circumvention tools, tutorials, and resources, including software and configuration guides for Android, iOS, Windows, Mac, Linux, as well as self-hosted server tutorials and free account information.
en.content: The repository contains multiple subdirectories and wiki pages, such as fqnews2 (news app), android, ios, windows, ChromeGoMac, EdgeGo, offering one-click circumvention packages, tutorial documents, and free account lists.
en.stack: Primary language is Kotlin for Android app development; also includes browser extensions and scripts, as well as tutorials for proxy protocols like V2ray and Shadowsocks.
en.hot: With over 52k stars and 522 added today, ranking 11th on the daily trending, it remains popular for offering practical circumvention solutions.
uses: Users needing to access blocked websites can get one-click circumvention packages and tutorials.
Developers or admins can follow self-hosted V2ray/SS server tutorials.
Users seeking free proxy accounts can check the free ss/v2ray account lists.
Those interested in circumvention news can download the FQNews Android app.

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频配音或制作多语言音频，但不想依赖云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.
en.content: The repository includes full application code, docs, installation guides, architecture, and API docs, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, offering both GUI and CLI tools.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging various open-source TTS/ASR engines (e.g., Coqui, Whisper), with cross-platform desktop support and Docker deployment.
en.hot: As a local-first ElevenLabs alternative, VoiceStudio is gaining rapid traction among privacy- and cost-conscious users, adding 1,672 stars in a day to reach 16,279 total, reflecting high demand for self-hosted voice tools.
uses: Content creators needing video dubbing or multilingual audio without cloud dependency.
Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 企业级 LLM/VLM 后训练强化学习框架
zh.what: Miles 是一个面向企业的大规模模型后训练强化学习框架，支持 LLM 和 VLM，与 SGLang 和 Megatron-LM 深度集成，提供高性能的 rollout 和训练能力。它从 slime 分叉而来，并与 slime 共同演进。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架源码、文档、快速入门指南、模型支持列表，以及多个博客文章链接，涵盖 v0.1 发布、Blackwell 原生 8-bit/4-bit RL、Kimi K3 支持等。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 SGLang 进行 rollout，Megatron-LM 进行训练，支持多种硬件（如 AMD Instinct MI355X）和模型（如 DeepSeek-V4、Kimi K3）。
zh.hot: 作为企业级 RL 框架，Miles 在 GitHub Trending 日榜排名第 14，今日新增 64 星，总星数达 2551，反映了社区对生产级后训练工具的高度关注。
uses: 企业 AI 团队需要大规模模型后训练，追求生产级稳定性和性能。
研究人员探索 LLM/VLM 的强化学习算法，需要与 SGLang 和 Megatron 无缝集成的框架。
开发者希望快速上手 RL 训练，利用 Miles 的文档和模型支持列表进行部署。

en.tag: Enterprise-grade RL framework for LLM/VLM post-training
en.what: Miles is an enterprise-facing reinforcement learning framework for large-scale model post-training, supporting LLMs and VLMs. It integrates tightly with SGLang for high-throughput rollout and Megatron-LM for training, forked from and co-evolving with slime.
en.content: The repo includes full framework source code, documentation, quick start guides, supported model lists, and links to blog posts covering v0.1 release, Blackwell-native 8-bit/4-bit RL, Kimi K3 support, and more.
en.stack: Built on Python, leverages SGLang for rollout and Megatron-LM for training, supports various hardware (e.g., AMD Instinct MI355X) and models (e.g., DeepSeek-V4, Kimi K3).
en.hot: As an enterprise-grade RL framework, Miles ranks #14 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining 64 stars today to reach 2551 total, reflecting strong community interest in production-grade post-training tools.
uses: Enterprise AI teams needing production-grade stability and performance for large-scale model post-training.
Researchers exploring RL algorithms for LLMs/VLMs, requiring seamless integration with SGLang and Megatron.
Developers seeking quick start with RL training, leveraging Miles' docs and supported model lists for deployment.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 编程代理，终端与桌面双形态
zh.what: OpenCode 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，能在终端中自主完成编码任务，支持多模型接入。它提供类似 Claude Code 的交互体验，并具备桌面应用（测试版）。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心代理引擎、终端 UI（packages/web）、桌面应用（packages/console）以及安装脚本，支持多种包管理器安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 生态，通过 npm/bun/pnpm 分发，并支持多平台安装（brew、scoop、pacman 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 20.4 万星标和日增 345 星，OpenCode 成为开源 AI 编程代理的领跑者，其终端原生体验和桌面应用吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接使用 AI 代理进行编码，无需切换 IDE。
团队需要可私有化部署的 AI 编程助手，支持多种模型供应商。
喜欢尝试最新 AI 编程工具的技术爱好者，关注开源社区活跃项目。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent with terminal & desktop apps
en.what: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that autonomously completes coding tasks in the terminal, supporting multiple models. It offers a Claude Code-like interactive experience and a desktop app (beta).
en.content: The repo includes the core agent engine, terminal UI (packages/web), desktop app (packages/console), and install scripts supporting various package managers.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Node.js ecosystem, distributed via npm/bun/pnpm, with multi-platform installers (brew, scoop, pacman, etc.).
en.hot: With 204k stars and +345 daily, OpenCode leads open-source AI coding agents, attracting developers with its terminal-native experience and desktop app.
uses: Developers who want an AI agent directly in the terminal without switching IDEs.
Teams needing a self-hostable AI coding assistant with multiple model providers.
Tech enthusiasts tracking active open-source AI coding tools.

zh.tag: DirectX 游戏着色器与资源修改工具集
zh.what: RenoDX 是一个用于修改 DirectX 游戏的工具集，可以替换着色器、注入缓冲区、添加覆盖层、升级交换链和纹理资源，并将用户设置写入磁盘。它基于 Reshade 的插件系统，兼容性广泛，无需修补特定版本的 exe 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、多个实用工具（如 FPS 限制器、开发者工具包）以及一个 Shader Model 6.0+ 反编译器（decomp.exe）。还提供文档和贡献指南，以及一个用于构建插件的开发工具包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 HLSL 编写着色器相关代码，构建系统支持 Clang、Ninja 和 Visual Studio，并依赖 Reshade 的插件系统。
zh.hot: 今日新增 261 星，总星数 3527，因其为 DirectX 游戏模组提供了强大且易用的工具，且兼容性广，吸引了游戏模组社区关注。
uses: 游戏模组制作者：希望替换着色器或增强游戏画质的开发者。
逆向工程师：需要反编译 Shader Model 6.0+ 着色器以分析或修改。
游戏玩家：想使用现成模组或工具（如 FPS 限制器）优化游戏体验。

en.tag: Toolset for modding DirectX games via shader replacement and resource upgrades
en.what: RenoDX is a toolset for modding DirectX games, enabling shader replacement, buffer injection, overlay addition, swapchain and texture resource upgrades, and user settings persistence. It leverages Reshade's add-on system for broad compatibility, avoiding version-specific executable patching.
en.content: The repository includes the core library, utility tools (FPS limiter, devkit), and a Shader Model 6.0+ decompiler (decomp.exe). It also provides documentation, contribution guidelines, and a devkit for building addons.
en.stack: Primarily HLSL for shader-related code, with build support for Clang, Ninja, and Visual Studio, and relies on Reshade's add-on system.
en.hot: Gained 261 stars today, reaching 3527 total, as it offers a powerful and accessible toolset for DirectX game modding with broad compatibility, attracting the game modding community.
uses: Game modders: developers looking to replace shaders or enhance game visuals.
Reverse engineers: those needing to decompile Shader Model 6.0+ shaders for analysis or modification.
Gamers: players who want to use ready-made mods or tools like FPS limiter to optimize gameplay.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手提供 38 种编辑级图表模板
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi）设计的技能包，提供 38 种编辑级质量的图表类型。它生成自包含的 HTML+SVG 文件，无需构建步骤或外部依赖，并强调无阴影、无 Mermaid 风格的设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 38 种图表类型的定义，每种都有浅色、深色和全编辑三种静态变体，以及文档和截图。还包含语义模式系统，可将行为与布局分离，并支持从 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源重绘图表。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript 或外部图像依赖。设计为与 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 AI 代理兼容，并支持 Agent Skills 标准。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得超过 30.9k 星标，今日新增 437 星。它解决了 AI 生成图表质量差的痛点，提供了设计师认可的高质量模板，并持续更新新图表类型。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成架构图、流程图等，避免手动调整样式
内容创作者需要快速制作编辑级图表，用于博客、文档或演示
团队希望统一图表风格，通过读取网站自动匹配品牌视觉

en.tag: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi
en.what: A skill pack for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, offering 38 editorial-quality diagram types. It generates self-contained HTML+SVG files with no build step or external dependencies, emphasizing a clean design without shadows or Mermaid-style output.
en.content: The repo contains definitions for 38 diagram types, each with minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial static variants, plus docs and screenshots. It also includes a semantic pattern system that separates behavior from layout, and can redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, with no JavaScript or external image dependencies. Designed to work with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and compatible with Agent Skills.
en.hot: The repo has gone viral on GitHub with over 30.9k stars and 437 stars today. It addresses the pain point of low-quality AI-generated diagrams by offering designer-approved templates, and it continuously adds new diagram types.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Codex to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, etc., without manual styling
Content creators needing quick editorial-quality diagrams for blogs, docs, or presentations
Teams wanting consistent diagram styling, with automatic brand matching by reading a website

zh.tag: 面向 AI 编码代理的规范驱动开发工具包
zh.what: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，帮助团队在使用任何 AI 编码代理时，先定义要构建的内容（规范），再开始构建。它提供了一套即用的规范驱动流程，也可自定义，支持扩展和预设，旨在提升软件质量与协作效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具（specify）、文档、扩展与预设机制、角色化捆绑包，以及社区贡献的集成示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 AI 编码代理（如 GitHub Copilot）和规范文件格式，支持通过扩展集成多种代理。
zh.hot: 由 GitHub 官方发布，star 数高达 13.35 万，今日新增近 200，因其填补了 AI 编码时代规范驱动开发的空白，并达到 1.0 里程碑，引发社区广泛关注。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望提高代码质量与需求对齐度。
技术负责人或架构师，需要为团队建立规范驱动的开发流程。
对 AI 辅助开发流程感兴趣的研究者或爱好者，可探索其扩展机制。

en.tag: Spec-driven development toolkit for any AI coding agent
en.what: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit that helps teams define what to build before building it, enabling spec-driven development with any AI coding agent. It offers a ready-to-use process, is extensible with presets and bundles, and is designed for organization-wide adoption.
en.content: The repository includes the specify CLI, documentation, extension and preset mechanisms, role-based bundles, and community-contributed integration examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it relies on AI coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and spec file formats, with extensions for integrating various agents.
en.hot: Officially from GitHub, it has amassed 133.5k stars with ~200 new stars today, as it fills a gap in spec-driven development for AI coding and recently hit 1.0.0, sparking community buzz.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents who want to improve code quality and requirement alignment.
Tech leads or architects needing to establish a spec-driven process for their teams.
Researchers or enthusiasts interested in AI-assisted development workflows, exploring its extension mechanisms.

zh.tag: 实战型 AI 工程项目合集，覆盖 OCR、RAG 与智能体
zh.what: 这是一个精选的实用 AI 项目集合，包含 OCR 系统、RAG 管道、AI 智能体等。每个项目都提供完整代码、设置说明和文档，旨在帮助开发者通过实践学习并构建真实世界的 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库按类别组织，包括 AI 智能体、OCR、RAG 等，每个子目录是一个独立项目，如多智能体研究助手、金融分析师、每日 AI 新闻摘要等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，项目涉及多种模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google）和开源模型，以及 Ollama、BGE 嵌入等本地推理工具。
zh.hot: 凭借 3139 颗星和每日新增 60 颗的势头，该仓库因提供生产就绪的多样化 AI 项目而受到欢迎，适合希望动手实践的学习者。
uses: AI 开发者想要通过完整项目学习 RAG、OCR 和智能体开发。
数据科学家需要参考生产级代码来快速搭建原型。
技术爱好者希望探索多模型提供商和本地推理的集成。

en.tag: Hands-on AI engineering projects covering OCR, RAG, agents, and more
en.what: A curated collection of practical AI projects implementing OCR systems, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and other use cases. Each project includes complete code, setup instructions, and documentation, designed to help developers learn by doing and build real-world AI applications.
en.content: Organized by categories such as AI agents, OCR, and RAG, each subdirectory is a standalone project, e.g., multi-agent research assistant, financial analyst, daily AI news digest.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with projects leveraging multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and open-source models, as well as local inference tools like Ollama and BGE embeddings.
en.hot: With 3,139 stars and a daily gain of 60, the repo is popular for offering production-ready, diverse AI projects that appeal to hands-on learners.
uses: AI developers seeking to learn RAG, OCR, and agent development through complete projects.
Data scientists needing production-grade code references for rapid prototyping.
Tech enthusiasts exploring integrations with multiple model providers and local inference.

zh.tag: 从零到一构建 AI Native 智能体的系统教程
zh.what: 这是一本由 Datawhale 社区发起的系统性智能体学习教程，旨在帮助学习者从基础理论到实际应用全面掌握智能体系统的设计与实现。教程强调动手实践，引导读者从 LLM 使用者蜕变为智能体构建者。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的教程文档，分为多个章节，涵盖智能体基础、经典范式、上下文工程、记忆、协议、评估、模型训练（SFT 到 GRPO）以及实战项目（如智能旅行助手、赛博小镇）。同时提供在线阅读和本地阅读方式。
zh.stack: 教程基于 Python，涉及 LLM 应用开发，可能使用 OpenAI API、LangChain 等框架，并包含自研框架 HelloAgents 的实践。
zh.hot: 随着 2025 年被称为 Agent 元年，系统且重实践的教程稀缺，该项目填补了空白。Star 数已达 77k，今日新增 209，登上 GitHub Trending Python 榜第 10 名，反映了社区对智能体学习资源的强烈需求。
uses: 对智能体感兴趣、希望从零开始系统学习智能体构建的开发者或研究者。
希望从 LLM 使用者进阶为智能体系统构建者的技术人员。
需要实战案例和面试准备的学习者，如智能旅行助手、赛博小镇项目。

en.tag: A hands-on tutorial for building AI-native agents from scratch
en.what: This is a systematic tutorial on agents initiated by the Datawhale community, aiming to help learners master the design and implementation of agent systems from basic theory to practical application. It emphasizes hands-on practice, guiding readers from LLM users to agent builders.
en.content: The repository contains comprehensive tutorial documents divided into chapters covering agent basics, classic paradigms, context engineering, memory, protocols, evaluation, model training (SFT to GRPO), and practical projects (e.g., AI travel assistant, cyber town). It offers online reading and local reading options.
en.stack: The tutorial is based on Python, involving LLM application development, possibly using frameworks like OpenAI API and LangChain, and includes practice with a self-developed framework HelloAgents.
en.hot: As 2025 is dubbed the 'Year of Agents', systematic and practice-oriented tutorials are scarce, and this project fills the gap. With 77k stars and 209 new stars today, it ranks #10 on GitHub Trending for Python, reflecting strong community demand for agent learning resources.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in agents who want to systematically learn agent building from scratch.
Technical professionals aiming to advance from LLM users to agent system builders.
Learners seeking hands-on projects and interview preparation, such as AI travel assistant and cyber town.

zh.tag: 终端里的 AI 编程代理，自然语言驱动开发
zh.what: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 推出的智能编程工具，运行在终端中，能理解代码库，通过自然语言指令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码和处理 Git 工作流。它支持在终端、IDE 或 GitHub 上使用，帮助开发者显著提升编码效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Claude Code 的安装脚本、文档、演示 GIF 以及多个扩展功能的插件目录。插件提供自定义命令和代理，增强工具的能力。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 18+ 构建，以 npm 包形式分发，但推荐使用官方安装脚本或包管理器。主语言为 Python（用于仓库本身？），但核心工具是 Node.js。
zh.hot: 凭借 Anthropic 的品牌效应和 AI 编程助手的热潮，Claude Code 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，star 数已超 14.4 万，今日新增 157，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 开发者日常编码：在终端中用自然语言快速完成重构、代码解释等任务。
团队协作：通过 GitHub 上的 @claude 标签，在 Issue 或 PR 中自动处理代码相关请求。
学习与探索：利用其解释复杂代码的能力，快速理解陌生项目。

en.tag: Agentic coding tool in your terminal, driven by natural language
en.what: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool by Anthropic that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows through natural language commands. It can be used in the terminal, IDE, or via @claude on GitHub.
en.content: The repository includes installation scripts, documentation, a demo GIF, and a plugins directory that extends functionality with custom commands and agents.
en.stack: Built on Node.js 18+, distributed as an npm package, but recommended installation via official scripts or package managers. The repository's primary language is Python, but the core tool is Node.js-based.
en.hot: Thanks to Anthropic's brand and the AI coding assistant trend, Claude Code has gone viral on GitHub, amassing over 144k stars with 157 new stars today, continuously drawing developer attention.
uses: For developers in daily coding: use natural language in the terminal to quickly refactor, explain code, etc.
For team collaboration: tag @claude on GitHub to handle code-related requests in issues or PRs.
For learning and exploration: leverage its ability to explain complex code to quickly understand unfamiliar projects.

zh.tag: A股自动选股系统，收盘后扫描形态并推送飞书
zh.what: Sequoia-X 是一个面向 A 股市场的量化选股系统，基于 Python 工程化标准重构。它每日收盘后自动运行多种技术形态策略，筛选出符合条件的股票，并通过飞书推送结果。系统支持日常增量更新和全量历史数据回填。
zh.content: 仓库包含主入口 main.py、核心配置与日志模块、数据引擎（基于 baostock 和 SQLite）、多个策略实现（如海龟突破、均线放量等），以及飞书通知模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.10+，依赖 baostock 获取行情数据，SQLite 存储，使用 Pydantic-settings 管理配置，支持 uv 或 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 今日新增 512 星，总星数 6489，登上 GitHub Python 日榜第 8。因其为 A 股散户提供免费、自动化的选股工具，且设计清晰、易部署，受到关注。
uses: A股个人投资者：每日自动获取技术形态选股结果，节省复盘时间。
量化爱好者：可参考其策略实现与数据架构，进行二次开发或学习。
需要自动化推送的团队：可集成飞书机器人，实现定时任务通知。

en.tag: Automated A-share stock screening with pattern scanning and Feishu push after market close
en.what: Sequoia-X is a quantitative stock screening system for the A-share market, rebuilt with modern Python engineering standards. It automatically runs multiple technical pattern strategies after market close, filters stocks meeting criteria, and pushes results via Feishu. It supports daily incremental updates and full historical data backfill.
en.content: The repository includes the main entry point main.py, core config and logging modules, a data engine (based on baostock and SQLite), multiple strategy implementations (e.g., TurtleTrade, MaVolume), and a Feishu notification module.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.10+, uses baostock for market data, SQLite for storage, Pydantic-settings for config, and supports installation via uv or pip.
en.hot: Gained 512 stars today, total 6489, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending for Python. It attracts attention for offering a free, automated stock screening tool for A-share retail investors, with clean design and easy deployment.
uses: A-share retail investors: automatically get technical pattern screening results daily, saving review time.
Quant enthusiasts: can reference its strategy implementations and data architecture for further development or learning.
Teams needing automated notifications: can integrate Feishu bot for scheduled task alerts.

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 谷歌DeepMind下一代全球天气与气旋AI预报模型
zh.what: WeatherNext 2 是谷歌DeepMind与谷歌研究开发的全球中期大气与气旋预报模型，代码库同时包含前代模型 GraphCast 和 GenCast。该模型可提供高分辨率（约30km）的确定性及概率性天气预报，并支持气旋路径预测。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WeatherNext 2 和 WeatherNext Cyclones 的预训练模型代码，以及 GraphCast 和 GenCast 的文档与实现。提供多种数据访问途径（Google Cloud、WeatherLab、OpenMeteo），并附有模型指南、论文和博客链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖深度学习框架（如 JAX 或 TensorFlow）进行模型推理，可能涉及气象数据处理库。
zh.hot: 作为谷歌DeepMind最先进的天气预报模型，WeatherNext 2 在Nature发表论文并投入业务使用，吸引大量关注。尽管今日新增星标不多，但累计7625星表明其持续受到气象与AI社区的高度关注。
uses: 气象研究人员：用于复现和对比最新AI天气预报模型，开展天气与气候研究。
AI开发者：学习图神经网络、扩散模型在科学计算领域的应用，借鉴模型设计。
气象服务提供商：通过API或云平台获取WN2预报数据，提升预报精度。
应急管理部门：利用气旋路径预测辅助防灾减灾决策。

en.tag: Google DeepMind's next-gen AI model for global weather & cyclone forecasting
en.what: WeatherNext 2 is a global medium-range atmospheric and cyclone forecasting model developed by Google DeepMind and Google Research. The repo also hosts code for prior models GraphCast and GenCast. It provides high-resolution (~30km) deterministic and probabilistic forecasts, including cyclone tracks.
en.content: The repo contains pretrained model code for WeatherNext 2 and WeatherNext Cyclones, along with docs and implementations for GraphCast and GenCast. It offers multiple data access routes (Google Cloud, WeatherLab, OpenMeteo) and links to guides, papers, and blogs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX or TensorFlow) for model inference, with possible meteorological data processing libraries.
en.hot: As Google DeepMind's most advanced weather forecasting model, WeatherNext 2 has been published in Nature and used operationally, drawing significant attention. Despite modest daily stars, its 7625 total stars reflect sustained interest from meteorology and AI communities.
uses: Meteorology researchers: to reproduce and compare state-of-the-art AI weather models for weather and climate studies.
AI developers: to learn applications of GNNs and diffusion models in scientific computing and borrow model designs.
Weather service providers: to access WN2 forecast data via APIs or cloud platforms for improved accuracy.
Emergency management agencies: to use cyclone track predictions for disaster preparedness and response.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能安全扫描器，安装前检测漏洞与恶意模式
zh.what: SkillSpector 是一个安全扫描器，用于检测 AI 代理技能中的漏洞、恶意模式和风险。它支持扫描 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 技能，帮助用户判断技能是否安全可安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包、命令行工具、文档和扩展指南，提供多格式输入扫描、两阶段分析（静态+LLM）、实时漏洞查询、多种输出格式和风险评分等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，使用 AST 分析、YARA 签名、OSV.dev API 等，可选集成 LLM 进行语义评估，支持 SARIF 报告输出。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理技能生态爆发，安全问题凸显，SkillSpector 填补了技能安全扫描的空白，由 NVIDIA 背书，star 数迅速增长至 1.6 万。
uses: 开发者在安装第三方 AI 技能前，快速验证其安全性
安全团队集成到 CI/CD 流程，自动扫描技能仓库
AI 代理用户评估 Claude Code、Codex 等技能的可信度

en.tag: Security scanner for AI agent skills, detecting vulnerabilities before install
en.what: SkillSpector is a security scanner that detects vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, and risks in AI agent skills. It supports scanning skills for Claude Code, Codex, and MCP, helping users decide if a skill is safe to install.
en.content: The repository contains a Python package, CLI tool, documentation, and extension guides, offering multi-format input scanning, two-stage analysis (static + LLM), live vulnerability lookups, multiple output formats, and risk scoring.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, uses AST analysis, YARA signatures, OSV.dev API, optional LLM semantic evaluation, and supports SARIF report output.
en.hot: As the AI agent skill ecosystem explodes, security concerns rise; SkillSpector fills the gap for skill scanning, backed by NVIDIA, with stars quickly growing to 16k.
uses: Developers quickly verify safety before installing third-party AI skills
Security teams integrate into CI/CD to automatically scan skill repos
AI agent users assess trustworthiness of skills for Claude Code, Codex, etc.

zh.tag: 长周期AI代理的开放、中立、有状态控制平面
zh.what: LoopX 是一个轻量级状态内核和本地优先的控制平面，用于管理长期运行的 AI 代理。它运行在任何代理框架（如 Codex、Claude Code）之上，提供持久状态、语义决策、治理、恢复和人机协作，使长周期工作可审查、可重启、易交接。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的文档站点、开发者手册（中英双语）、快速入门指南、以及核心的 Python 控制平面实现。还提供了社交预览图、徽章和社区链接（Discord、飞书手册）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+ 构建，采用本地优先架构，与多种代理框架集成（如 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。使用 Apache-2.0 许可证，并依赖 pyproject.toml 管理依赖。
zh.hot: 本月新增 5248 星，总星数达 5394，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 8。其“代理中立”和“状态控制平面”理念切中长周期 AI 代理管理的痛点，受到开发者热捧。
uses: 需要管理复杂、多步骤 AI 代理任务的开发者，确保工作可追踪和可恢复。
使用 Codex、Claude Code 等工具进行自动化编码的团队，希望增加治理和人类监督。
对 AI 代理编排和状态管理感兴趣的研究者或工程师，用于构建自定义控制平面。

en.tag: Open, provider-neutral, stateful control plane for long-horizon agents
en.what: LoopX is a lightweight state kernel and local-first control plane for managing long-running AI agents. It runs on top of any agent harness (e.g., Codex, Claude Code), providing durable state, semantic decisions, governance, recovery, and human-agent collaboration, making long-horizon work reviewable, restartable, and easy to hand off.
en.content: The repository includes a full documentation site, a bilingual developer book, getting-started guides, and the core Python control-plane implementation. It also provides social preview images, badges, and community links (Discord, Feishu manual).
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, local-first architecture, integrating with multiple agent harnesses (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Cursor). Licensed under Apache-2.0, with dependencies managed via pyproject.toml.
en.hot: Gained 5,248 stars this month, reaching 5,394 total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending monthly. Its 'provider-neutral' and 'stateful control plane' concept hits the pain point of long-horizon AI agent management, gaining rapid traction.
uses: Developers managing complex, multi-step AI agent tasks, ensuring work is traceable and recoverable.
Teams using Codex, Claude Code, etc., for automated coding, seeking governance and human oversight.
Researchers or engineers interested in AI agent orchestration and state management, for building custom control planes.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理直接生成 CAD/CAE/CAM 工件的技能库
zh.what: text-to-cad 是一个为 AI 代理设计的技能库，使其能够从本地项目文件生成、检查、获取、切片并交付 CAD 和机器人描述工件。它支持多种格式输出，如 STEP、STL、3MF 等，并集成到代理工作流中。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块，如 CAD、URDF、SDF、SRDF 等，每个技能都有对应的 SKILL.md 文件，并配有演示动图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11+，依赖包括 CAD 相关的库，并支持导出 STEP、STL、3MF 等格式。
zh.hot: 14.3k 星标，日增 93，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为将 AI 代理与工业设计结合，极大简化了 CAD 生成流程。
uses: 工程师和设计师：用自然语言快速生成 CAD 模型，提高设计效率。
机器人开发者：生成 URDF/SDF 等机器人描述文件，加速仿真与部署。
AI 代理开发者：集成这些技能到自定义代理中，扩展其处理 CAD 任务的能力。

en.tag: Agent skills for generating CAD, CAE, CAM and robot artifacts from text
en.what: text-to-cad is a library of agent skills that enables AI agents to generate, inspect, source, slice, and hand off CAD and robot-description artifacts from local project files. It supports multiple output formats like STEP, STL, 3MF, and integrates into agent workflows.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill modules such as CAD, URDF, SDF, SRDF, each with a corresponding SKILL.md file, demo GIFs, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily uses Python 3.11+, with dependencies for CAD operations, supporting export to STEP, STL, 3MF, etc.
en.hot: With 14.3k stars and 93 new stars today, it trended on GitHub due to its novel combination of AI agents with industrial design, simplifying CAD generation.
uses: Engineers and designers: quickly generate CAD models via natural language to boost design efficiency.
Robotics developers: generate URDF/SDF robot descriptions to accelerate simulation and deployment.
AI agent developers: integrate these skills into custom agents to extend their CAD capabilities.

zh.tag: Google 产品与技术的 Agent Skills 集合
zh.what: 这是一个包含 Google 产品和技术的 Agent Skills 仓库，提供可复用的技能模块，帮助 AI 代理执行云平台操作、解决方案架构等任务。通过 npx 命令即可安装和选择所需技能。
zh.content: 仓库内包含多个技能目录，涵盖 Google Cloud 入门、多产品解决方案、AI/ML 平台管理等，每个技能以 Markdown 文件形式提供详细指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 npx 进行安装，技能内容基于 Markdown 编写。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，开发者需要标准化的技能库来增强代理能力，Google 官方出品使其备受关注，star 数迅速增长。
uses: 开发者：为 AI 代理添加 Google Cloud 操作技能，快速集成云服务。
解决方案架构师：利用预置的技能模板设计云架构和数据分析流程。
AI 平台管理员：管理模型部署、调优和监控，提升运维效率。

en.tag: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
en.what: This repository contains Agent Skills for Google products and technologies, offering reusable skill modules that enable AI agents to perform cloud platform operations, solution architecture, and more. Skills can be installed via npx command with selective installation.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill directories covering Google Cloud onboarding, multi-product solutions, AI/ML platform management, etc., with each skill provided as detailed Markdown files.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, installed via npx, with skills written in Markdown.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, developers need standardized skill libraries to enhance agent capabilities, and Google's official offering has gained significant attention, leading to rapid star growth.
uses: Developers: Add Google Cloud operational skills to AI agents for quick cloud integration.
Solution architects: Use pre-built skill templates to design cloud architectures and data analytics workflows.
AI platform admins: Manage model deployment, tuning, and monitoring to improve operational efficiency.

zh.tag: 数学建模全流程自动化 Agent，一键生成可提交论文
zh.what: MathModelAgent 是一个专为数学建模设计的 AI Agent，能够自动完成从问题分析、建模、编码、绘图到论文排版的全流程，最终生成一份可直接提交的完整论文。它采用多智能体协作（建模手、代码手、论文手）和多模型配置，旨在将原本 3 天的比赛时间缩短至 1 小时。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面版应用（内置 Claude Code 与全套 SKILLS）、核心 SKILLS 集合（如 /1start-mathmodel）、17 套 Typst 论文模板、内置建模知识库，以及在线版本链接。项目蒸馏为完全由 SKILLS 驱动，不再依赖 Harness 层，每个阶段是独立 Skill，可单独调用。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，使用 Jupyter 作为本地代码解释器，支持 E2B 和 Daytona 云端解释器；通过 litellm 接入所有主流模型；使用 ChromaDB 和 Rerank 实现 RAG 知识库；集成 Tavily API 进行网络搜索；桌面版基于 Electron 等（具体未说明），内置 Claude Code。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 53 颗星，总星数达 4162，位列 Python 日榜第 19 名。其热度源于精准解决数学建模竞赛痛点，提供端到端自动化，且完全开源免费，可接入任意模型，吸引了大量参赛学生和科研人员。
uses: 数学建模竞赛参赛者：快速生成高质量论文，节省时间，提升获奖概率。
科研人员与工程师：自动化建模流程，辅助数据分析和报告撰写。
AI 应用开发者：参考其多智能体协作与 SKILLS 设计模式，构建类似自动化工具。

en.tag: Agent for automated math modeling, generating submission-ready papers
en.what: MathModelAgent is an AI agent designed for mathematical modeling that automates the entire workflow from problem analysis, modeling, coding, plotting, to paper typesetting, producing a complete paper ready for submission. It uses multi-agent collaboration (modeler, coder, writer) and multi-LLM configuration, aiming to reduce a 3-day competition to 1 hour.
en.content: The repository includes a desktop app (with built-in Claude Code and full SKILLS), core SKILLS collection (e.g., /1start-mathmodel), 17 Typst paper templates, built-in modeling knowledge base, and an online version link. The project is distilled to be fully SKILLS-driven without a Harness layer; each stage is an independent Skill that can be invoked separately.
en.stack: Built on Python, uses Jupyter as local code interpreter, supports E2B and Daytona cloud interpreters; integrates all major models via litellm; uses ChromaDB and Rerank for RAG knowledge base; integrates Tavily API for web search; desktop app likely based on Electron (not specified), with built-in Claude Code.
en.hot: The repository is rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub, with 53 stars today and 4,162 total, ranking 19th on the Python daily trending list. Its appeal stems from precisely addressing pain points in math modeling competitions, offering end-to-end automation, being fully open-source and free, and supporting any model, attracting many competition participants and researchers.
uses: Math modeling competition participants: quickly generate high-quality papers, save time, and increase winning chances.
Researchers and engineers: automate modeling workflows, assist data analysis and report writing.
AI application developers: reference its multi-agent collaboration and SKILLS design patterns to build similar automation tools.

zh.tag: 用 NumPy 从零实现机器学习算法，透明可读的教学仓库
zh.what: 这是一个从零开始用 Python 和 NumPy 实现经典机器学习模型与算法的仓库，覆盖线性回归到深度学习。项目目的不是追求性能优化，而是以透明易懂的方式展示算法内部工作原理。
zh.content: 仓库包含监督学习（如回归、分类）、无监督学习（如聚类、关联分析）、强化学习和深度学习（如 CNN、RBM）的实现，并附有可运行的示例脚本和可视化结果。
zh.stack: 主要依赖 Python 和 NumPy，部分示例可能使用 matplotlib 进行可视化，安装简单（setup.py）。
zh.hot: 该仓库长期受关注，累计 3.2 万星标，因其教学价值高，帮助学习者理解算法本质，今日新增 26 星，仍保持热度。
uses: 机器学习初学者：通过阅读源码理解算法内部机制，而非仅调用黑盒库。
教学与培训场景：作为课程补充材料，展示从零构建模型的完整过程。
面试准备者：快速复习经典模型的数学与实现细节。

en.tag: Bare-bones NumPy implementations of ML models for transparent, accessible learning
en.what: This repository provides bare-bones NumPy implementations of fundamental ML models and algorithms, from linear regression to deep learning. It prioritizes transparency and accessibility over computational efficiency to reveal how algorithms work internally.
en.content: It contains implementations for supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement, and deep learning (e.g., CNN, RBM), along with runnable example scripts and visualizations.
en.stack: Primarily Python with NumPy; some examples use matplotlib for visualization. Installation is straightforward via setup.py.
en.hot: With 32.6k stars and steady daily gains, it remains popular for its high educational value in demystifying ML algorithms.
uses: ML beginners who want to understand algorithms by reading source code instead of using black-box libraries.
Educators and trainers seeking supplementary material to demonstrate model building from scratch.
Job seekers preparing for interviews by reviewing mathematical and implementation details of classic models.

zh.tag: 高性能 LLM 与多模态模型推理服务框架
zh.what: SGLang 是一个用于大语言模型和多模态模型的高性能推理服务框架。它通过先进的技术如 RadixAttention 和 speculative decoding 实现极快的推理速度，并支持多种硬件后端。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心运行时、前端 API、文档、示例以及用于性能优化的模块。提供 Python 包和 Docker 镜像，支持多种模型架构和硬件加速。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，并针对 NVIDIA GPU 和 Google TPU 等硬件进行了优化。
zh.hot: SGLang 在 GitHub 上拥有超过 35k 星标，今日新增 836 星，因其在推理性能上的突破性优化（如 25 倍性能提升）和对最新模型（如 DeepSeek-V4）的快速支持而广受关注。
uses: AI 工程师和研究人员需要高效部署和运行大规模语言模型，以降低推理成本并提高吞吐量。
平台团队构建高性能 AI 推理服务，支持多用户、多模型并发，并需要灵活的调度和缓存策略。
对最新开源模型（如 Kimi K3、GLM5.2）有快速部署需求的开发者，希望第一时间体验前沿模型能力。

en.tag: High-performance serving framework for LLMs and multimodal models
en.what: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models. It achieves extremely fast inference via techniques like RadixAttention and speculative decoding, and supports various hardware backends.
en.content: The repository contains core runtime, frontend APIs, documentation, examples, and modules for performance optimization. It provides Python packages and Docker images, supporting various model architectures and hardware accelerations.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on PyTorch and other deep learning frameworks, optimized for NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs.
en.hot: With over 35k stars and 836 added today, SGLang is popular for its breakthrough inference optimizations (e.g., 25x speedup) and day-0 support for cutting-edge models like DeepSeek-V4.
uses: AI engineers and researchers who need to deploy and run large language models efficiently to reduce inference cost and increase throughput.
Platform teams building high-performance AI inference services that support multi-user, multi-model concurrency with flexible scheduling and caching.
Developers who require day-0 support for the latest open models like Kimi K3 and GLM5.2 to experience cutting-edge capabilities immediately.

zh.tag: 一套核心，多端适配的 AI 编码代理工作流编排引擎
zh.what: AI-DLC Workflows 将 AI 编码代理转化为可验证、自纠错的工程工作流。它基于 AI-DLC 方法论，提供 14 个代理角色（11 个领域专家、2 个审查代理、1 个自适应工作流编排器）和 33 阶段流程，每个关卡需人工批准。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个与工具无关的 core/ 目录，定义方法论；以及针对 Claude Code、Kiro IDE/CLI、Codex CLI、Cursor、opencode、GitHub Copilot 等工具的薄适配层，从单一源生成各工具的分发版本。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 TypeScript；依赖各 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等）的接口，遵循 AI-DLC 2.0 规范（含白皮书）。
zh.hot: AWS 官方出品，将 AI 代理从单点工具升级为可治理的完整开发生命周期，契合企业级 AI 工程化需求。4.3k stars 且持续增长，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望获得结构化、可审查的开发流程
技术负责人或平台团队，需要统一不同 AI 工具的工作流规范，确保代码质量与合规
对 AI 驱动开发方法论感兴趣的研究者，可参考其 14 代理、33 阶段的编排设计

en.tag: One harness-neutral core, many harnesses: AI agents as verifiable, self-correcting engineering workflows
en.what: AI-DLC Workflows turns AI coding agents into verifiable, self-correcting engineering workflows. Based on the AI-DLC methodology, it provides a 14-agent roster (11 domain experts, 2 review-only agents, and an adaptive-workflows composer) working through a 33-stage workflow with human approval at every gate.
en.content: The repository includes a harness-neutral core/ directory defining the methodology, plus thin adapters for Claude Code, Kiro IDE/CLI, Codex CLI, Cursor, opencode, and GitHub Copilot, generating distributions for each harness from a single source.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript; interfaces with various AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI, etc.), following the AI-DLC 2.0 Specification (including whitepaper).
en.hot: Official AWS project that elevates AI agents from point tools to a governed full development lifecycle, meeting enterprise AI engineering needs. 4.3k stars and growing, trending on TypeScript daily.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor who want a structured, reviewable development process
Tech leads or platform teams needing to unify workflow standards across different AI tools for quality and compliance
Researchers interested in AI-driven development methodologies, referencing its 14-agent, 33-stage orchestration design

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程助手直接操控 Chrome 的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: chrome-devtools-mcp 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，允许 AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor、Copilot）实时控制并检查 Chrome 浏览器。它提供性能洞察、高级调试和可靠自动化能力，并附带 CLI 供非 MCP 场景使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器实现、CLI 工具、文档（工具参考、故障排除、设计原则等）以及贡献指南。核心功能包括性能追踪、网络请求分析、截图和 console 消息检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 puppeteer 实现浏览器自动化，依赖 Chrome DevTools 前端进行性能追踪，并集成 Google CrUX API 获取真实用户体验数据。
zh.hot: 凭借 5 万+ star 成为 AI 代理工具链的明星项目，本周新增 738 star 登上 TypeScript 周榜。它让 AI 编程助手获得浏览器级调试能力，极大提升自动化与排错效率。
uses: AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor）需要自动化浏览器操作或调试前端代码的开发者
需要分析网页性能、网络请求和 console 错误的 QA 或性能工程师
希望为自定义 AI 工作流集成浏览器控制能力的 MCP 用户
对 Chrome DevTools 自动化感兴趣，想扩展其能力的开发者

en.tag: MCP server that lets coding agents control and inspect Chrome
en.what: chrome-devtools-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets coding agents (like Claude, Cursor, Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It provides performance insights, advanced debugging, and reliable automation, with a CLI for non-MCP use.
en.content: The repo contains the MCP server implementation, a CLI, docs (tool reference, troubleshooting, design principles), and contributing guidelines. Key features include performance tracing, network analysis, screenshots, and console message inspection.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses puppeteer for browser automation, leverages Chrome DevTools frontend for performance tracing, and integrates Google CrUX API for real-user experience data.
en.hot: With 50k+ stars, it's a star in the AI agent toolchain, gaining 738 stars this week and ranking #18 on TypeScript weekly. It gives coding agents browser-level debugging, boosting automation and troubleshooting efficiency.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to automate browser tasks or debug frontend code
QA or performance engineers needing to analyze page performance, network requests, and console errors
MCP users who want to integrate browser control into custom AI workflows
Developers interested in extending Chrome DevTools automation capabilities

zh.tag: 个人AI记忆基础设施，统一数据库与网关
zh.what: OB1（Open Brain）是一个为个人思考打造的基础设施层，提供一个统一的数据库、AI网关和聊天通道，让任何AI工具都能接入并共享持久记忆。它不是笔记应用，而是一个带向量搜索的数据库和开放协议，旨在让Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor等所有AI工具共享同一个“大脑”。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的设置指南、AI辅助设置流程、配套提示词包、常见问题解答，以及用于扩展的食谱（如Google Activity导入）。还提供了Claude Skill、ChatGPT Custom GPT和Gemini GEM等AI助手，帮助用户上手。
zh.stack: 主要使用TypeScript，涉及数据库（支持向量搜索）、AI网关、MCP服务器，以及Slack捕获集成。部署工作流使用GitHub Actions。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending上迅速走红，目前拥有4558颗星，今日新增10颗，位列TypeScript日榜第5。它切中了AI工具碎片化的痛点，提供统一的记忆层，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 适用于使用多个AI工具（如Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor）并希望它们共享上下文和记忆的个人用户。
适合希望构建个人知识库或第二大脑的技术爱好者，无需编写代码即可在45分钟内完成设置。
对于开发者，可作为基础设施参考，学习如何构建AI网关和向量数据库集成。

en.tag: Personal AI memory infrastructure with unified database and gateway
en.what: OB1 (Open Brain) is an infrastructure layer for personal thinking, offering one database, one AI gateway, and one chat channel so any AI tool can plug in and share persistent memory. It's not a notes app but a database with vector search and an open protocol, designed to let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI tools share the same 'brain'.
en.content: The repo includes setup guides, AI-assisted setup workflows, companion prompts, a FAQ, and recipes for extensions (e.g., Google Activity import). It also provides AI assistants like Claude Skill, ChatGPT Custom GPT, and Gemini GEM to help users get started.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, involving a database with vector search, an AI gateway, an MCP server, and Slack capture integration. Deployment workflows use GitHub Actions.
en.hot: The project is gaining traction on GitHub Trending with 4,558 stars and 10 new stars today, ranking #5 on the TypeScript daily list. It addresses the pain point of fragmented AI tools by offering a unified memory layer, attracting significant attention.
uses: For individuals using multiple AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) who want them to share context and memory.
For tech enthusiasts wanting to build a personal knowledge base or second brain, with no-code setup in about 45 minutes.
For developers interested in infrastructure patterns for AI gateways and vector database integration.

zh.tag: 可复制粘贴的高质量 UI 组件库与代码分发平台
zh.what: shadcn/ui 是一套设计精美、可访问性高的组件集合，采用复制粘贴的方式集成到项目中，而非传统依赖包。它支持多种框架，并提供代码分发平台，方便开发者分享和复用组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含组件源码、文档站点（apps/v4）、贡献指南和 MIT 许可证。组件以源码形式提供，可自由定制和扩展。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Radix UI 等无头组件库构建，支持 React、Vue、Svelte 等框架。
zh.hot: 凭借其创新的“复制粘贴”理念和优雅设计，star 数已超 12 万，今日新增 101，持续霸榜 GitHub Trending。
uses: 前端开发者快速构建现代化、可访问的 Web 应用界面
设计系统团队定制和扩展组件，保持品牌一致性
全栈开发者学习组件设计与无障碍实践

en.tag: Copy-paste UI components and code distribution platform
en.what: shadcn/ui is a collection of beautifully designed, accessible components that you can copy-paste into your apps, rather than installing as a dependency. It works with your favorite frameworks and includes a code distribution platform for sharing and reusing components.
en.content: The repo includes component source code, a documentation site (apps/v4), contributing guide, and MIT license. Components are provided as source code for full customization.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging headless libraries like Radix UI, and supports frameworks such as React, Vue, and Svelte.
en.hot: With its innovative copy-paste approach and elegant design, it has amassed over 120k stars, adding 101 today, consistently trending on GitHub.

Design system teams customizing components for brand consistency
Full-stack developers learning component design and accessibility practices

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 为 LLM 与 AI 编辑器提供实时代码文档的 MCP 平台
zh.what: Context7 是一个为大型语言模型和 AI 代码编辑器提供最新、版本特定文档与代码示例的平台。它通过 MCP 协议将实时文档直接注入提示词，避免模型使用过时或虚构的 API。

en.tag: MCP platform delivering up-to-date code docs for LLMs and AI editors

en.hot: With over 61K stars and 39 new today, it ranks #8 on the TypeScript trending list. It addresses the pain point of outdated docs and hallucinated APIs in AI coding, gaining wide adoption.
uses: Developers using AI editors like Cursor or VS Code who want accurate, real-time code examples.
Engineers building LLM apps or agents that need to integrate up-to-date library docs into prompts.
Developers working with modern frameworks like Supabase or Cloudflare to avoid errors from API changes.
Developers interested in MCP protocol and how to implement documentation injection.

zh.tag: 开源终端编码代理，兼容任意 LLM 后端
zh.what: OpenClaude 是一个开源的编码代理 CLI，支持云端和本地模型提供商。它允许用户通过统一的终端工作流使用 OpenAI 兼容 API、Gemini、GitHub Models、Codex OAuth、Ollama 等，同时保留提示、工具、代理、MCP、斜杠命令和流式输出等功能。

团队需要将编码代理集成到 CI/CD 或自动化工作流中。

en.tag: Open-source terminal coding agent for any LLM backend

Users who prefer local models like Ollama for offline development.

对 Claude Code 高级用法和自定义工具感兴趣的 AI 工程师。
关注 AI 编程生产力争议，想了解 LOC 方法论的研究者。

en.what: gstack is Garry Tan's (YC CEO) public Claude Code setup with 23 specialist tools and 8 power tools, simulating roles like CEO, designer, eng manager, release manager, doc engineer, and QA. It extends the AI coding assistant into a full software factory via slash commands and Markdown.
en.content: The repo contains tool definitions (Markdown), configuration examples, usage docs, and a detailed methodology with reproduction script on the LOC controversy. All tools are slash commands, MIT licensed.
en.stack: Built on Claude Code, written in TypeScript, relies on Markdown and slash commands, no extra runtime.
en.hot: The repo amassed 130K+ stars quickly, thanks to YC CEO's battle-tested config showing how AI agents boost individual productivity by hundreds of times, sparking wide debate.

AI engineers interested in advanced Claude Code usage and custom tools.
Researchers following the AI coding productivity debate and LOC methodology.

zh.tag: 用稳定命名本地URL替代端口号，面向开发者和AI代理
zh.what: Portless 是一个开发工具，让你用像 https://myapp.localhost 这样的稳定命名 URL 替代 localhost:3000 之类的端口号。它自动管理 HTTPS、端口分配和代理，简化本地开发体验，尤其适合人类和 AI 代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个命令行工具，通过全局或项目依赖安装。它生成本地 CA、绑定 443 端口并启动代理，自动将命名 URL 路由到分配的端口，支持多种框架和配置选项。
zh.stack: 主要用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 生态，通过 npm 分发。涉及 HTTPS/HTTP2、代理、进程管理等技术。
zh.hot: 今日新增 450 星，总星数 12052，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了开发中端口记忆和冲突的痛点，并迎合了 AI 代理对稳定 URL 的需求。
uses: 本地开发人员：告别端口号，使用易记的命名 URL 访问多个项目。
AI 代理开发者：为代理提供稳定的本地端点，便于自动化测试和交互。
团队协作：统一开发环境，减少端口冲突和配置问题。

en.tag: Replace port numbers with stable named local URLs for dev and agents
en.what: Portless is a dev tool that replaces port numbers with stable named URLs like https://myapp.localhost. It automatically handles HTTPS, port assignment, and proxying, simplifying local development for both humans and AI agents.
en.content: The repo contains a CLI tool installable globally or as a project dependency. It generates a local CA, binds port 443, and starts a proxy that routes named URLs to assigned ports, with support for many frameworks and configuration options.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, distributed via npm, leveraging Node.js ecosystem. Involves HTTPS/HTTP2, proxying, and process management.
en.hot: Gained 450 stars today, total 12052, trending on GitHub. It solves the pain of remembering and conflicting ports, and caters to AI agents needing stable URLs.
uses: Local developers: replace port numbers with memorable named URLs for multiple projects.
AI agent developers: provide stable local endpoints for agents to automate testing and interaction.
Team collaboration: unify dev environment, reduce port conflicts and configuration issues.

en.tag: One-stop LLM app dev platform for Agentic workflows & RAG
en.what: Dify is an open-source LLM app development platform for building Agentic workflows and RAG pipelines. It offers visual orchestration, rich AI model and tool support, and deployment options on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的跨平台语音转文字听写应用
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的语音转文字听写应用，支持本地离线模型（如 Whisper、NVIDIA Parakeet）和云端模型（自带密钥），确保音频数据不离开设备。它提供热键唤起、光标处插入文本、会议转录和笔记功能，是 WisprFlow 和 Granola 的免费替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，覆盖 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台，提供安装包（DMG、EXE、AppImage 等）。项目包含前端界面、语音引擎集成、系统托盘、热键监听等模块，并配有文档和 API 参考。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，可能基于 Electron 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用。语音识别依赖本地引擎（如 Whisper、NVIDIA Parakeet）和 ONNX Runtime，支持云端 API 集成。
zh.hot: 凭借隐私优先和跨平台特性，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获近 6000 星，今日新增 50 星，位列 JavaScript 日榜第五。作为商业产品的开源替代，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要高效语音输入的文字工作者，如记者、作家、程序员，可用热键快速听写。
注重隐私的用户，希望在本地完成语音转文字，避免音频上传云端。
经常开会的人士，利用会议转录功能自动生成笔记和行动项。
开发者或技术爱好者，可自定义模型或集成自有 API 密钥。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation app
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source voice-to-text dictation app supporting local offline models (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) and cloud models (bring your own key), ensuring audio data never leaves the device. It offers hotkey activation, text insertion at cursor, meeting transcription, and note-taking, serving as a free alternative to WisprFlow and Granola.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop app, covering macOS, Windows, and Linux, with installers (DMG, EXE, AppImage, etc.). It includes frontend UI, speech engine integration, system tray, hotkey listener, and is accompanied by docs and API reference.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely built with Electron or similar cross-platform framework. Speech recognition relies on local engines (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) and ONNX Runtime, with cloud API integration.
en.hot: Rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub due to privacy-first and cross-platform features, amassing nearly 6k stars with 50 new stars today, ranking 5th on the JavaScript daily trending. As an open-source alternative to commercial products, it attracts significant attention.
uses: For writers, journalists, and programmers who need efficient voice input with hotkey dictation.
For privacy-conscious users who want on-device speech-to-text without uploading audio to the cloud.
For frequent meeting attendees who use transcription to auto-generate notes and action items.
For developers and tech enthusiasts who can customize models or integrate their own API keys.

en.hot: With nearly 90k stars and trending on GitHub, this repo addresses the growing need for standardized engineering practices in AI coding agents. It offers plug-and-play skills that streamline agent workflows and improve code quality.
uses: AI agent users: want agents like Claude Code, Cursor to follow senior engineer best practices.
Development teams: need unified coding standards and quality gates to improve code review and testing efficiency.
Tech leads: want to automate development workflows, reduce manual steps, while maintaining quality.

zh.tag: 为AI代理设计的极速共享浏览器，零配置
zh.what: ego lite 是一款专为 AI 代理设计的浏览器，允许用户和 AI 代理并行工作。代理可以在独立空间中运行多个浏览器任务，同时用户保留自己的标签页，且无需额外配置即可共享登录状态。

zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，基于浏览器技术构建，支持 macOS 平台，Windows 和 Linux 在路线图中。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2288 星，总星数 11863，因解决 AI 浏览器自动化中登录状态共享的痛点而迅速走红。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理执行浏览器任务并访问真实登录状态。
自动化测试工程师：希望在不干扰用户标签页的情况下并行运行测试。
个人用户：想用 AI 代理处理日常网页操作，同时保留自己的浏览会话。

en.tag: Fastest shared browser for AI agents, zero config
en.what: ego lite is a browser designed for AI agents to run browser automation in parallel with users. Agents operate in their own Spaces, while users keep their tabs, and logins are shared seamlessly without extra setup.
en.content: The repo provides macOS app downloads (Apple Silicon and Intel), docs, Discord, X handle, and demo video. Core feature is the `ego-browser` skill enabling agents to access real logins and tabs.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, leveraging browser technologies, currently supports macOS, with Windows and Linux on roadmap.
en.hot: Gained 2288 stars this week, total 11863, popular for solving login-sharing pain in AI browser automation.

Automation testers: want parallel test runs without disturbing user tabs.
Personal users: want AI agents to handle web tasks while keeping their own session.

uses: 开发者和团队希望让 AI 助手直接查询或更新 Jira 工单、Confluence 页面，实现自动化工作流。
使用 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 等 AI 工具的用户，想要安全地连接公司内部 Atlassian 数据。
企业管理员需要为 AI 工具提供受控的、基于 OAuth 2.1 的访问权限，确保合规性。

en.tag: Official remote MCP server from Atlassian, bridging AI tools to Jira, Confluence, and more
en.what: This is an official remote MCP server by Atlassian that enables AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor to securely and in real-time access Atlassian cloud products such as Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket. en.hot: As an official remote MCP server from Atlassian, it fills the gap between AI tools and enterprise collaboration platforms. Despite zero stars today, it has accumulated 1017 stars and ranks #11 on the JavaScript trending list, indicating strong demand for enterprise AI integration.
uses: Developers and teams who want AI assistants to directly query or update Jira tickets and Confluence pages for automated workflows.
Users of AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor who need secure access to their company's Atlassian data.
Enterprise administrators seeking controlled, OAuth 2.1-based access for AI tools to ensure compliance.

zh.tag: Claude Code 全家桶：代理、技能、钩子、规则与 MCP 配置
zh.what: 这是一个由 Anthropic 黑客松获奖者开发的 Claude Code 配置集合，包含生产级的代理、技能、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置。这些配置经过 10 多个月的日常使用打磨，用于构建真实产品。

zh.hot: 本周新增 154 颗星，总星数突破 1000，登上 JavaScript 周榜第 9 名。作为黑客松获奖者的实战配置，吸引了大量 Claude Code 用户寻求高效开发工作流。

AI 辅助开发团队：需要标准化代理、技能和钩子配置的团队。
学习 AI 编程实践：想了解如何构建高效 AI 开发工作流的学习者。

en.tag: Complete Claude Code toolkit: agents, skills, hooks, rules, and MCP configs
en.what: A collection of Claude Code configurations from an Anthropic hackathon winner, including production-ready agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs. Evolved over 10+ months of intensive daily use building real products.
