AI-assisted dev teams: teams needing standardized agents, skills, and hooks.
Learners of AI coding practices: those wanting to build efficient AI dev workflows.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 浏览器中的网络瑞士军刀，加密编码分析神器
zh.what: CyberChef 是一个简单直观的网页应用，用于在浏览器中执行各种“网络”操作，如 XOR 和 Base64 编码、AES 等加密、压缩解压、哈希计算等。它旨在让技术与非技术分析师都能以复杂方式处理数据，无需掌握复杂工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CyberChef 源代码，包括前端界面、核心操作库、构建配置和 Docker 支持。提供官方网站在线使用，也支持本地 Docker 或源码构建运行。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Node.js 构建，支持 Docker 容器化部署。前端采用 Web 技术，核心操作模块化设计。
zh.hot: CyberChef 作为 GCHQ 开源项目，功能强大且免费，长期受到安全研究人员和数据分析师青睐。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计 35k+ star 证明其持续热度。
uses: 安全分析师：快速解码或编码数据，进行恶意软件分析或日志取证。
开发人员：调试接口时进行数据格式转换，如 Base64、Hex 等。
数据爱好者：无需编程即可进行复杂的数据转换和计算。

en.tag: A web app for encryption, encoding, compression and data analysis
en.what: CyberChef is a simple, intuitive web app for carrying out all manner of 'cyber' operations within a web browser, including encoding, encryption, compression, and data analysis. It enables both technical and non-technical analysts to manipulate data in complex ways without dealing with complex tools.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of CyberChef, including the frontend interface, core operations library, build configuration, and Docker support. It offers an official website for online use, as well as local Docker or source builds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built with Node.js, and supports Docker containerization. The frontend uses web technologies, and core operations are modular.
en.hot: As an open-source project from GCHQ, CyberChef is powerful and free, long favored by security researchers and data analysts. Despite modest daily stars, its 35k+ total stars demonstrate sustained popularity.
uses: Security analysts: quickly decode/encode data for malware analysis or log forensics.
Developers: convert data formats like Base64 or Hex when debugging APIs.
Data enthusiasts: perform complex data transformations and calculations without coding.

zh.tag: 微软出品的12周Web开发入门课程

编程教师或培训者，可直接使用现成的教案和项目作为教学资源。
需要复习前端基础或寻找实践项目的开发者，可从中获取灵感。

en.tag: Microsoft's 12-week web dev beginner curriculum

Educators or trainers who can use the ready-made lesson plans and projects as teaching materials.
Developers seeking to review front-end basics or find practical project ideas.

zh.tag: 隐形 AI 面试助手，屏幕共享不可见
zh.what: OpenCluely 是一款开源桌面应用，专为技术面试（如 DSA、在线测评、竞赛编程）提供实时 AI 辅助。它通过隐形覆盖层显示答案，屏幕共享或录制工具无法捕捉，支持语音提问和截图识别，并流式返回答案。

zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，可能基于 Electron 等桌面框架。AI 功能依赖 Gemini API，支持本地语音识别，跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）。
zh.hot: 在技术面试场景中提供隐形 AI 辅助，满足求职者需求，且免费开源、隐私友好。今日新增 4 星，总星数 896，登上 JavaScript 日榜第 16 名。
uses: 准备 DSA、在线测评或竞赛编程的技术求职者，希望获得实时提示又不被监考发现。
需要在不中断屏幕共享的情况下，快速获取代码思路或调试建议的开发者。
注重隐私的用户，希望 AI 处理本地化，仅发送必要请求到 AI 提供商。

en.tag: Invisible AI interview copilot that screen sharing cannot see
en.what: OpenCluely is an open-source desktop app that provides real-time AI assistance during technical interviews like DSA, OAs, and CP. It displays answers on an invisible overlay that screen sharing and recording tools cannot capture, supports voice or screenshot input, and streams responses.

en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely built on a desktop framework like Electron. AI features rely on Gemini API, with local voice recognition, cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux).
en.hot: It offers stealth AI assistance for technical interviews, appealing to job seekers, and is free, open-source, and privacy-friendly. Gaining 4 stars today, total 896, it reached #16 on the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: Tech job seekers preparing for DSA, OAs, or CP who want real-time hints without being detected by proctors.
Developers needing quick coding insights or debugging suggestions without disrupting screen sharing.
Privacy-conscious users who prefer local processing with only necessary requests sent to the AI provider.

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: 跨代理、跨机器的长期记忆层，让编码代理无缝交接
zh.what: ai-memory 为 AI 编码代理提供长期记忆服务，支持在多个代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）之间共享记忆，实现任务的无缝交接。它通过捕获会话数据、整合为可读的 Markdown 页面，并提供检索与交接协议，确保代理能记住上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的服务端与 CLI 工具，提供捕获、整合、检索和交接功能。核心是 git 备份的 Markdown 文件作为事实源，数据库为派生索引。支持多用户认证、审计日志和生命周期钩子。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust（1.95+），依赖 git 进行版本管理，支持多平台。默认无需 LLM API，但可选用。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，跨代理记忆和交接成为痛点。该项目提供统一解决方案，上线即获 5735 星，月增 113，反映开发者对无缝工作流的需求。
uses: 频繁切换不同 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望保留任务上下文，避免重复解释。
团队协作时，需要共享项目知识，让不同成员的代理都能访问同一记忆库。
跨设备工作的开发者，希望在不同机器上继续同一项目的工作。

en.tag: Cross-agent, cross-machine long-term memory for coding agents with seamless handoffs
en.what: ai-memory provides long-term memory for AI coding agents, enabling shared memory across multiple agents (like Claude Code, Codex) for seamless task handoffs. It captures session data, consolidates into readable Markdown pages, and offers recall and handoff protocols so agents retain context.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-implemented server and CLI tooling, offering capture, consolidation, recall, and handoff features. The core is a git-backed wiki of Markdown files as source of truth, with a derived database index. Includes multi-user auth, audit logs, and lifecycle hooks.
en.stack: Primarily Rust (1.95+), leveraging git for versioning, cross-platform. Works with zero LLM calls by default, but can be integrated optionally.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, cross-agent memory and handoff become pain points. This project offers a unified solution, quickly gaining 5735 stars with 113 monthly additions, reflecting developers' need for seamless workflows.
uses: Developers who frequently switch between different AI coding agents and want to retain task context without re-explaining.
Teams that need to share project knowledge so that each member's agent can access the same memory base.
Developers working across multiple devices who want to resume the same project on different machines.

zh.tag: Rust 编程语言官方主仓库：编译器、标准库与文档
zh.what: Rust 是一门系统编程语言，注重性能、可靠性与生产力。该仓库是 Rust 语言的核心源码仓库，包含编译器（rustc）、标准库和官方文档。
zh.content: 仓库包含编译器前端与后端、标准库实现、官方文档（如 The Book）以及贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 LLVM 作为后端，并包含 Cargo 构建工具、rustfmt 格式化器、Clippy linter 和 rust-analyzer 等工具链组件。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 语言的官方仓库，拥有超过 11.7 万 star，持续吸引开发者关注，今日新增 42 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。
uses: 系统编程开发者：需要高性能和内存安全的底层开发场景，如操作系统、嵌入式等。
Web 后端与工具链开发者：利用 Rust 的可靠性和丰富工具链构建高效服务。
编程语言爱好者：研究编译器实现和语言设计，参与开源贡献。

en.tag: Official main repository for the Rust programming language: compiler, standard library, and docs
en.what: Rust is a systems programming language focused on performance, reliability, and productivity. This repository is the main source code repository for Rust, containing the compiler (rustc), standard library, and official documentation.
en.content: The repository contains compiler frontend and backend, standard library implementation, official documentation (like The Book), and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, relies on LLVM as backend, and includes toolchain components like Cargo build tool, rustfmt formatter, Clippy linter, and rust-analyzer.
en.hot: As the official repository of the Rust language, it has over 117k stars, consistently attracting developers' attention, with 42 new stars today, ranking third on the Rust trending list.
uses: Systems programmers: for low-level development requiring high performance and memory safety, such as OS and embedded.
Web backend and toolchain developers: leveraging Rust's reliability and rich tooling to build efficient services.
Programming language enthusiasts: to study compiler implementation and language design, and contribute to open source.

zh.tag: 把安卓手机变成电脑的高品质无线麦克风
zh.what: MicYou 是一个将安卓手机变为电脑高品质麦克风的工具，支持 Wi-Fi、USB 和 Web 三种连接方式。它提供原生安卓客户端和桌面端服务器，适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，并具备丰富的音频处理功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含安卓客户端源码、桌面端服务器（GUI/CLI/TUI）、音频处理管线（AI 降噪、回声消除等）以及详细的文档和截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发桌面端，安卓客户端采用原生开发，支持 Material 3 界面。依赖包括音频路由工具（如 VB-CABLE、PipeWire、BlackHole）和多种音频处理库。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 163 星，总星数达 3541，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 6。其创新的应用场景和跨平台支持吸引了大量用户。
uses: 需要临时使用高品质麦克风的用户，如进行线上会议、直播或录音。
希望利用手机作为无线麦克风进行游戏语音或视频通话的玩家。
对音频处理有专业需求的内容创作者，可利用 AI 降噪和回声消除功能。
开发者可参考其 Rust 桌面端和安卓客户端架构，学习跨平台音频应用开发。

en.tag: Turn your Android phone into a high-quality wireless mic for your PC
en.what: MicYou is a tool that turns your Android phone into a high-quality microphone for your PC, supporting Wi-Fi, USB, and Web connections. It includes a native Android app and desktop servers for Windows, Linux, and macOS, with extensive audio processing features.
en.content: The repository contains the Android client source code, desktop server (GUI/CLI/TUI), audio processing pipeline (AI noise suppression, echo cancellation, etc.), and detailed documentation with screenshots.
en.stack: The desktop side is primarily developed in Rust, while the Android client is native with Material 3 UI. It relies on audio routing tools like VB-CABLE, PipeWire, and BlackHole, along with various audio processing libraries.
en.hot: The project is gaining rapid popularity on GitHub, with 163 stars added today and a total of 3541, ranking 6th on the Rust trending list. Its innovative use case and cross-platform support attract many users.
uses: Users needing a high-quality mic temporarily for online meetings, live streaming, or recording.
Gamers or callers who want to use their phone as a wireless mic for voice chat.
Content creators with professional audio needs, leveraging AI noise suppression and echo cancellation.
Developers interested in cross-platform audio app architecture, referencing the Rust desktop and Android client.

zh.tag: 开源 Loom 替代品，美观可分享的屏幕录制工具
zh.what: Cap 是一款开源的屏幕录制工具，旨在替代 Loom。它提供快速录制、本地编辑、即时分享链接、评论、字幕、分析、团队工作区等功能，并支持自定义域名、S3 存储和完全自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（macOS/Windows）、Web 仪表盘、编辑器等组件，支持即时模式和工作室模式两种录制方式。
zh.stack: 桌面应用使用 Rust 和 Tauri 构建，前端可能涉及 Web 技术，支持 S3 兼容存储。
zh.hot: 作为 Loom 的开源替代品，Cap 提供数据所有权和自托管选项，吸引了大量关注，今日新增 121 星，总星数超过 2.1 万。
uses: 产品演示、教程和客户更新等需要屏幕录制的场景
团队异步协作，如代码审查、设计反馈和异步站会
注重数据隐私和自托管的企业用户

en.tag: Open source Loom alternative for beautiful, shareable screen recordings
en.what: Cap is an open-source screen recording tool designed as a Loom alternative. It offers fast recording, polished local editing, instant share links, comments, transcripts, analytics, team workspaces, custom domains, custom S3 storage, and full self-hosting.
en.content: The repository includes desktop apps for macOS/Windows, a web dashboard, and an editor, supporting both Instant Mode and Studio Mode for recording.
en.stack: Desktop apps are built with Rust and Tauri, frontend likely uses web technologies, and it supports S3-compatible storage.
en.hot: As an open-source Loom alternative, Cap attracts attention with data ownership and self-hosting options, gaining 121 stars today and over 21k total.
uses: For product demos, tutorials, and client updates requiring screen recordings
For async team collaboration like code reviews, design feedback, and async standups
For enterprises prioritizing data privacy and self-hosting

zh.tag: 为编码智能体打造的版本控制与协作平台
zh.what: Atlas 是面向编码智能体的源代码控制工具，将每次智能体运行与提交关联，记录提示、工具调用和推理过程。它支持并行运行多个智能体（如 Claude Code、Codex 等），共享记忆和知识，实现无缝切换与协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的核心引擎、命令行工具、文档、以及用于展示的 banner 等资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）注册表，可能涉及本地文件系统与 Markdown 处理。
zh.hot: 今日新增 419 星，总星数达 3132，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）排名第二。随着多智能体协作开发兴起，开发者急需此类工具来管理和追踪智能体行为，Atlas 填补了这一空白。
uses: 使用多个编码智能体（如 Claude Code、Codex）的开发者，希望统一管理和追踪它们的变更。
需要跨智能体共享上下文和记忆的团队，避免重复工作，提升协作效率。
对智能体行为进行审计和回溯的工程师，要求每次提交都有详细解释。

en.tag: Source control for coding agents: track, query, and collaborate across agents
en.what: Atlas is source control for coding agents, linking every commit to the session that produced it, including prompts, tool calls, and reasoning. It enables running multiple agents side-by-side with shared memory, so switching agents mid-task doesn't mean starting over.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based core engine, CLI tools, documentation, and assets like banners for presentation.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, leveraging the ACP (Agent Client Protocol) registry, and likely involving local file system and Markdown processing.
en.hot: With 419 stars added today and a total of 3132, it ranks #2 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily. As multi-agent collaborative development rises, developers need tools to manage and track agent actions, and Atlas fills this gap.
uses: Developers using multiple coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) who want to manage and track their changes in one place.
Teams needing to share context and memory across agents to avoid redundant work and boost collaboration.
Engineers auditing agent behavior, requiring detailed explanations for every commit.

zh.tag: 兼容 Git 的下一代版本控制系统
zh.what: Jujutsu (jj) 是一个从头设计、注重易用性的版本控制系统，内部抽象了用户界面和版本控制算法与存储层，目前使用 Git 仓库作为存储后端，因此兼容现有 Git 工具。它融合了 Git、Mercurial 等系统的设计理念，旨在提供更简洁的工作流和更强大的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的完整 VCS 命令行工具，提供安装指南、教程、开发路线图等文档，以及用于贡献的指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Git 作为存储后端，并可能集成其他存储后端（如 Mercurial）。
zh.hot: 作为 Git 的潜在替代品，它提供了更直观的命令和更灵活的历史编辑功能，吸引了大量开发者关注，目前星标已超 3.1 万，今日新增 29 星，位列 Rust 日榜第七。
uses: 希望简化版本控制工作流的开发者，尤其是对 Git 复杂性感到困扰的用户。
需要与现有 Git 仓库和工具链无缝协作的团队，可平滑迁移。
对版本控制底层设计感兴趣，愿意探索新工具的技术爱好者。

en.tag: A next-gen VCS that is Git-compatible, simple and powerful
en.what: Jujutsu (jj) is a powerful version control system designed from the ground up for ease of use. It abstracts the UI and algorithms from storage, using Git repositories as a backend for compatibility with Git-based tools. It combines design concepts from Git, Mercurial, and others to offer a simpler and more powerful workflow.
en.content: The repository contains a full-featured VCS command-line tool implemented in Rust, along with installation guides, tutorials, development roadmap, and contributing guidelines.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it uses Git as a storage backend and may integrate other backends like Mercurial in the future.
en.hot: As a potential Git alternative with more intuitive commands and flexible history editing, it has attracted significant attention, amassing over 31k stars with 29 new stars today, ranking 7th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Developers seeking a simpler version control workflow, especially those frustrated by Git's complexity.
Teams that need seamless integration with existing Git repositories and toolchains for a smooth migration.
Tech enthusiasts interested in the underlying design of version control systems and eager to explore new tools.

zh.tag: 俄罗斯解锁 Google Antigravity 的本地补丁工具
zh.what: 这是一个针对 Windows 和 Linux 的解锁工具，让俄罗斯用户无需 VPN 或更改 Google 账号地区即可使用 Antigravity。它通过修改本地文件和 DNS 规则绕过区域限制，且所有更改可回滚。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的可执行文件，提供图形界面或命令行操作，支持一键解锁、自动更新补丁和完整回滚功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 开发，涉及系统级文件修改、DNS 规则设置（NRPT）和本地代理。
zh.hot: 因 Google 对俄罗斯用户的限制，该工具解决了实际痛点，上线后迅速获得 443 星，今日新增 19 星，登上 Rust 趋势榜第 8。
uses: 俄罗斯用户希望使用 Antigravity 但受区域限制，不想用 VPN 或改账号地区。
需要为多台电脑或不同 Google 账号提供一次性解锁方案的技术爱好者。
关注 Google 代理编程工具（如 Antigravity IDE/CLI）的开发者，希望绕过地区限制。

en.tag: Local patcher to unlock Google Antigravity in Russia without VPN
en.what: This is an unlocker for Windows and Linux that allows Russian users to use Antigravity without VPN or changing Google account region. It bypasses regional restrictions by patching local files and DNS rules, with all changes reversible.
en.content: The repository contains Rust-based executables with GUI or CLI, offering one-click unlock, automatic patching on Antigravity updates, and full rollback.
en.stack: Developed in Rust, involving system-level file patching, DNS rules (NRPT), and a local proxy.
en.hot: Addressing a real pain point for Russian users blocked by Google, it quickly gained 443 stars with 19 today, ranking #8 on Rust trending.
uses: Russian users who want to use Antigravity despite regional blocks, avoiding VPN or account region changes.
Tech enthusiasts needing a one-time unlock solution for multiple computers or different Google accounts.
Developers using Google's agentic coding tools (Antigravity IDE/CLI) who want to bypass geo-restrictions.

zh.tag: 一键切换 Antigravity 账号的桌面管理工具
zh.what: Antigravity Tools 是一款专为开发者和 AI 爱好者设计的桌面应用，用于管理 Antigravity 账号并实现一键无缝切换。它还能将 Web 端 Session 转化为标准 API，充当本地 AI 中转站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tauri v2 + React 前端和 Rust 后端，提供图形界面进行账号管理、协议转换和请求调度。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React 和 Rust，使用现代桌面应用框架，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3 万+ Star 和日增 84 的热度，它解决了 AI 账号管理的痛点，提供高效便捷的本地中转方案。
uses: 需要管理多个 Antigravity 账号的开发者，可一键切换，提升效率。
希望将 Web Session 转为 API 的 AI 爱好者，用于本地集成和调用。
追求低成本、高稳定 AI 中转服务的用户，可结合赞助商服务使用。

en.tag: One-click Antigravity account manager & switcher desktop app
en.what: Antigravity Tools is a desktop app for developers and AI enthusiasts to manage Antigravity accounts and switch between them seamlessly with one click. It also converts web sessions into standard APIs, acting as a local AI relay.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri v2 + React frontend and Rust backend, offering a GUI for account management, protocol conversion, and request routing.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, and Rust, leveraging a modern desktop framework for cross-platform support.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 84 daily additions, it addresses AI account management pain points with an efficient local relay solution.
uses: Developers managing multiple Antigravity accounts can switch with one click for efficiency.
AI enthusiasts wanting to convert web sessions into APIs for local integration and calls.
Users seeking low-cost, stable AI relay services can leverage sponsor offerings.

zh.tag: 一站式下载器：课程、视频、音乐、书籍，无需命令行
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，支持从 Udemy、Hotmart、YouTube 等 1800+ 网站下载课程、视频、音乐和电子书。内置播放器、PDF/EPUB 阅读器和音乐库，所有文件保存在本地，无需命令行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 后端、Svelte/Tauri 前端、桌面安装包及多语言 README。提供图形界面、快捷键下载、内置播放器等功能，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tauri 构建，使用 Svelte 作为前端框架，依赖 yt-dlp 进行下载。
zh.hot: 今日新增 102 星，总星数达 9480，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）排名第 10。其精准的 SEO 标签策略使其在多个下载器细分领域（如课程下载、YouTube 下载）中排名第一，吸引了大量用户。
uses: 在线学习者：需要下载 Udemy、Hotmart 等平台的付费课程以便离线观看。
内容创作者：希望保存 YouTube、TikTok 等平台的视频素材用于二次创作。
音乐与书籍爱好者：想要下载音乐和电子书并在应用内管理阅读。
技术小白：希望无需命令行即可轻松下载网络资源。

en.tag: All-in-one downloader for courses, videos, music & books — no terminal needed
en.what: OmniGet is a free, open-source desktop app that downloads courses, videos, music, and books from 1,800+ sites including Udemy, Hotmart, and YouTube. It features a built-in player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library, keeping all files on your computer with no terminal required.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust backend, Svelte/Tauri frontend, desktop installers, and multilingual READMEs. It offers a GUI, hotkey downloads, built-in player, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri, using Svelte for the frontend, and powered by yt-dlp for downloads.
en.hot: Gained 102 stars today, reaching 9,480 total, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily. Its strategic SEO tagging makes it #1 in niche downloader categories (e.g., course-downloader, youtube-downloader), driving significant attention.
uses: Online learners who need to download paid courses from Udemy, Hotmart, etc. for offline viewing.
Content creators who want to save videos from YouTube, TikTok, etc. for remixing or reference.
Music and book enthusiasts who wish to download media and manage them within the app.
Non-technical users who prefer a GUI over command-line tools for downloading online content.

zh.tag: 跨平台 AI 编码代理一站式配置切换与管理工具
zh.what: CC Switch 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于集中管理 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多个 AI 编码代理的配置与 API 端点，支持快速切换不同提供商或模型。它旨在简化开发者管理多个 AI 工具的过程，提升工作效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 Tauri 2 桌面应用源码，提供图形界面用于管理代理配置，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。项目还包含多语言 README（英文、中文、日文、德文）及变更日志，并设有赞助商展示区。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tauri 2 构建，使用 Web 前端技术（如 HTML/CSS/JS）渲染界面。依赖系统 WebView 实现跨平台支持，并可能集成 API 调用与配置管理库。
zh.hot: 该仓库已获得 13 万+ Star，今日新增 182，位居 Rust 日榜第 11。其热度源于 AI 编码代理的爆发式增长，开发者需要统一管理多个代理配置，CC Switch 正好解决了这一痛点。
uses: 适用于使用多个 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）的开发者，需要频繁切换配置的场景
适合团队统一管理成员的 AI 工具配置，确保使用一致的模型和 API 端点
对 AI 工具配置管理感到繁琐、希望简化操作流程的开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform all-in-one manager for AI coding agents
en.what: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop app that centrally manages configurations and API endpoints for multiple AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. It enables quick switching between providers or models, streamlining the developer's workflow with multiple AI tools.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Tauri 2 desktop app written in Rust, offering a GUI to manage agent configurations, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It also includes multilingual READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese, German) and a changelog, with a sponsor showcase section.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri 2, using web front-end technologies (HTML/CSS/JS) for the UI. It leverages the system WebView for cross-platform support and likely integrates API calls and configuration management libraries.
en.hot: With over 131k stars and 182 new stars today, ranking #11 on the Rust daily trending list, its popularity stems from the explosive growth of AI coding agents, as developers need a unified way to manage multiple agent configurations, which CC Switch addresses.
uses: For developers using multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) who need to switch configurations frequently
Ideal for teams to centrally manage members' AI tool configurations, ensuring consistent models and API endpoints
For developers who find managing AI tool configurations tedious and want to streamline their workflow

zh.tag: macOS 上的开源容器与虚拟机运行时
zh.what: ArcBox 是一个用 Rust 从零构建的快速、开源的容器和虚拟机运行时，专为 macOS 设计。它提供 Docker 兼容引擎、原生 Kubernetes、AI 代理沙箱以及完整的 Linux 和 macOS 虚拟机，旨在替代 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心运行时（自己的 VMM、VirtIO 设备、文件系统共享和网络数据路径）以及 CLI 工具（abctl），支持容器、沙箱、Linux 机器和 macOS 客户机四种工作负载。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，自带 VMM 和 VirtIO 设备，OCI 兼容，支持 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 今日新增 543 星，总星数 2874，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）第 17 名。作为 OrbStack 的开源替代品，它提供了快速、低开销的 Docker 和 VM 体验，同时保持完全开源。
uses: 开发者希望在 macOS 上使用 Docker 兼容环境，但不想依赖闭源的 Docker Desktop 或 OrbStack。
AI 工程师需要为代理或不可信代码提供隔离的沙箱环境，且要求快速启动和本地优先。
系统管理员或 DevOps 人员需要原生 Kubernetes 支持，以及完整的 Linux 虚拟机。
需要临时 macOS 虚拟机进行测试或开发的用户。

en.tag: Open-source container & VM runtime for macOS
en.what: ArcBox is a fast, open-source container and VM runtime for macOS, built from scratch in Rust. It offers Docker-compatible engine, native Kubernetes, AI agent sandboxes, and full Linux and macOS VMs, aiming to replace Docker Desktop and OrbStack.
en.content: The repository contains the core runtime (its own VMM, VirtIO devices, filesystem sharing, and network datapath) and the CLI tool (abctl), supporting four types of workloads: containers, sandboxes, Linux machines, and macOS guests.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation with its own VMM and VirtIO devices, OCI compatible, supports Kubernetes.
en.hot: Gained 543 stars today, total 2874, ranking #17 in GitHub Trending (Rust). As an open-source alternative to OrbStack, it offers fast, low-overhead Docker and VM experience while being fully open source.
uses: Developers who want Docker-compatible environment on macOS without relying on closed-source Docker Desktop or OrbStack.
AI engineers needing isolated sandboxes for agents or untrusted code with fast boot and local-first.
Sysadmins or DevOps needing native Kubernetes support and full Linux VMs.
Users needing disposable macOS VMs for testing or development.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的轻量 Bitwarden 服务器，自托管首选
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 服务器 API 的非官方替代实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方 Bitwarden 客户端。它专为自托管设计，资源占用远低于官方服务，适合不想运行重量级官方服务器的用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码，支持 Docker、Podman 等多种部署方式，提供 Docker Hub、ghcr.io 等镜像。项目包含 Web 界面、API 实现、数据库迁移等模块，并附带详细的部署文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Actix Web 框架、SQLx 数据库工具，支持 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL 等数据库。前端部分使用 Web Vault（官方 Bitwarden 前端）的静态文件。
zh.hot: Vaultwarden 拥有 66.8k stars，持续活跃，今日新增 66 星，位列 Rust 日榜第 13。其轻量、易自托管的特点吸引了大量希望完全掌控密码数据的用户。
uses: 个人用户或小团队希望自托管密码管理器，避免依赖云端服务
企业或组织需要低成本、低资源占用的密码管理解决方案
开发者希望基于 Bitwarden 兼容 API 进行二次开发或集成

en.tag: Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible server in Rust, ideal for self-hosting
en.what: Vaultwarden is an unofficial alternative implementation of the Bitwarden server API, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It is designed for self-hosting, with much lower resource usage than the official service, ideal for users who prefer a lightweight setup.
en.content: The repository contains the full server-side code, supporting deployment via Docker, Podman, and more, with images on Docker Hub and ghcr.io. It includes a web interface, API implementation, database migrations, and detailed deployment documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, using Actix Web framework and SQLx for database access, supporting SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL. The frontend uses static files from the official Bitwarden Web Vault.
en.hot: With 66.8k stars and steady growth (66 stars today, #13 on Rust daily trending), Vaultwarden's lightweight and self-hosting-friendly nature attracts users who want full control over their password data.
uses: Individuals or small teams who want to self-host a password manager and avoid cloud dependencies
Organizations needing a low-cost, low-resource password management solution
Developers looking to build on a Bitwarden-compatible API for customization or integration

zh.tag: 开源智能间隔重复记忆卡软件
zh.what: Anki 是一款基于间隔重复算法的智能记忆卡软件，帮助用户高效记忆。它通过科学安排复习时间，提高长期记忆保留率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Anki 桌面版的全部源代码，包括核心算法、用户界面、同步功能等。代码结构清晰，包含文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，结合 TypeScript、Python 等，依赖 Qt 框架。
zh.hot: 作为广受欢迎的记忆工具，Anki 拥有超过 3 万 star，今日新增 33 个，持续受到学习者青睐。
uses: 语言学习者：利用间隔重复高效记忆单词和短语。
医学生和法学生：记忆大量专业术语和知识点。
终身学习者：复习任何需要长期记忆的内容。
开发者：学习 Rust 和大型项目架构的绝佳案例。

en.tag: Open-source smart spaced repetition flashcard software
en.what: Anki is a smart flashcard program that uses spaced repetition to help users memorize effectively. It schedules reviews at optimal intervals to enhance long-term retention.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for Anki's computer version, including core algorithms, user interface, and synchronization features. It is well-organized with documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with TypeScript and Python, relying on the Qt framework.
en.hot: As a widely-used memorization tool, Anki has over 30k stars, with 33 added today, continuing to attract learners.
uses: Language learners: efficiently memorize vocabulary and phrases with spaced repetition.
Medical and law students: memorize vast amounts of terminology and knowledge points.
Lifelong learners: review any content that requires long-term retention.
Developers: an excellent case study for learning Rust and large-scale project architecture.

zh.tag: CLI代理，压缩命令输出，节省LLM令牌60-90%
zh.what: RTK是一个高性能的CLI代理，拦截shell命令并压缩其输出，再传给LLM，从而大幅减少token消耗。它支持100多种常用命令，如ls、cat、git、测试等，通过智能格式化和过滤，将输出压缩至原来的10%-40%。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust源码、文档（多语言README）、架构说明、安装脚本和CI配置。核心是一个单一Rust二进制文件，无依赖，可直接通过Homebrew或预编译二进制安装。
zh.stack: 纯Rust实现，无外部依赖，利用Rust的高性能和内存安全特性。支持跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows），通过shell钩子或包装命令集成。
zh.hot: 在LLM代理开发热潮中，token成本是痛点，RTK直接减少60-90%的输入token，且安装简单、性能开销<10ms，因此迅速获得78k+星标，日增163。
uses: 使用Claude Code、Codex等AI编程助手的开发者，希望降低token费用
需要处理大量命令行输出的自动化脚本或CI流程，优化LLM上下文
对Rust高性能工具感兴趣的开发者，学习如何构建系统级CLI

en.tag: CLI proxy that cuts LLM token usage by 60-90% on dev commands
en.what: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy that intercepts shell commands and compresses their output before it reaches an LLM, cutting token usage by 60-90%. It supports 100+ common commands like ls, cat, git, and test runners, using smart formatting and filtering to reduce output to 10-40% of its original size.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, documentation (multi-language READMEs), architecture docs, installation scripts, and CI config. The core is a single Rust binary with zero dependencies, installable via Homebrew or prebuilt binaries.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation with zero dependencies, leveraging Rust's performance and memory safety. Cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows), integrated via shell hooks or command wrapping.
en.hot: Amid the LLM agent boom, token costs are a pain point; RTK directly cuts input tokens by 60-90%, with simple install and <10ms overhead, quickly amassing 78k+ stars and 163 new stars today.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex to reduce token costs
Automation scripts or CI pipelines that generate large command outputs and feed LLMs, optimizing context
Rust enthusiasts interested in building high-performance system-level CLIs

zh.tag: 统一指标、日志、追踪的云原生可观测性数据库
zh.what: GreptimeDB 是一个开源的云原生可观测性数据库，使用单一列式引擎统一处理指标、日志和追踪数据。它专为在对象存储上运行而设计，提供高吞吐、低成本的存储方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的数据库实现，包括查询引擎、存储引擎、分布式协调等，并提供 Docker 镜像、Helm 图表和客户端库。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Apache Arrow、DataFusion 和 object store 等生态，支持多种对象存储后端。
zh.hot: 随着可观测性数据量激增，开发者寻求统一且成本效益高的解决方案，GreptimeDB 凭借其创新架构和活跃社区迅速获得关注，star 数已超 6.6k。
uses: 适用于需要统一管理指标、日志和追踪的 DevOps 和 SRE 团队，降低基础设施成本。
适合在云环境中构建可观测性平台，利用对象存储实现弹性扩展和低延迟查询。
对 Rust 和数据库内核感兴趣的开发者可参与贡献，学习分布式系统设计。

en.tag: Unified cloud-native observability database for metrics, logs, and traces
en.what: GreptimeDB is an open-source cloud-native observability database that unifies metrics, logs, and traces in a single columnar engine. It is designed to run on object storage, offering high throughput and low-cost storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full database implementation, including query engine, storage engine, and distributed coordination, along with Docker images, Helm charts, and client libraries.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging Apache Arrow, DataFusion, and object store ecosystem, supporting various object storage backends.
en.hot: With the explosion of observability data, developers seek unified and cost-effective solutions, and GreptimeDB's innovative architecture and active community have driven its popularity, surpassing 6.6k stars.
uses: Ideal for DevOps and SRE teams needing to unify metrics, logs, and traces to reduce infrastructure costs.
Suitable for building observability platforms in the cloud, leveraging object storage for elastic scaling and low-latency queries.
Great for developers interested in Rust and database internals to contribute and learn distributed system design.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码代理像队友一样协作的开源工作台
zh.what: Multica 是一个开源、可自托管的工作空间，让你像分配任务给队友一样，把工作分配给 AI 编码代理。代理可以自主领取 issue、报告进度、提出阻塞问题，并交回人工审查，所有上下文和决策都关联到同一 issue，确保人类掌控最终交付。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心服务（Go 编写）、Web 应用（apps/docs 等）、文档和示例，支持 26 种代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Kimi），提供看板视图、团队（Squads）、技能（Skills）等功能。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 构建后端，前端可能涉及 TypeScript/React（基于 apps/docs 推测），支持自托管，兼容多种代理 CLI 和运行时。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理普及，开发者急需统一管理多个代理的工具。Multica 提供类似 Trello 的看板来协调代理与人类，上线即获 4.8 万 star，日增 118，登上 Go 语言趋势榜第二。
uses: 开发团队：需要同时管理多个 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）并保持上下文一致性的场景。
技术管理者：希望将 AI 代理纳入现有工作流，像管理人类成员一样分配任务和审查结果。
自托管用户：对数据隐私敏感，希望将代理协作平台部署在自己服务器上的团队或个人。

en.tag: Open-source workspace to manage AI coding agents as teammates
en.what: Multica is an open-source, self-hostable workspace where you assign work to AI coding agents just like you would to a teammate. Agents pick up issues, report progress, raise blockers, and hand back results for review, with all context and decisions tied to the same issue, ensuring human oversight.
en.content: The repo includes a Go-based core service, web apps (apps/docs, etc.), documentation, and examples. It supports 26 agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi, etc.) and features a board view, squads, and skills.
en.stack: Backend built primarily in Go; frontend likely TypeScript/React (inferred from apps/docs). Supports self-hosting and integrates with multiple agent CLIs and runtimes.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need a unified way to manage multiple agents. Multica offers a Trello-like board to coordinate agents and humans, quickly gaining 48.9k stars (118 daily) and ranking #2 on GitHub Trending for Go.
uses: Development teams needing to manage multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) with consistent context.
Tech leads who want to integrate AI agents into existing workflows, assigning tasks and reviewing outputs like human teammates.
Self-hosting enthusiasts who prefer to deploy collaboration platforms on their own infrastructure for data privacy.

zh.tag: 开源基础设施即代码工具，Terraform 的替代品
zh.what: OpenTofu 是一个开源工具，用于安全高效地构建、变更和版本化管理基础设施。它支持声明式配置，可管理现有主流服务提供商及自定义内部解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenTofu 的源代码、文档、贡献指南和社区会议信息。核心功能包括基础设施即代码、执行计划、资源图和变更自动化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖云服务商 API 和基础设施资源。
zh.hot: 作为 Terraform 的替代品，OpenTofu 在开源社区备受关注，拥有超过 3 万 star，今日新增 27 个，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第三。
uses: 云基础设施工程师：使用声明式配置管理多云环境，实现基础设施即代码。
DevOps 团队：通过执行计划和资源图自动化变更，减少人为错误。
寻求 Terraform 替代方案的组织：希望使用开源、社区驱动的 IaC 工具。

en.tag: Open-source Infrastructure as Code tool, a Terraform alternative
en.what: OpenTofu is an open-source tool for building, changing, and versioning infrastructure safely and efficiently. It uses declarative configuration to manage existing popular service providers as well as custom in-house solutions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, contribution guide, and community meeting info. Key features include Infrastructure as Code, execution plans, resource graph, and change automation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on cloud provider APIs and infrastructure resources.
en.hot: As a Terraform alternative, OpenTofu gains significant attention in the open-source community, with over 30k stars and 27 new stars today, ranking #3 on the Go trending list.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers: manage multi-cloud environments with declarative config, enabling IaC.
DevOps teams: automate changes with execution plans and resource graphs to reduce human errors.
Organizations seeking a Terraform alternative: prefer an open-source, community-driven IaC tool.

zh.tag: 自托管 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 管理面板与 AI 网关可观测性仪表盘
zh.what: 这是一个自托管的 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 管理面板，提供 AI 网关的可观测性仪表盘，用于监控请求、用量、成本、配额、失败和账户健康。它支持管理提供商、凭证、OAuth、插件和配置，并将请求历史、成本分析和账户自动化数据存储在本地。
zh.content: 仓库包含仪表盘、请求监控、用量分析、凭证管理和健康检查等界面，以及文档和 Docker 部署配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持 Docker 部署，前端可能使用 Web 技术构建。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 日榜上排名第六，拥有 3033 颗星，因其解决了 AI 网关管理中的关键痛点，如成本追踪和账户健康监控，受到开发者关注。
uses: 适用于使用 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 的开发者，需要监控 AI 请求成本和配额。
适合管理多个 AI 提供商凭证和账户健康的管理员。
用于需要本地存储请求历史和成本分析的企业或团队。

en.tag: Self-hosted CPA/CLIProxyAPI management panel and AI gateway observability dashboard
en.what: It is a self-hosted management panel for CPA/CLIProxyAPI, offering an AI gateway observability dashboard for requests, usage, cost, quota, failures, and account health. It manages providers, credentials, OAuth, plugins, and configuration while keeping persistent request history, cost analytics, and account automation in local storage.
en.content: The repository includes dashboard, request monitoring, usage analytics, credential management, and health inspection interfaces, along with documentation and Docker deployment configuration.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports Docker deployment, and the frontend is likely built with web technologies.
en.hot: Ranked 6th on GitHub Trending with 3033 stars, it gained attention for addressing key pain points in AI gateway management, such as cost tracking and account health monitoring.
uses: For developers using CPA/CLIProxyAPI who need to monitor AI request costs and quotas.
For administrators managing multiple AI provider credentials and account health.
For enterprises or teams requiring local storage of request history and cost analytics.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供持久记忆的 Go 二进制工具
zh.what: Engram 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的持久记忆系统，解决代理在会话结束后丢失记忆的问题。它提供本地或云端的统一记忆存储，支持多种交互方式，使代理能够跨会话保持上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心二进制文件，集成 SQLite 与 FTS5 全文搜索，并提供 CLI、HTTP API、MCP 服务器和 TUI 等多种访问方式。还包含文档、插件系统及云服务相关代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 SQLite 数据库和 FTS5 全文搜索模块，支持 MCP（模型上下文协议），提供多种接口。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，持久记忆成为刚需，Engram 以单一二进制、零依赖和代理无关的设计迅速获得关注，star 数已达 6325。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者：为代理集成持久记忆，提升跨会话任务连续性。
团队协作场景：共享记忆库，实现团队知识沉淀与复用。
本地优先用户：通过 SQLite 本地存储，保护隐私且无需云服务。

en.tag: Persistent memory system for AI coding agents, single Go binary
en.what: Engram is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents, addressing the issue of agents losing memory after sessions. It offers unified memory storage locally or in the cloud, with multiple interfaces for agents to maintain context across sessions.
en.content: The repository contains a Go binary with SQLite and FTS5 full-text search, exposing CLI, HTTP API, MCP server, and TUI. It also includes documentation, plugin system, and cloud service code.
en.stack: Primarily Go, leveraging SQLite with FTS5 for full-text search, supporting MCP (Model Context Protocol), and offering multiple interfaces.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, persistent memory becomes essential. Engram's single-binary, zero-dependency, agent-agnostic design has quickly gained traction, reaching 6325 stars.
uses: AI coding agent developers: integrate persistent memory to improve cross-session task continuity.
Team collaboration: share memory stores for knowledge accumulation and reuse.
Local-first users: leverage SQLite local storage for privacy without cloud dependency.

zh.tag: Datadog 官方采集代理，监控与可观测性核心组件
zh.what: Datadog Agent 是 Datadog 的官方采集代理，负责从主机、容器和云环境中收集指标、日志和追踪数据，并发送到 Datadog 平台。它支持版本 6 和 7，提供预打包二进制文件，便于安装和部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Agent 的完整源代码，包括核心进程、检查器（checks）、日志收集、追踪、进程监控、网络性能监控（NPM）等模块，以及文档和开发指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，部分 BPF 代码使用 C（GPL 许可）。依赖多种库和工具，如 gRPC、protobuf 等。
zh.hot: Datadog 是领先的可观测性平台，其 Agent 是核心组件，持续更新和维护。虽然今日新增 star 为 0，但总星数 3715 表明其长期受关注，且进入 Go 语言日榜第 6 名。
uses: 需要部署 Datadog 监控的运维和开发人员，用于收集主机和容器指标。
希望扩展或定制 Agent 功能的开发者，可参考文档和源码进行二次开发。
对可观测性代理架构感兴趣的技术人员，可学习其设计模式和实现。

en.tag: Official Datadog Agent for monitoring and observability
en.what: The Datadog Agent is the official data collector for Datadog, gathering metrics, logs, and traces from hosts, containers, and cloud environments and sending them to the Datadog platform. It supports versions 6 and 7 and provides pre-packaged binaries for easy installation.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Agent, including core processes, checks, log collection, tracing, process monitoring, network performance monitoring (NPM), along with documentation and developer guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with some BPF code in C (GPL licensed). It relies on various libraries and tools such as gRPC, protobuf, etc.
en.hot: Datadog is a leading observability platform, and its Agent is a core component with continuous updates and maintenance. Although it gained 0 stars today, its total of 3715 stars shows long-term interest, and it ranks #6 on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Ops and developers deploying Datadog monitoring to collect host and container metrics.
Developers looking to extend or customize Agent features, using docs and source for secondary development.
Tech enthusiasts interested in observability agent architecture, learning design patterns and implementation.

zh.tag: 订阅转 API 的一站式网关，支持拼车共享
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，用于将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅配额统一转换为 API 接口，支持拼车共享以分摊成本，并允许原生工具无缝使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端、Vue 3 前端、PostgreSQL 数据库、Redis 缓存，并提供 Docker 部署支持。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Go 1.27、Vue 3.4+、PostgreSQL 15+、Redis 7+，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: Star 数突破 4 万，今日新增 130，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（Go）第 7 名，因其解决了订阅共享和 API 接入的痛点，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 希望将 AI 订阅配额共享给团队或朋友，降低使用成本的个人或组织。
需要统一管理多个 AI 服务 API 的开发者，实现无缝集成到现有工具。
对 AI 网关技术感兴趣，希望学习或二次开发的学习者和开发者。

en.tag: One-stop gateway converting AI subscriptions to unified APIs, supporting carpool sharing
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway platform that converts subscription quotas from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, etc., into unified APIs, supporting carpooling to share costs and enabling seamless use with native tools.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, Vue 3 frontend, PostgreSQL database, Redis cache, and Docker deployment support.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Go 1.27, Vue 3.4+, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+, with Docker support.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 130 new stars today, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending (Go), gaining popularity for addressing subscription sharing and API integration pain points.
uses: Individuals or organizations wanting to share AI subscription quotas with teams or friends to reduce costs.
Developers needing unified management of multiple AI service APIs for seamless integration into existing tools.
Learners and developers interested in AI gateway technology for study or further development.

zh.tag: 为编码代理提供持久化、结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个命令行工具，为 AI 编码代理提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图结构取代杂乱的 markdown 计划，使代理能够处理长期任务而不丢失上下文。它支持多代理协作，通过 Dolt 实现分布式同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具（bd），提供初始化、任务创建/认领/关闭等命令，以及针对 Codex、Claude Code 等代理的集成设置脚本。文档涵盖快速入门、代理设置和 IDE 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 Dolt（分布式 SQL 数据库）实现图存储和同步。提供 npm 和 PyPI 包，支持 MCP 集成。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理的普及，开发者需要更可靠的记忆机制。Beads 以 2.69 万星标迅速走红，今日新增 43 星，登上 Go 语言日榜，解决了代理丢失上下文的痛点。
uses: 使用 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望提升代理在复杂项目中的任务执行能力。
需要多代理协作或跨机器同步任务状态的团队，利用分布式图追踪问题。
对 AI 代理工作流感兴趣的技术爱好者，想探索结构化记忆和依赖图管理。

en.tag: Distributed graph issue tracker giving coding agents persistent, structured memory
en.what: Beads is a CLI tool that provides persistent, structured memory for AI coding agents. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, enabling agents to handle long-horizon tasks without losing context. It supports multi-agent collaboration with distributed sync via Dolt.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based CLI tool (bd) with commands for init, task creation/claim/close, and setup scripts for agents like Codex and Claude Code. Docs cover quickstart, agent setup, and IDE integrations.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed SQL database) for graph storage and sync. Offers npm and PyPI packages, with MCP support.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need more reliable memory mechanisms. Beads quickly gained 26.9k stars, adding 43 today, and hit the Go daily trending list by solving the pain point of agents losing context.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code who want to improve agent performance on complex tasks.
Teams needing multi-agent collaboration or cross-machine task sync, using distributed graph issue tracking.
Tech enthusiasts interested in AI agent workflows, exploring structured memory and dependency graph management.

zh.tag: 无代码构建云原生控制平面的框架
zh.what: Crossplane 是一个用于构建云原生控制平面的开源框架，允许用户通过声明式 API 编排应用和基础设施，而无需编写代码。它提供高度可扩展的后端和高度可配置的前端，支持跨环境统一管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Crossplane 核心代码、文档、发布说明和路线图，支持多种版本（如 v1.20 至 v2.7），并提供 Helm 安装包和 Artifact Hub 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes 和 CNCF 生态，集成 OpenSSF 最佳实践、CI 工作流和 Go Report Card 等工具。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 项目，Crossplane 在云原生领域备受关注，12k+ Stars 表明其广泛采用，今日新增 10 星并登上 Go 趋势榜，持续吸引开发者。
uses: 平台工程师：构建内部开发者平台（IDP），统一管理多云基础设施。
DevOps 团队：通过声明式 API 实现基础设施即代码，减少手工操作。
云原生爱好者：学习控制平面架构和 Kubernetes 扩展机制。

en.tag: Framework for building cloud native control planes without writing code
en.what: Crossplane is an open-source framework for building cloud native control planes, enabling users to orchestrate applications and infrastructure via declarative APIs without writing code. It features a highly extensible backend and a configurable frontend, allowing unified management across environments.
en.content: The repository contains Crossplane core code, documentation, release notes, and roadmap, supporting multiple versions (e.g., v1.20 to v2.7), with Helm packages and Artifact Hub integration.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging Kubernetes and CNCF ecosystem, with integrations for OpenSSF best practices, CI workflows, and Go Report Card.
en.hot: As a CNCF project, Crossplane gains significant attention in cloud native, with 12k+ stars indicating wide adoption; today's +10 stars and Go trending list placement show ongoing developer interest.
uses: Platform engineers: build internal developer platforms (IDPs) to manage multi-cloud infrastructure uniformly.
DevOps teams: implement infrastructure as code via declarative APIs, reducing manual operations.
Cloud native enthusiasts: learn control plane architecture and Kubernetes extension mechanisms.

zh.tag: 基于 eBPF 的网络、安全与可观测性平台
zh.what: Cilium 是一个基于 eBPF 的开源项目，为 Kubernetes 等容器环境提供网络连接、安全策略和可观测性。它利用 eBPF 技术在内核中动态注入字节码，实现高性能的数据路径，并支持跨集群网络、负载均衡、服务网格等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cilium 的完整源代码、文档、示例和构建脚本。主要组件包括代理（Agent）、运维工具（CLI）、以及用于网络策略、负载均衡和可观测性的 eBPF 程序。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux 内核的 eBPF 特性，并集成 Kubernetes、Envoy（用于服务网格）等生态。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Cilium 已成为云原生网络的事实标准，star 数持续增长。其 eBPF 技术带来的高性能和安全性备受关注，尤其在服务网格和可观测性领域。
uses: Kubernetes 集群管理员：用于提供高性能网络、安全策略和可观测性，替代 kube-proxy。
平台工程师：构建跨集群网络和服务网格，实现统一的网络与安全管控。
安全团队：利用基于身份的安全模型和 L7 策略，实现细粒度的访问控制。
开发者：在开发环境中使用 Cilium 进行本地测试和调试，体验 eBPF 带来的性能优势。

en.tag: eBPF-based networking, security, and observability platform
en.what: Cilium is an open-source project that provides networking, security, and observability for container environments like Kubernetes. Leveraging eBPF, it dynamically inserts bytecode into the Linux kernel for a high-performance data path, supporting multi-cluster networking, load balancing, service mesh, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build scripts for Cilium. Key components include the agent, CLI tools, and eBPF programs for network policy, load balancing, and observability.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it relies on Linux kernel eBPF features and integrates with Kubernetes, Envoy (for service mesh), and other ecosystem tools.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, Cilium has become a de facto standard for cloud-native networking, with steady star growth. Its eBPF-based performance and security attract attention, especially in service mesh and observability.
uses: Kubernetes cluster admins: for high-performance networking, security policies, and observability, replacing kube-proxy.
Platform engineers: to build multi-cluster networks and service mesh with unified network and security controls.
Security teams: to enforce fine-grained access control with identity-based security and L7 policies.
Developers: to test and debug locally with Cilium, experiencing the performance benefits of eBPF.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的即时、并发、安全、轻量级沙箱服务
zh.what: CubeSandbox 是一个高性能的沙箱服务，基于 RustVMM 和 KVM 构建，为 AI 代理提供硬件级隔离的运行环境。它能在 60 毫秒内创建沙箱，内存开销小于 5MB，支持单节点部署和轻松扩展到多节点集群。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的沙箱服务实现，包括 RustVMM 和 KVM 集成、E2B 兼容的 API、Python SDK（PyPI 包）、文档、快速入门指南和变更日志。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 RustVMM 和 KVM 实现硬件级虚拟化。提供 Python SDK，兼容 E2B SDK。
zh.hot: 凭借极快的启动速度（60ms）和极低的内存开销（<5MB），以及 E2B 兼容性，迅速获得开发者关注，GitHub 日榜 Go 语言第 2 名，star 数已超 1.1 万。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要安全、隔离的环境来执行代码或运行工具，确保代理行为可控。
平台工程师：构建多租户沙箱服务，用于代码执行、数据处理或安全测试。
教育场景：为学生提供安全的编程练习环境，避免影响宿主机。

en.tag: Instant, concurrent, secure & lightweight sandbox service for AI agents
en.what: CubeSandbox is a high-performance sandbox service built on RustVMM and KVM, providing hardware-isolated runtime environments for AI agents. It can create a sandbox in under 60ms with less than 5MB memory overhead, supporting single-node deployment and easy scaling to multi-node clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the full sandbox service implementation, including RustVMM and KVM integration, E2B-compatible API, Python SDK (PyPI package), documentation, quickstart guide, and changelog.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging RustVMM and KVM for hardware-level virtualization. Provides a Python SDK and is compatible with the E2B SDK.
en.hot: With ultra-fast startup (60ms) and low memory overhead (<5MB), plus E2B compatibility, it quickly gained developer attention, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending for Go and amassing over 11k stars.
uses: AI agent developers: need secure, isolated environments to execute code or run tools, ensuring agent behavior is controlled.
Platform engineers: build multi-tenant sandbox services for code execution, data processing, or security testing.
Educational scenarios: provide students with safe programming practice environments without affecting the host machine.

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

zh.tag: E2B Cloud 的云基础设施，支撑 AI 代码解释环境
zh.what: 这是 E2B 平台背后的基础设施代码库，用于在云端运行 AI 代码解释环境。它提供了自托管指南，支持在 GCP 和 AWS 上部署，使开发者能够自主搭建类似 E2B 的 AI 代理运行环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Terraform 部署脚本、自托管指南（self-host.md）和贡献指南（CONTRIBUTING.md），以及相关的配置文件和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，基础设施即代码采用 Terraform，支持多云部署（GCP、AWS）。
zh.hot: 虽然今日新增 0 星，但作为 E2B 的核心基础设施，它吸引了关注 AI 代码解释和自托管基础设施的开发者，在 Go 趋势榜上排名第 14。
uses: 想要自托管 AI 代码解释环境的开发者，可参考此仓库部署基础设施。
对 E2B 平台架构感兴趣，希望了解其底层实现的技术人员。
需要在 GCP 或 AWS 上搭建类似 AI 代理运行环境的团队。

en.tag: Cloud infrastructure powering E2B Cloud for AI code interpreting
en.what: This repository contains the infrastructure that powers the E2B platform, enabling cloud-based AI code interpreting environments. It includes self-hosting guides and Terraform configurations for deploying on GCP and AWS, allowing developers to run AI agents in their own cloud.
en.content: The repository includes Terraform deployment scripts, a self-hosting guide (self-host.md), a contributing guide (CONTRIBUTING.md), and associated configuration files and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with infrastructure as code using Terraform, supporting multi-cloud deployment on GCP and AWS.
en.hot: Despite zero stars today, it ranks #14 on the Go trending list, attracting developers interested in AI code interpreting and self-hosted infrastructure as the core of E2B.
uses: Developers who want to self-host AI code interpreting environments can use this repo to deploy infrastructure.
Technicians interested in the architecture of E2B platform and its underlying implementation.
Teams needing to set up similar AI agent runtime environments on GCP or AWS.

zh.tag: 功能丰富的交互式 Jira 命令行工具
zh.what: JiraCLI 是一个用于 Atlassian Jira 的交互式命令行工具，旨在帮助用户在一定程度上避免使用 Jira 的网页界面。它提供了日常 Jira 工作流所需的核心功能，如问题搜索、导航、创建、克隆、链接和状态转换等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、演示 GIF、文档和 CI 配置，支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Jira REST API，并可能使用 Cobra 等 CLI 库。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub CLI 的灵感产物，它填补了 Jira 命令行交互的空白，star 数达 5945，今日新增 3，位列 Go 趋势榜第 15 名。
uses: 开发者或项目经理希望通过终端快速查询和操作 Jira 任务，避免频繁切换浏览器。
喜欢命令行工作流、追求效率的工程师，希望将 Jira 操作集成到脚本或自动化中。
团队希望统一 Jira 操作方式，减少对 Web UI 的依赖，提升日常任务处理速度。

en.tag: Feature-rich interactive Jira command line tool
en.what: JiraCLI is an interactive command line tool for Atlassian Jira that helps users avoid using the Jira UI to some extent. It provides essential features for daily Jira workflows, including issue search, navigation, creation, cloning, linking, and transitions.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, demo GIFs, documentation, and CI configuration, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the Jira REST API, and likely using CLI libraries such as Cobra.
en.hot: Inspired by GitHub CLI, it fills the gap for Jira command-line interaction, with 5945 stars and 3 new stars today, ranking 15th on the Go trending list.
uses: Developers or project managers who want to quickly query and manipulate Jira issues from the terminal, avoiding frequent browser switches.
Engineers who prefer command-line workflows and seek efficiency, wanting to integrate Jira operations into scripts or automation.
Teams aiming to standardize Jira interactions, reduce reliance on the web UI, and speed up daily task handling.

zh.tag: 无守护进程的容器与 Pod 管理工具
zh.what: Podman 是一个用于管理 OCI 容器、镜像、卷和 Pod 的工具，基于 libpod 库实现容器生命周期管理。它支持 Linux，并可通过虚拟机在 Mac 和 Windows 上使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Podman 命令行工具和 libpod 库，提供容器、Pod、镜像和卷的管理 API。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 OCI 标准和容器运行时（如 runc），支持多种镜像格式。
zh.hot: 作为 Docker 的无守护进程替代方案，Podman 在开发者中持续流行，拥有 3.2 万星标，今日新增 7 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 16 名。
uses: 系统管理员：在无需守护进程的环境中安全运行容器，增强系统稳定性。
开发人员：在本地开发时使用 Podman 管理容器和 Pod，与 Docker 命令兼容。
DevOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 流程中利用 Podman 的无根模式提升安全性。

en.tag: Daemonless container and pod management tool
en.what: Podman is a tool for managing OCI containers, images, volumes, and pods, built on the libpod library for container lifecycle management. It runs on Linux and can be used on Mac and Windows via a Podman-managed virtual machine.
en.content: The repository contains the Podman CLI and the libpod library, offering APIs for managing containers, pods, images, and volumes.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, relying on OCI standards and container runtimes (e.g., runc), supporting multiple image formats.
en.hot: As a daemonless alternative to Docker, Podman remains popular among developers, with 32.7k stars and 7 new stars today, ranking 16th on the Go trending list.
uses: System administrators: run containers securely without a daemon, enhancing system stability.
Developers: use Podman locally to manage containers and pods, compatible with Docker commands.
DevOps engineers: leverage Podman's rootless mode in CI/CD pipelines for improved security.

zh.tag: 生产级、厂商中立、纯 OCI 规范的容器镜像仓库
zh.what: zot 是一个基于 OCI 分发规范实现的可水平扩展的容器镜像与制品仓库，完全遵循 OCI 镜像格式与线上协议。它旨在提供生产环境可用的、厂商中立的替代方案，支持大规模部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 zot 的完整源代码、文档（位于 zotregistry.dev）、构建与测试配置（GitHub Actions）、OCI 一致性测试、代码覆盖率报告以及安全相关的配置（CodeQL、OpenSSF Scorecard 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 OCI 镜像规范与分发规范，可能使用分布式存储后端（如 S3、MinIO 等）实现可扩展性。
zh.hot: 随着容器与 OCI 生态的普及，对厂商中立、生产级镜像仓库的需求增长。zot 以纯 OCI 实现和可扩展性吸引开发者，今日新增 15 星，总星数 2705，登上 Go 趋势榜。
uses: 需要自托管容器镜像仓库的运维团队，希望避免厂商锁定并降低成本。
对 OCI 规范有严格合规要求的企业，需要经过一致性测试的 registry。
大规模 Kubernetes 集群的镜像分发场景，需要高可用、可扩展的存储后端。
开发者或研究者希望深入理解 OCI 分发规范的参考实现。

en.tag: Production-ready, vendor-neutral, OCI-native container image/artifact registry
en.what: zot is a scale-out, production-ready container image and artifact registry built purely on the OCI Distribution Specification. It stores images in OCI image format and speaks the OCI distribution protocol on the wire, offering a vendor-neutral alternative for large-scale deployments.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of zot, documentation (hosted at zotregistry.dev), CI/CD configurations (GitHub Actions), OCI conformance tests, code coverage reports, and security-related configurations (CodeQL, OpenSSF Scorecard, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on the OCI image and distribution specifications, likely leveraging distributed storage backends (e.g., S3, MinIO) for scalability.
en.hot: As container and OCI ecosystems grow, demand for vendor-neutral, production-grade registries rises. zot attracts developers with its pure OCI implementation and scalability, gaining 15 stars today (total 2705) and trending on the Go daily list.
uses: Ops teams needing a self-hosted container registry to avoid vendor lock-in and reduce costs.
Enterprises with strict OCI compliance requirements needing a conformance-tested registry.
Large-scale Kubernetes clusters requiring a highly available, scalable image distribution backend.
Developers or researchers seeking a reference implementation to understand the OCI distribution spec.

zh.tag: 全能开源安全扫描器，覆盖容器、K8s、代码与云
zh.what: Trivy 是一款多功能安全扫描器，可检测容器镜像、文件系统、Git 仓库、虚拟机镜像和 Kubernetes 中的漏洞、错误配置、密钥、SBOM 及许可证问题。它支持多种编程语言、操作系统和平台，提供全面的安全覆盖。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Trivy 的源代码、文档、示例和集成指南。核心功能通过命令行工具提供，支持多种扫描目标和扫描器，并集成了 GitHub Actions、Kubernetes Operator 和 VS Code 插件等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种开源库实现扫描功能。支持广泛的生态集成，如容器运行时、Kubernetes 和主流 CI/CD 平台。
zh.hot: Trivy 因其全面性和易用性广受欢迎，拥有 37.8k 星标，今日新增 19 星。作为安全扫描领域的领先工具，它持续吸引开发者和安全团队关注，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 18。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中集成 Trivy，自动扫描容器镜像和代码仓库的安全问题。
安全团队使用 Trivy 对 Kubernetes 集群和云环境进行持续安全监控和合规检查。
DevOps 工程师利用 Trivy 生成 SBOM 和许可证报告，辅助软件供应链管理。

en.tag: Comprehensive open-source security scanner for containers, K8s, code, and cloud
en.what: Trivy is a comprehensive security scanner that detects vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, SBOM, and license issues across container images, filesystems, Git repos, VM images, and Kubernetes. It supports a wide range of languages, OSes, and platforms for thorough security coverage.
en.content: The repository contains Trivy's source code, documentation, examples, and integration guides. The core functionality is provided via a CLI tool supporting multiple targets and scanners, with integrations for GitHub Actions, Kubernetes Operator, and VS Code plugin.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various open-source libraries for scanning capabilities. It integrates with a broad ecosystem including container runtimes, Kubernetes, and popular CI/CD platforms.
en.hot: Trivy is popular for its comprehensiveness and ease of use, with 37.8k stars and 19 new stars today. As a leading security scanner, it consistently attracts developers and security teams, ranking #18 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily.
uses: Developers integrate Trivy into CI/CD pipelines to automatically scan container images and code repos for security issues.
Security teams use Trivy for continuous monitoring and compliance checks on Kubernetes clusters and cloud environments.
DevOps engineers leverage Trivy to generate SBOM and license reports for software supply chain management.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上自动扩缩容的 GitHub Actions 自托管运行器控制器
zh.what: ARC 是一个 Kubernetes 操作器，用于编排和扩缩容 GitHub Actions 的自托管运行器。它允许创建运行器规模集，根据仓库、组织或企业中运行的工作流数量自动调整规模。由于受控运行器可以是基于容器的临时实例，因此可以快速、干净地上下扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ARC 的源代码、Helm 图表、文档和示例，用于在 Kubernetes 上部署和管理运行器规模集。它由 GitHub Actions 团队与外部维护者共同开发，并欢迎社区贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，基于 Kubernetes Operator 模式，利用 Helm 进行部署。依赖 GitHub Actions 的 API 和 Kubernetes 的自动扩缩容机制。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计 6481 星，位列 Go 语言日榜第 19，说明其作为官方推荐的自托管运行器解决方案持续受到关注。
uses: 需要在 Kubernetes 上运行 GitHub Actions 的团队，可以自动扩缩容以节省成本。
想要利用容器化运行器实现快速、隔离的 CI/CD 环境的开发者。
管理大规模 GitHub Actions 工作流的企业，需要集中控制和弹性资源。

en.tag: Kubernetes operator for autoscaling GitHub Actions self-hosted runners
en.what: ARC is a Kubernetes operator that orchestrates and scales self-hosted runners for GitHub Actions. It enables creating runner scale sets that automatically scale based on the number of workflows running in your repository, organization, or enterprise. Because controlled runners can be ephemeral and container-based, new instances can scale up or down rapidly and cleanly.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, Helm charts, documentation, and examples for deploying and managing runner scale sets on Kubernetes. It is developed in collaboration with the GitHub Actions team and external maintainers, with community contributions welcome.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on the Kubernetes Operator pattern, deployed via Helm. It leverages GitHub Actions APIs and Kubernetes autoscaling mechanisms.
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars, the cumulative 6481 stars and ranking 19th on the Go daily trending list indicate sustained interest as an official solution for self-hosted runners.
uses: Teams running GitHub Actions on Kubernetes, benefiting from autoscaling to reduce costs.
Developers wanting fast, isolated CI/CD environments using containerized runners.
Enterprises managing large-scale GitHub Actions workflows needing centralized control and elastic resources.

zh.tag: 在终端和AI代理中管理HEY邮箱与日历的CLI/TUI工具
zh.what: HEY CLI 是一个命令行界面和终端应用，让你在终端中管理 HEY 邮箱、日历、联系人和日记。它支持实时同步，并能为编码代理提供访问 HEY 数据的接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用 Go 编写的 CLI 和 TUI 应用，提供邮件、联系人、日历和日记功能，支持键盘快捷键、实时更新，并可通过管道输出 JSON 数据。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 HEY 的 API，支持通过 mise、Homebrew、Scoop、Nix 等多种方式安装。
zh.hot: 作为 HEY 官方推出的 CLI 工具，它填补了在终端和 AI 代理中高效处理邮件的需求，上线首日即获 330 星，日增 47 星，进入 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 适合喜欢在终端中高效处理邮件的开发者，无需离开命令行即可收发邮件。
适用于希望将邮件和日历集成到 AI 编码代理工作流中的开发者。
适合需要自动化邮件操作（如搜索、回复、查看线程）的脚本编写者。

en.tag: A CLI and TUI for HEY email and calendar, bringing your inbox to the terminal and coding agents.
en.what: HEY CLI is a command-line interface and terminal app that lets you manage HEY email, calendar, contacts, and journal from your terminal. It supports live syncing and provides an interface for coding agents to access HEY data.
en.content: The repository contains a CLI and TUI application written in Go, offering mail, contacts, calendar, and journal features with keyboard shortcuts, live updates, and JSON output for piping.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, leveraging HEY's API, and installable via mise, Homebrew, Scoop, Nix, and more.
en.hot: As HEY's official CLI, it fills the need for terminal and AI-agent email management, gaining 330 stars on day one with 47 new stars, trending on GitHub.
uses: Developers who prefer terminal-based email management and want to handle messages without leaving the command line.
Developers integrating email and calendar into AI coding agent workflows.
Scripters needing to automate email operations like searching, replying, and viewing threads.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 模型网关与资产管理平台
zh.what: New API 是一个集中式 AI 模型网关，支持将多种 LLM 统一转换为 OpenAI、Claude 或 Gemini 兼容格式，便于聚合与分发。它提供个人和企业级模型管理、认证、用量统计与成本核算，并支持私有化部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web 前端（基于 React 等）、Docker 部署配置、多语言 README（中英法日等）以及详细的文档和快速入门指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能采用 React 等现代框架，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，并集成多种 LLM API 协议转换。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.5k 星标和日增 115 星，New API 成为 AI 基础设施的热门选择，因其解决了多模型统一接入的痛点，并支持私有化部署，深受开发者和企业青睐。
uses: 开发者：需要统一管理多个 LLM API 密钥和调用格式的开发者
企业：希望构建内部 AI 网关，实现成本控制和审计的企业
自托管用户：偏好私有化部署，避免依赖第三方服务的用户
AI 应用团队：需要将不同模型快速集成到现有应用中的团队

en.tag: Unified AI model gateway and asset management platform
en.what: New API is a centralized AI model gateway that aggregates and distributes various LLMs by converting them into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It offers personal and enterprise-grade model management, authentication, usage analytics, cost accounting, and supports private deployment.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based backend service, a web frontend (e.g., React), Docker deployment configurations, multilingual READMEs (Chinese, English, French, Japanese, etc.), and comprehensive documentation and quick-start guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a modern frontend framework like React, containerized via Docker, and integrates protocol conversion for various LLM APIs.
en.hot: With 45.5k stars and 115 new stars today, New API is a popular choice for AI infrastructure, solving the pain point of unified multi-model access and supporting private deployment, which appeals to developers and enterprises.
uses: Developers: those needing to manage multiple LLM API keys and formats in one place
Enterprises: seeking an internal AI gateway for cost control and auditing
Self-hosters: users preferring private deployment to avoid third-party dependencies
AI application teams: teams needing to quickly integrate various models into existing apps

zh.tag: Kubernetes 事件驱动自动扩缩容组件
zh.what: KEDA 是一个基于 Kubernetes 的事件驱动自动扩缩容组件，允许根据事件（如消息队列长度、请求数等）对容器进行精细的自动扩缩容，甚至支持缩容到零。它作为 Kubernetes 的 Metrics Server，通过自定义资源定义（CRD）让用户定义扩缩容规则，并与 Horizontal Pod Autoscaler 原生集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 KEDA 的核心代码、部署清单、文档、社区治理文件以及测试策略等。主要目录包括控制器、指标服务器、适配器、文档等，支持多种事件源（如 RabbitMQ、Kafka 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API、Horizontal Pod Autoscaler、Prometheus 等云原生技术，并支持 Helm 部署。
zh.hot: KEDA 是 CNCF 毕业项目，拥有超过 1 万 star，今日新增 5 个，在 GitHub 趋势榜上持续活跃。其事件驱动扩缩容能力在云原生领域需求旺盛，尤其适合处理突发流量和节省成本。
uses: 适合需要根据消息队列、数据库、HTTP 请求等事件自动扩缩容的 Kubernetes 集群运维人员。
适用于希望实现缩容到零以节省资源成本的云原生应用开发者。
适合构建事件驱动架构、需要与 Knative 等集成实现 Serverless 体验的团队。

en.tag: Kubernetes-based Event Driven Autoscaling component
en.what: KEDA is a Kubernetes-based Event Driven Autoscaling component that enables fine-grained autoscaling (including to/from zero) for event-driven Kubernetes workloads. It acts as a Kubernetes Metrics Server and allows users to define autoscaling rules via a dedicated custom resource definition, integrating natively with the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler.
en.content: The repository contains the core KEDA code, deployment manifests, documentation, community governance files, and testing strategy. Key directories include controller, metrics server, adapter, and docs, supporting various event sources like RabbitMQ and Kafka.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes APIs, Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, and Prometheus, with Helm chart support for deployment.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project with over 10k stars and 5 new stars today, KEDA remains active on the GitHub trending list. Its event-driven autoscaling capability is in high demand in the cloud-native space, especially for handling burst traffic and cost savings.
uses: Ideal for Kubernetes operators needing autoscaling based on events like message queue length, database connections, or HTTP requests.
Useful for developers aiming to scale to zero to reduce resource costs in cloud-native applications.
Great for teams building event-driven architectures or integrating with Knative for a serverless experience.

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适合播客、音乐制作和音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑器、音频引擎、效果插件、UI 资源等。当前正在开发 Audacity 4，采用全新 UI 并进行大规模重构，同时保留 3.x 分支供维护。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets（UI）、PortAudio（音频 I/O）等库。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供针对不同平台的构建脚本。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音频工具，Audacity 长期拥有稳定用户群。近期因 Audacity 4 的 UI 重构和功能更新引发关注，今日新增 272 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。
uses: 播客制作者：录制和编辑多轨音频，添加效果和导出播客节目。
音乐爱好者：进行简单的录音、剪辑和混音，或修复老旧录音。
教育场景：用于音频教学、学生录音作业或声音实验。
音频修复：去除噪音、剪辑对话或恢复历史录音。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder
en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasting, music production, and audio restoration.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Audacity, including the core editor, audio engine, effects plugins, and UI resources. It is currently undergoing major structural change for Audacity 4, with a brand-new UI and refactorings, while maintaining the 3.x branch.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on wxWidgets for UI, PortAudio for audio I/O, and other libraries. The build system uses CMake, with platform-specific build scripts.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source audio tool, Audacity has a stable user base. Recent attention is driven by the UI overhaul and updates for Audacity 4, gaining 272 stars today and ranking #2 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Podcasters: record and edit multi-track audio, add effects, and export episodes.
Music enthusiasts: perform simple recording, editing, and mixing, or restore old recordings.
Educational settings: use for audio teaching, student recording assignments, or sound experiments.
Audio restoration: remove noise, edit dialogue, or recover historical recordings.

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个为现代 C++ 设计的 JSON 库，提供直观的 API，支持 JSON 的解析、序列化以及与 STL 容器的无缝集成。它旨在让 C++ 开发者能够像使用 Python 或 JavaScript 一样轻松地处理 JSON 数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含单一头文件 json.hpp，以及完整的文档、测试套件和示例代码。支持多种平台和编译器，并提供了在线演示和详细的 API 参考。
zh.stack: 纯 C++11 及以上实现，无外部依赖，使用 CMake 构建，支持跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）。
zh.hot: 因其易用性和高性能而广受欢迎，拥有超过 5 万 star，是 C++ 社区最常用的 JSON 库之一。今日新增 16 星，持续活跃。
uses: C++ 开发者需要在项目中快速集成 JSON 解析和生成功能
需要跨平台且无依赖的 JSON 库的嵌入式或桌面应用开发
希望简化 JSON 数据处理流程的软件工程师

en.tag: JSON parser and serializer for modern C++
en.what: A JSON library for modern C++ that provides an intuitive API for parsing, serializing, and integrating with STL containers. It aims to make JSON handling in C++ as easy as in Python or JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains a single header file json.hpp, along with comprehensive documentation, test suites, and examples. It supports multiple platforms and compilers, offering an online demo and detailed API reference.
en.stack: Implemented in pure C++11 or later with no external dependencies, built with CMake, and cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS).
en.hot: Popular for its ease of use and high performance, with over 50k stars, it is one of the most used JSON libraries in the C++ community. Gaining 16 stars today, it remains actively maintained.
uses: C++ developers needing to quickly integrate JSON parsing and generation in their projects
Embedded or desktop app development requiring a cross-platform, dependency-free JSON library
Software engineers looking to simplify JSON data handling in their code

zh.tag: Google 开源的 C++ 通用库，补充标准库
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 内部 C++ 代码库的开源版本，旨在补充 C++ 标准库的不足。它提供标准库缺失的组件，或针对特殊需求提供替代实现，并已在 Google 生产环境中广泛测试和使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个库组件，如 base、algorithm、cleanup、container 等，每个组件位于独立的子目录中，并附有构建配置和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 C++17 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，依赖 C++ 标准库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方开源库，拥有 18k+ stars，是 C++ 开发者的常用工具集，虽然今日新增不多，但长期稳定受欢迎。
uses: C++ 开发者需要标准库之外的实用工具时，可快速引入 Abseil 组件。
希望借鉴 Google 内部 C++ 最佳实践和代码风格的项目团队。
需要跨平台、高性能且经过生产验证的基础库的应用程序。

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries augmenting the standard library
en.what: Abseil is an open-source collection of C++ library code from Google's internal codebase, designed to augment the C++ standard library. It provides missing pieces or alternatives for special needs, extensively tested in production.
en.content: The repository contains multiple library components such as base, algorithm, cleanup, container, each in separate subdirectories with build configurations and documentation.
en.stack: Written in C++17, supports Bazel and CMake build systems, depends on the C++ standard library.
en.hot: As an official Google open-source library with 18k+ stars, it's a common toolkit for C++ developers. Although today's increment is small, it remains consistently popular.
uses: C++ developers needing utilities beyond the standard library can quickly adopt Abseil components.
Teams looking to follow Google's internal C++ best practices and coding style.
Applications requiring a cross-platform, high-performance, production-proven base library.

zh.tag: Tenstorrent AI 芯片的低层内核编程与神经网络算子库
zh.what: TT-Metal 是 Tenstorrent 面向其 AI 加速器的软件栈，包含 TT-NN（Python/C++ 神经网络算子库）和 TT-Metalium（低层内核编程模型）。它让开发者能够为 Tenstorrent 硬件编写高性能内核，并运行优化过的 LLM 等模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TT-NN 算子库、TT-Metalium 内核编程接口、模型演示（如 Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 2.5 7B）、安装指南和 API 文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，提供 Python 绑定；依赖硬件（如 Wormhole、Blackhole），并集成 vLLM 等推理服务器。
zh.hot: 尽管 star 数相对较低（1660），但作为 Tenstorrent 官方软件栈，它吸引了关注 AI 硬件和低层优化的开发者，今日新增 4 星并登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 为 Tenstorrent AI 加速器编写高性能内核的开发者
在 Tenstorrent 硬件上部署和优化 LLM 的 AI 工程师
研究神经网络算子实现和硬件协同设计的爱好者

en.tag: Low-level kernel programming model and NN operator library for Tenstorrent AI accelerators
en.what: TT-Metal is Tenstorrent's software stack for its AI accelerators, featuring TT-NN (a Python/C++ neural network operator library) and TT-Metalium (a low-level kernel programming model). It enables developers to write high-performance kernels for Tenstorrent hardware and run optimized models like LLMs.
en.content: The repository includes the TT-NN operator library, TT-Metalium kernel programming interface, model demos (e.g., Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5 7B), installation guide, and API documentation.
