en.stack: Primarily C++ with Python bindings; depends on Tenstorrent hardware (e.g., Wormhole, Blackhole) and integrates with inference servers like vLLM.
en.hot: Despite a relatively modest star count (1660), it's the official software stack for Tenstorrent hardware, attracting developers interested in AI accelerators and low-level optimization; it gained 4 stars today and hit the C++ trending list.
uses: Developers writing high-performance kernels for Tenstorrent AI accelerators
AI engineers deploying and optimizing LLMs on Tenstorrent hardware
Enthusiasts researching neural network operator implementation and hardware-software co-design

zh.tag: 轻量级进程内向量数据库，极速相似搜索
zh.what: Zvec 是一个开源的、嵌入式的向量数据库，专为低延迟和高性能设计，可直接集成到应用中。它已在阿里巴巴集团内部经过实战检验，提供生产级的相似性搜索能力，且部署简单。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 引擎、Python 和 Node.js 客户端库、文档、基准测试以及示例。最新版本引入了 zvec-grep 命令行工具和 ReMe 集成，支持 DiskANN 和索引优化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，提供 Python（3.10~3.14）和 npm 包，支持 Linux/macOS（含 ARM64），采用 io_uring 异步 I/O，集成 HNSW 和 IVF 索引算法。
zh.hot: 凭借阿里背书和极简部署，在 GitHub 上获得 15.7k 星，今日新增 97 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 10。其轻量级进程内设计契合 AI 代理和本地搜索需求。
uses: 开发者需要在应用中嵌入向量数据库，实现低延迟相似搜索，如推荐系统或语义缓存。
AI 代理开发者利用 zvec 作为记忆存储后端，支持 HNSW 近似最近邻搜索。
本地优先工具链用户通过 zvec-grep 统一关键词与向量搜索，提升工作区检索效率。
对性能敏感的场景，如大规模向量检索，需要生产级且易部署的解决方案。

en.tag: Lightweight in-process vector DB for lightning-fast similarity search
en.what: Zvec is an open-source, in-process vector database designed for low-latency, high-performance similarity search. It can be embedded directly into applications, and has been battle-tested within Alibaba Group for production-grade use.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ engine, Python and Node.js client libraries, documentation, benchmarks, and examples. The latest release adds zvec-grep CLI tool and ReMe integration, with DiskANN support and index optimizations.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, with Python (3.10~3.14) and npm packages, supporting Linux/macOS (incl. ARM64), using io_uring async I/O, integrating HNSW and IVF index algorithms.
en.hot: With Alibaba's backing and minimal setup, it has gained 15.7k stars on GitHub, +97 today, ranking #10 on the C++ trending list. Its lightweight in-process design suits AI agents and local search needs.
uses: Developers needing an embedded vector DB for low-latency similarity search in apps like recommendation or semantic cache.
AI agent developers using zvec as a memory backend with HNSW ANN search.
Local-first toolchain users leveraging zvec-grep to unify keyword and vector search for workspace retrieval.
Performance-sensitive scenarios requiring production-grade, easy-to-deploy vector search.

zh.tag: Google 跨语言数据序列化标准
zh.what: Protocol Buffers（protobuf）是 Google 开发的语言中立、平台中立、可扩展的结构化数据序列化机制，用于高效编码和交换数据。它通过 .proto 文件定义数据结构，并生成多种语言的代码，广泛应用于 RPC 系统和数据存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 protobuf 的完整实现，包括 C++ 编写的编译器（protoc）、各语言运行时库（如 C++、Java、Python、Go 等）、测试和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写编译器，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，并依赖多种语言运行时。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，protobuf 拥有超过 7 万星标，今日新增 96 星，持续受到开发者关注，因其高效、跨语言特性成为微服务和分布式系统的基石。
uses: 后端开发人员：在微服务间定义高效、版本兼容的通信协议。
数据工程师：用于大数据管道和存储格式（如与 gRPC 结合）。
跨语言团队：需要统一数据交换格式，支持多语言生成代码。

en.tag: Google's cross-language data serialization standard
en.what: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It defines data structures in .proto files and generates code in multiple languages, widely used in RPC systems and data storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full implementation of protobuf, including the compiler (protoc) written in C++, runtime libraries for various languages (C++, Java, Python, Go, etc.), tests, and documentation.
en.stack: The compiler is primarily written in C++, supporting Bazel and CMake build systems, with dependencies on various language runtimes.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, protobuf has over 71k stars, with 96 added today, continuing to attract developers due to its efficiency and cross-language capabilities, making it a cornerstone of microservices and distributed systems.
uses: Backend developers: define efficient, version-tolerant communication protocols between microservices.
Data engineers: use in big data pipelines and storage formats (e.g., with gRPC).
Cross-language teams: need a unified data interchange format with multi-language code generation.

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached
zh.what: Dragonfly 是一个现代化的内存数据存储，专为现代应用负载设计。它完全兼容 Redis 和 Memcached API，无需修改代码即可迁移。相比传统内存存储，吞吐量提升 25 倍，资源消耗降低 80%。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎源码、文档、基准测试、构建指南以及多语言 README。还提供了 Docker 镜像和云服务入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Linux 内核特性如 epoll 和 io_uring。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Helm charts 用于 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 作为 Redis 和 Memcached 的现代替代品，凭借惊人的性能提升和资源节省，在 C++ 社区持续火爆，今日新增 77 星，总星数达 31150。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟缓存服务的后端开发团队，可无缝替代 Redis。
希望在降低基础设施成本的同时提升性能的运维和架构师。
对内存数据库内部实现感兴趣的 C++ 开发者，可阅读源码学习。

en.tag: High-performance in-memory data store, Redis & Memcached compatible
en.what: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to adopt. Compared to legacy in-memory datastores, it delivers 25X more throughput and uses up to 80% less resources.
en.content: The repository contains core engine source code, documentation, benchmarks, build guides, and multi-language READMEs. It also provides Docker images and a cloud service entry point.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Linux kernel features like epoll and io_uring. Supports Docker deployment and provides Helm charts for Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for Redis and Memcached, it gains popularity in the C++ community due to its impressive performance gains and resource savings, with 77 new stars today and 31,150 total.
uses: Backend teams needing high-throughput, low-latency caching, seamlessly replacing Redis.
Ops and architects aiming to cut infrastructure costs while boosting performance.
C++ developers interested in the internals of in-memory databases for learning.

zh.tag: Cloudflare Workers 开源运行时，自托管与本地开发
zh.what: workerd 是 Cloudflare Workers 背后的 JavaScript/Wasm 服务器运行时，基于 V8 构建。它允许你在自己的服务器上运行 Workers 应用，或作为开发工具进行本地测试，也可用作可编程 HTTP 代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含运行时源码、文档、示例配置以及用于构建和测试的工具。核心是 C++ 实现的服务器运行时，支持基于能力的绑定、多线程和兼容性日期机制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 V8 引擎，支持 JavaScript 和 WebAssembly。构建系统基于 Bazel，并支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare Workers 的开源核心，吸引了大量开发者和企业关注。本月新增 222 星，总星数达 8608，在 C++ 月度趋势榜排名第 20，热度持续上升。
uses: 自托管 Workers 应用：在自有服务器上运行为 Cloudflare Workers 设计的代码
本地开发与测试：在部署前于本地模拟 Workers 环境
可编程 HTTP 代理：拦截、修改和路由网络请求
学习 Workers 运行时原理：研究其设计原则和实现

en.tag: Open-source runtime powering Cloudflare Workers for self-hosting and local dev
en.what: workerd is the JavaScript/Wasm server runtime that powers Cloudflare Workers, built on V8. It lets you self-host Workers applications, develop and test locally, or use it as a programmable HTTP proxy.
en.content: The repo contains runtime source code, documentation, example configs, and build/test tooling. Core is a C++ server runtime with capability bindings, multi-threading, and compatibility dates.
en.stack: Primarily C++, depends on V8 engine, supports JavaScript and WebAssembly. Build system uses Bazel, supports Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: As the open-source core of Cloudflare Workers, it attracts developers and enterprises. Gained 222 stars this month, total 8608, ranking #20 on C++ monthly trending, with rising popularity.
uses: Self-host Workers apps: run code designed for Cloudflare Workers on your own servers
Local development and testing: simulate Workers environment locally before deployment
Programmable HTTP proxy: intercept, modify, and route network requests
Learn Workers runtime internals: study its design principles and implementation

zh.tag: 极简 C++ 即时模式 GUI 库，零依赖高性能
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个为 C++ 设计的极简图形用户界面库，采用即时模式（immediate mode）范式，输出优化的顶点缓冲区，可在任何启用 3D 管线的应用中渲染。它速度快、可移植、与渲染器无关，且无外部依赖，主要用于快速迭代和开发工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码（imgui.cpp/h 等）、示例（examples/）和文档（docs/），以及用于集成到各种渲染后端和平台的绑定。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持 OpenGL、DirectX、Vulkan 等渲染后端，并提供多种语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为游戏和工具开发中事实标准的 GUI 库，拥有 76k+ star，长期活跃，今日新增 24 星，持续获得开发者青睐。
uses: 游戏引擎编辑器或调试工具开发者，需要快速构建可视化界面
图形程序员，用于创建内容创作工具或性能分析面板
需要轻量级、可嵌入 GUI 的桌面应用或工具链开发者

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++. It uses an immediate-mode paradigm, outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered anytime in a 3D-pipeline-enabled application. It is fast, portable, renderer agnostic, and self-contained (no external dependencies), designed for fast iterations and developer tools.
en.content: The repository contains core library source (imgui.cpp/h etc.), examples (examples/), and documentation (docs/), along with bindings for various rendering backends and platforms.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supports rendering backends like OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, and offers bindings for multiple languages.
en.hot: As the de facto standard GUI library for game and tool development, it has 76k+ stars, remains highly active, and gained 24 stars today, continuing to earn developer favor.
uses: Game engine editor or debug tool developers needing quick visual UI
Graphics programmers creating content creation tools or performance analysis panels
Desktop app or toolchain developers needing a lightweight embeddable GUI

zh.tag: 3D打印切片与G代码生成工具
zh.what: PrusaSlicer 是一款将 3D 模型转换为 3D 打印指令（G-code）的软件，支持 FDM 和 mSLA 打印机。它由 Prusa Research 开发，兼容多种品牌打印机，并提供丰富的打印参数设置和模型编辑功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建文档（doc/Build.md）、资源文件（如图标）以及贡献指南。主要功能包括精确的打印参数设置、模型编辑（如涂色、切割、排列）、多项目多平台支持、多材料打印、3D 预览和命令行接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Slic3r 构建，依赖常见的图形和几何库。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台，Linux 通过 Flathub 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 打印领域的知名开源切片软件，PrusaSlicer 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 9296，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。其强大的功能和活跃的社区是热度来源。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：使用 PrusaSlicer 将模型切片并生成打印指令，支持多种打印机。
专业用户：需要精细控制打印参数和进行多材料打印的工程师或设计师。
自动化工作流：通过命令行接口在无 GUI 环境下集成切片功能。

en.tag: 3D printing slicer and G-code generator
en.what: PrusaSlicer is a software that converts 3D models into 3D printing instructions (G-code), supporting FDM and mSLA printers. Developed by Prusa Research, it is compatible with a wide range of printer brands and offers extensive printing parameter settings and model editing features.
en.content: The repository contains the complete C++ source code, build documentation (doc/Build.md), resource files (e.g., icons), and contribution guidelines. Key features include precise printing parameter settings, model editing (painting, cutting, arranging), multi-project and multi-bed support, multi-material printing, 3D preview, and a command-line interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, built on Slic3r, and relies on common graphics and geometry libraries. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux; Linux is distributed via Flathub.
en.hot: As a well-known open-source slicer in 3D printing, PrusaSlicer continues to gain attention, adding 13 stars today, reaching 9296 total, ranking third on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and active community drive its popularity.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use PrusaSlicer to slice models and generate print instructions for various printers.
Professional users: engineers or designers needing precise control over print parameters and multi-material printing.
Automation workflows: integrate slicing via command-line interface in headless environments.

zh.tag: 跨 GPU 的图形缩放与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一个允许在支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换原生缩放器的工具，并能管理帧生成，包括通过实验性的 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成。它支持 DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ 输入，并可将 DLSS 帧生成替换为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、预编译的稳定版和夜间版发布包、详细的 Wiki 文档、Discord 社区链接以及捐赠渠道。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖图形 API 如 DX12 和 Vulkan，以及 DLSS/FSR/XeSS 等缩放技术。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 10k+ 星标，今日新增 47 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。它解决了跨 GPU 缩放和帧生成的兼容性问题，受到游戏玩家和模组社区的广泛关注。
uses: 游戏玩家：在非原生支持的游戏中使用 FSR 或 XeSS 替换 DLSS，提升帧率或画质。
模组制作者：利用 Nukem 模组将 DLSS 帧生成转换为 FSR3，扩展硬件兼容性。
开发者：研究图形缩放和帧生成技术的实现，参考其跨平台兼容方案。

en.tag: Bridges upscaling/frame gen across GPUs, replacing native upscalers
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games that already support DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation, including enabling it in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG. It supports DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ inputs and can replace DLSS frame gen with FSR3.
en.content: The repository contains C++ source code, precompiled stable and nightly releases, a comprehensive Wiki, Discord community link, and donation channels.
en.stack: Developed in C++, relies on graphics APIs like DX12 and Vulkan, and upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With over 10k stars and 47 new stars today, ranking #2 on the C++ trending list, it addresses cross-GPU upscaling and frame gen compatibility, gaining attention from gamers and modders.
uses: Gamers: Replace DLSS with FSR or XeSS in games that don't natively support them, improving FPS or quality.
Modders: Use the Nukem mod to convert DLSS frame gen to FSR3, extending hardware compatibility.
Developers: Study the implementation of upscaling and frame gen techniques, referencing its cross-platform compatibility approach.

zh.tag: C++ 微基准测试库，像写单元测试一样写性能测试
zh.what: Google 出品的 C++ 微基准测试库，用于对代码片段进行性能基准测试，类似于单元测试。它提供简单的 API 来定义基准测试函数，自动计时并输出结果。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、文档（用户指南、构建说明）、示例代码以及 Python 绑定。核心 API 通过 BENCHMARK 宏注册函数，并使用 BENCHMARK_MAIN 运行所有基准测试。
zh.stack: C++ 编写，支持 C++11 使用，构建需 C++17。使用 CMake 构建，可选依赖 Python 绑定，支持 Bazel。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方库，star 数已过万，是 C++ 性能测试的标准选择。虽然今日新增为 0，但长期热度稳定，在 C++ 日榜中位列第 13。
uses: C++ 开发者需要对关键代码路径进行性能回归测试时
在持续集成中集成基准测试，以监控性能变化
对比不同算法实现或优化方案的实际运行效率

en.tag: A C++ microbenchmark library for benchmarking code snippets like unit tests
en.what: A Google-developed C++ microbenchmark library for benchmarking code snippets, similar to unit tests. It provides a simple API to define benchmark functions, automatically times them, and outputs results.
en.content: The repository contains core library source code, documentation (user guide, build instructions), examples, and Python bindings. The core API registers functions via the BENCHMARK macro and runs all benchmarks with BENCHMARK_MAIN.
en.stack: Written in C++, usable with C++11, requires C++17 to build. Uses CMake for building, optional Python bindings, supports Bazel.
en.hot: As an official Google library with over 10k stars, it's the standard choice for C++ performance testing. Although no new stars today, its long-term popularity is stable, ranking 13th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: For C++ developers needing performance regression tests on critical code paths
To integrate benchmarks into CI for monitoring performance changes
To compare the actual efficiency of different algorithm implementations or optimizations

zh.tag: 高性能跨平台流媒体服务框架，支持多协议互转
zh.what: ZLMediaKit 是一个基于 C++11 的高性能运营级流媒体服务框架，支持 RTSP/RTMP/HLS/HTTP-FLV/WebRTC/GB28181 等多种协议，并实现协议间的互转。它既可以作为完整的流媒体服务器部署，也可以作为 SDK 集成到其他应用中。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、完整 MediaServer 服务器、标准 C API、RESTful API 和 Web Hook，以及丰富的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11，使用多路复用、多线程和异步网络 IO，支持 Linux、macOS、iOS、Android、Windows 等平台，以及多种 CPU 架构。
zh.hot: 拥有 17.5k stars，因其功能全面、性能卓越（支持 10W 级并发播放器、100Gb/s IO），且已在商业环境验证，深受开发者信赖。
uses: 适用于需要搭建直播或点播服务器的开发者，可快速部署商用级流媒体服务。
适用于安防监控行业，支持 GB28181 协议，便于集成摄像头流。
适用于需要跨平台流媒体 SDK 的团队，可嵌入到移动或嵌入式设备。
适用于需要低延时（毫秒级）直播场景，如在线教育、互动直播。

en.tag: High-performance cross-platform streaming media framework with multi-protocol conversion
en.what: ZLMediaKit is a high-performance, production-grade streaming media framework based on C++11, supporting protocols like RTSP, RTMP, HLS, HTTP-FLV, WebRTC, and GB28181, with protocol conversion capabilities. It can be deployed as a full media server or used as an SDK.
en.content: The repository includes the core library, a full MediaServer, standard C API, RESTful API, Web Hooks, and extensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built on C++11 with multiplexing, multithreading, and async I/O; supports Linux, macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, and various CPU architectures.
en.hot: With 17.5k stars, it's trusted for its comprehensive features, outstanding performance (100k+ concurrent players, 100Gb/s I/O), and proven commercial use.
uses: Developers needing to set up live or on-demand streaming servers with production-grade reliability.
Security surveillance industry: supports GB28181 for camera stream integration.
Teams requiring a cross-platform streaming SDK for mobile or embedded devices.
Low-latency live scenarios like online education or interactive broadcasting.

zh.tag: 高性能 C++ Web 框架，支持异步与跨平台
zh.what: Drogon 是一个基于 C++17/20 的 HTTP 应用框架，用于构建各种类型的 Web 应用服务器。它采用非阻塞 I/O 和异步编程模式，提供高性能、高并发的网络服务，并支持 RESTful API、WebSocket、HTTPS 等特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架源码、示例、文档（中英文）以及命令行工具 drogon_ctl，用于生成控制器、视图等代码。还提供 Docker 镜像和构建配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++14/17/20，使用 epoll/kqueue 实现非阻塞 I/O，依赖 OpenSSL、jsoncpp、zlib 等库，支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite 数据库。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 领域少有的高性能 Web 框架，Drogon 在 TechEmpower 基准测试中表现优异，吸引了大量追求性能的 C++ 开发者，star 数稳步增长。
uses: 需要构建高并发、低延迟 Web 服务的 C++ 开发者
希望使用现代 C++ 特性进行异步编程的团队
对 RESTful API 和 WebSocket 有需求的服务器端项目
学习 C++ 网络编程和框架设计的进阶者

en.tag: High-performance C++ web framework with async I/O and cross-platform support
en.what: Drogon is a C++17/20 based HTTP application framework for building various types of web application servers. It uses non-blocking I/O and asynchronous programming to provide high-performance, high-concurrency network services, supporting RESTful APIs, WebSocket, HTTPS, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the framework source code, examples, documentation (in Chinese and English), and the drogon_ctl command-line tool for generating controllers, views, etc. Docker images and build configurations are also provided.
en.stack: Built on C++14/17/20, uses epoll/kqueue for non-blocking I/O, depends on OpenSSL, jsoncpp, zlib, and supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite databases.
en.hot: As one of the few high-performance web frameworks in C++, Drogon excels in TechEmpower benchmarks, attracting performance-focused C++ developers, with steady star growth.
uses: C++ developers building high-concurrency, low-latency web services
Teams wanting to use modern C++ features for asynchronous programming
Server-side projects requiring RESTful APIs and WebSocket support
Advanced learners studying C++ network programming and framework design

zh.tag: 明日方舟全自动日常助手，一键长草
zh.what: MAA 是一款基于图像识别的《明日方舟》游戏辅助工具，能自动完成游戏内的日常任务，如刷图、基建换班、公招等。它通过模拟操作和图像识别，让玩家实现“一键长草”，省时省力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档（支持多语言）、以及用于构建和发布的配置。主要模块涵盖战斗、基建、公招、肉鸽等自动化功能，并提供多种编程语言的接口。
zh.stack: 基于 C++20 开发，使用图像识别技术，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。项目还集成了多种语言的接口，如 C、Python、Java、Rust 和 Golang。
zh.hot: 作为热门游戏《明日方舟》的辅助工具，MAA 凭借其高度自动化和活跃的社区更新，在 GitHub 上获得了 2.3 万星标，本月新增 762 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 21 名。
uses: 《明日方舟》玩家：希望自动完成日常任务，节省时间，实现一键长草。
游戏自动化爱好者：对图像识别和模拟操作技术感兴趣，可学习其实现。
开发者：需要集成游戏辅助功能，可通过提供的多种语言接口进行二次开发。

en.tag: One-click Arknights daily task assistant, auto-grind all clients
en.what: MAA is an image-recognition-based assistant for Arknights that automates daily tasks like auto-battles, base management, and recruitment. It simulates user operations to enable one-click idle farming, saving time and effort.
en.content: The repo contains full C++ source code, multi-language docs, and build/release configs. Main modules cover battle, base, recruitment, and roguelike automation, with APIs in multiple languages.
en.stack: Built with C++20, leveraging image recognition, and supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It also provides APIs for C, Python, Java, Rust, and Golang.
en.hot: As a popular Arknights assistant, MAA's high automation and active community updates have earned 22,988 stars, with 762 added this month, ranking #21 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Arknights players who want to automate daily tasks and save time with one-click farming.
Game automation enthusiasts interested in image recognition and simulated input techniques.
Developers seeking to integrate game assist features via provided multi-language APIs.

zh.tag: RE引擎游戏通用模组框架与VR支持工具
zh.what: REFramework 是一个针对卡普空 RE 引擎游戏的模组加载器、脚本平台和模组工具，支持 VR。它允许玩家在游戏中加载 Lua 脚本、插件和内置模组，并提供了大量游戏修复和增强功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 DLL 文件、Lua 脚本 API、插件系统、VR 支持、多种内置模组（如自由视角、FOV 调整等）以及开发者工具（如对象浏览器）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 DirectX 11/12，支持 SteamVR/OpenXR，并集成 Lua 脚本引擎。
zh.hot: 作为 RE 引擎游戏模组的核心工具，它持续吸引大量玩家和模组作者，今日新增 16 星，总星数达 5408，在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第 17。
uses: 模组作者：利用 Lua API 和插件系统为 RE 引擎游戏创建自定义模组和脚本。
VR 玩家：在支持的 RE 游戏中启用 VR 模式，获得沉浸式体验。
游戏玩家：使用内置修复和增强功能改善游戏体验，如解锁帧率或修复崩溃。

en.tag: Universal mod framework, scripting platform, and VR support for RE Engine games
en.what: REFramework is a mod loader, scripting platform, and modding tool for Capcom's RE Engine games, with VR support. It enables loading Lua scripts, plugins, and built-in mods, plus many fixes and enhancements.
en.content: The repository contains core DLLs, Lua scripting API, plugin system, VR support, various built-in mods (free camera, FOV slider, etc.), and developer tools like object explorer.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on DirectX 11/12, supports SteamVR/OpenXR, and integrates a Lua scripting engine.
en.hot: As a central tool for RE Engine modding, it consistently attracts players and modders, gaining 16 stars today to reach 5408 total, ranking #17 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Modders: Create custom mods and scripts for RE Engine games using the Lua API and plugin system.
VR enthusiasts: Enable VR mode in supported RE games for an immersive experience.
Gamers: Use built-in fixes and enhancements to improve gameplay, such as unlocking frame rate or fixing crashes.

zh.tag: 开源 RGB 灯效统一控制，跨平台免厂商软件
zh.what: OpenRGB 是一个开源 RGB 灯效控制工具，旨在替代各硬件厂商各自为政的软件。它通过逆向工程协议直接与硬件通信，支持在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上统一管理多种品牌的 RGB 设备，提供图形界面、命令行和 SDK。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档、截图和构建配置，支持多种设备列表，并提供预编译二进制文件（Windows、Linux AppImage/deb/rpm、macOS）以及 Flatpak 包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 libusb 等库进行硬件通信，支持跨平台构建（CMake）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 9 星，总星数 4386，位列 C++ 日榜第 18。因其解决了 RGB 生态碎片化痛点，且持续更新，吸引大量 DIY 玩家和开源爱好者。
uses: 适用于拥有多品牌 RGB 设备、厌倦安装多个厂商控制软件的用户，希望统一管理灯效。
适合喜欢自定义灯光效果、需要跨平台（如 Linux 或 macOS）控制 RGB 硬件的玩家。
适合开发者或高级用户，希望利用 OpenRGB SDK 或命令行接口集成到自己的脚本或应用中。

en.tag: Open-source unified RGB lighting control across Windows/Linux/macOS
en.what: OpenRGB is an open-source RGB lighting control tool that aims to replace manufacturer-specific software. By using reverse-engineered protocols to communicate directly with hardware, it unifies management of RGB devices from various brands on Windows, Linux, and macOS, offering a GUI, CLI, and SDK.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, documentation, screenshots, build configurations, a supported devices list, and pre-built binaries for Windows, Linux (AppImage/deb/rpm), macOS, plus a Flatpak package.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, using libraries like libusb for hardware communication, and CMake for cross-platform builds.
en.hot: Gained 9 stars today, total 4386, ranking #18 on C++ daily trending. It addresses the pain point of fragmented RGB ecosystems and is actively maintained, attracting DIY enthusiasts and open-source fans.
uses: For users with RGB devices from multiple brands who are tired of installing multiple vendor apps and want unified lighting control.
For enthusiasts who want cross-platform (e.g., Linux or macOS) control of RGB hardware and custom lighting effects.
For developers or advanced users who want to integrate OpenRGB's SDK or CLI into their own scripts or applications.

zh.tag: 跨平台无人机地面站，支持任务规划与实时飞行控制
zh.what: QGroundControl (QGC) 是一款用于无人机的跨平台地面控制站软件，支持任何基于 MAVLink 协议的无人机，包括 PX4 和 ArduPilot 平台。它提供完整的飞行控制和任务规划功能，适用于从简单飞行到复杂自主任务的各种场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 QGC 源代码，采用 C++ 编写，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。项目结构包括核心库、用户界面、插件系统以及用于构建和部署的脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 MAVLink 库，并集成 GStreamer 用于视频流处理。支持跨平台构建，使用 CMake 进行项目配置。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多（4 个），但累计 4896 个 star 表明其作为无人机地面站领域的长期稳定项目，持续受到开发者和无人机爱好者的关注。
uses: 无人机开发者：用于测试和调试 PX4 或 ArduPilot 自驾仪，进行参数调整和日志分析。
无人机操作员：在飞行现场使用 QGC 进行任务规划、实时监控和视频接收。
教育研究者：作为教学和科研平台，研究无人机自主飞行和地面控制交互。

en.tag: Cross-platform ground control station for drones with mission planning and live flight control
en.what: QGroundControl (QGC) is a cross-platform ground control station for UAVs, supporting any MAVLink-enabled drone, including PX4 and ArduPilot platforms. It provides full flight control and mission planning, suitable for scenarios from simple flights to complex autonomous missions.
en.content: The repository contains the full QGC source code written in C++, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. The project structure includes core libraries, user interfaces, plugin systems, and build/deployment scripts.
en.stack: Primarily uses C++ and the Qt framework, depends on the MAVLink library, and integrates GStreamer for video streaming. Supports cross-platform builds with CMake.
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars (4), the cumulative 4896 stars reflect its status as a long-standing stable project in the drone ground control domain, consistently attracting developers and drone enthusiasts.
uses: Drone developers: test and debug PX4 or ArduPilot autopilots, tune parameters, and analyze logs.
Drone operators: use QGC at flight sites for mission planning, live monitoring, and video reception.
Educators and researchers: use as a teaching and research platform for autonomous flight and ground control interaction.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 利用 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施，在 macOS 上启动虚拟 iPhone。它自动化了从下载固件、修补引导链到 DFU 恢复和首次启动的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含命令行工具 vphone-cli、用于管理虚拟机的子命令（vm、fw、restore、cfw 等），以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 编写，依赖 Python、aria2、wget、openssl、libusb 等工具，通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 周榜排名第 8，本周新增近 2000 star，总 star 过万，因其能在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的突破性能力而备受关注。
uses: iOS 开发者和安全研究人员，希望在 Mac 上快速启动虚拟 iPhone 进行测试。
对 iOS 内部机制感兴趣的技术爱好者，想探索 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施。
需要多设备测试环境的人员，可通过克隆快速创建多个虚拟 iPhone。

en.tag: CLI tool to boot a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs
en.what: vphone-cli leverages Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure to boot a virtual iPhone on macOS. It automates the entire pipeline from firmware download, boot chain patching, DFU restore, to first boot.
en.content: The repository includes the vphone-cli command-line tool, subcommands for VM management (vm, fw, restore, cfw, etc.), build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Swift, with dependencies on Python, aria2, wget, openssl, libusb, etc., installed via Homebrew.
en.hot: Ranked #8 on GitHub Trending this week with ~2000 new stars, surpassing 10k total, it gains attention for its groundbreaking ability to run a virtual iPhone on a Mac.
uses: iOS developers and security researchers who want to spin up virtual iPhones on a Mac for testing.
Tech enthusiasts interested in iOS internals, exploring PCC research VM infrastructure.
Those needing multiple test devices, can quickly clone virtual iPhones for parallel testing.

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.

zh.tag: 浏览器内零服务器代码知识图谱与Graph RAG代理
zh.what: GitNexus是一个完全在浏览器中运行的客户端知识图谱引擎，可导入Git仓库或ZIP文件，生成交互式知识图谱，并内置Graph RAG代理，用于代码探索。它索引代码库的依赖、调用链、集群和执行流，并通过MCP工具暴露给AI代理，使代理获得架构级上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含CLI工具（npx gitnexus analyze/setup）、Web UI（浏览器聊天界面）、MCP配置生成器，以及自动生成的AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md上下文文件。
zh.stack: 基于TypeScript，依赖npm包分发，使用MCP协议集成AI代理，支持GitHub/GitLab/Azure/本地仓库。
zh.hot: GitNexus在GitHub Trending日榜排名第5，今日新增202星，总星数达46k。其零服务器架构和深度代码分析能力吸引了开发者，被视为DeepWiki的进阶版。
uses: 开发者快速理解陌生代码库的架构和依赖关系
AI编码代理（如Cursor、Claude Code）获取完整代码上下文，减少错误编辑
技术团队在浏览器中协作探索代码，无需配置服务器
教育场景中用于可视化代码结构和调用链

en.tag: Zero-server code knowledge graph with Graph RAG agent in browser
en.what: GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph engine that runs entirely in the browser. Drop in a Git repo or ZIP file to get an interactive knowledge graph with a built-in Graph RAG agent for code exploration. It indexes dependencies, call chains, clusters, and execution flows, exposing them via MCP tools so AI agents gain architectural context.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI (npx gitnexus analyze/setup), a Web UI for browser chat, MCP config generator, and auto-generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context files.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, distributed via npm, uses MCP protocol for AI agent integration, supports GitHub/GitLab/Azure/local repos.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending daily with +202 stars today, reaching 46k total. Its zero-server architecture and deep code analysis appeal to developers, seen as a deeper alternative to DeepWiki.
uses: Developers quickly understand architecture and dependencies of unfamiliar codebases
AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code) get full code context to reduce blind edits
Teams explore code collaboratively in the browser without server setup
Educational use to visualize code structure and call chains

zh.tag: 自动构建个人知识库的跨平台桌面应用
zh.what: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，能自动将你的文档转化为组织良好、相互关联的知识库。它摒弃了传统 RAG 每次从头检索的方式，而是让 LLM 增量构建并维护一个持久化的 wiki。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，支持多格式文档解析、多模态图像提取、知识图谱、社区检测、深度研究等功能，并提供详细的 README 和中文等多语言文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端为桌面应用框架，后端包含 Rust 聊天代理，支持 LanceDB 向量搜索、MinerU PDF 处理，以及多种 LLM 模型配置。

适用于希望利用 AI 自动整理笔记、文献和网页剪辑的个人知识管理场景
对探索知识图谱、社区检测和深度研究功能感兴趣的技术爱好者和开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop app that auto-builds a personal knowledge base
en.what: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that automatically turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base. Instead of traditional RAG, it uses LLM to incrementally build and maintain a persistent wiki from your sources.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, featuring multi-format document parsing, multimodal image extraction, knowledge graph, community detection, deep research, and detailed README with multi-language support.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with a desktop app frontend and a Rust backend chat agent. Supports LanceDB vector search, MinerU PDF processing, and flexible LLM model configuration.

Perfect for personal knowledge management scenarios where AI automatically organizes notes, literature, and web clippings
Great for tech enthusiasts and developers interested in knowledge graphs, community detection, and deep research features

zh.tag: 浏览器内高性能 LLM 推理引擎，WebGPU 加速
zh.what: WebLLM 是一个高性能的浏览器内 LLM 推理引擎，利用 WebGPU 实现硬件加速，使语言模型推理直接在浏览器中运行，无需服务器支持。它完全兼容 OpenAI API，支持流式输出、JSON 模式等功能，并可在本地使用任何开源模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WebLLM 的 npm 包源码、示例代码、文档和测试，以及用于构建和部署的配置。核心是 TypeScript 编写的推理引擎，通过 WebGPU 和 WebAssembly 实现模型加载与计算。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 WebGPU 和 WebAssembly，通过 npm 包分发。与 MLC LLM 项目紧密相关，支持多种模型格式。
zh.hot: 本周新增 345 星，总星数近 1.9 万，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 14。它让 LLM 推理无需服务器，直接在浏览器中运行，兼顾隐私和 GPU 加速，且兼容 OpenAI API，降低了 AI 应用开发门槛。
uses: 前端开发者：在浏览器中构建无需后端的 AI 聊天应用，利用 WebGPU 加速推理。
隐私敏感场景：用户数据保留在本地浏览器，适合处理敏感信息的应用。
AI 应用原型设计：快速在网页中集成开源模型，无需配置服务器环境。

en.tag: High-performance in-browser LLM inference engine with WebGPU acceleration
en.what: WebLLM is a high-performance in-browser LLM inference engine that leverages WebGPU for hardware acceleration, enabling LLM inference directly in the browser without server support. It is fully compatible with the OpenAI API, supporting streaming, JSON mode, and other features, and can run any open-source model locally.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of the WebLLM npm package, examples, documentation, and tests, along with build and deployment configurations. The core is a TypeScript inference engine that uses WebGPU and WebAssembly for model loading and computation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, relying on WebGPU and WebAssembly, distributed as an npm package. Closely related to the MLC LLM project, supporting multiple model formats.
en.hot: With 345 stars added this week and nearly 19k total, it ranks #14 on the TypeScript weekly trending. It enables LLM inference in the browser without servers, balancing privacy and GPU acceleration, and its OpenAI API compatibility lowers the barrier for AI app development.
uses: Frontend developers: build AI chat apps in the browser without a backend, leveraging WebGPU acceleration.
Privacy-sensitive scenarios: user data stays in the local browser, suitable for apps handling sensitive information.
AI prototyping: quickly integrate open-source models into web pages without server setup.

zh.tag: GitHub Actions 官方检出仓库 Action
zh.what: 这是 GitHub 官方维护的 Actions/checkout，用于在 GitHub Actions 工作流中把仓库代码检出到运行器上。它默认只获取触发工作流的单个提交，也支持通过 fetch-depth 获取完整历史。
zh.content: 仓库包含该 Action 的源码、文档和示例，主要逻辑在 TypeScript 中实现，并附有测试和工作流配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 @actions/core、@actions/github 等官方包，并迁移到 ESM 模块系统。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub Actions 最基础的官方 Action，几乎所有工作流都会用到，本周新增 173 star，持续保持高热度。

en.tag: Official GitHub Action to check out a repository
en.what: This is the official GitHub Action to check out a repository in GitHub Actions workflows. It fetches a single commit by default, but can be configured to fetch full history with fetch-depth.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, and examples for the Action, implemented in TypeScript with tests and workflow configurations.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, using official @actions/* packages, and migrated to ESM.
en.hot: As the most fundamental official Action, it's used in nearly every workflow, gaining 173 stars this week and remaining highly popular.
uses: Developers using GitHub Actions to check out code in CI/CD pipelines.
Maintainers needing secure handling of fork pull requests, with an opt-in for unsafe checkout.
Developers interested in official Action best practices and TypeScript implementation.

zh.tag: 细粒度响应式 UI 库，无虚拟 DOM
zh.what: Solid 是一个声明式 JavaScript 库，用于构建用户界面。它不使用虚拟 DOM，而是将模板编译为真实 DOM 节点，并通过细粒度的响应式更新来高效管理状态变化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Solid 核心库的源码、文档、示例和测试。核心 API 包括 createSignal、createEffect 等响应式原语，以及 JSX 编译器和运行时支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 JSX 语法和编译器，支持现代浏览器和 Node.js 环境。
zh.hot: Solid 因其高性能和细粒度响应式而受到关注，尽管本周新增 star 不多，但总星数近 3.6 万，在 TypeScript 周榜中位列第 10，显示出持续的热度。
uses: 前端开发者寻求高性能、细粒度响应式的 UI 库
需要无虚拟 DOM 的轻量级框架的团队
对 React 替代方案感兴趣，希望学习新范式的人

en.tag: Fine-grained reactive UI library without Virtual DOM
en.what: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Instead of using a Virtual DOM, it compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions, ensuring efficient state management.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, examples, and tests for the Solid core library. Key APIs include reactive primitives like createSignal and createEffect, along with JSX compiler and runtime support.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, relies on JSX syntax and a compiler, supports modern browsers and Node.js environments.
en.hot: Solid gains attention for its high performance and fine-grained reactivity. Although weekly new stars are modest, its total stars approach 36k, ranking 10th on the TypeScript weekly list, indicating sustained popularity.
uses: Frontend developers seeking a high-performance, fine-grained reactive UI library
Teams needing a lightweight framework without Virtual DOM
Those interested in React alternatives and learning new paradigms

zh.tag: AI 编码工作流引擎，让 AI 开发流程确定可复现
zh.what: Archon 是一个用于 AI 编码代理的工作流引擎。它允许你将开发流程（如规划、实现、验证、代码审查、PR 创建）定义为 YAML 工作流，并在所有项目中可靠地运行。它类似于 Dockerfile 之于基础设施，或 GitHub Actions 之于 CI/CD，但专为 AI 编码工作流设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Archon 的源代码，包括 CLI、Web UI、Slack/Telegram 集成，以及示例工作流定义。它支持可组合的节点，包括确定性节点（bash、测试、git 操作）和 AI 节点（规划、代码生成、审查）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，可能依赖 Bun 运行时（示例中使用 bun run）。它集成了 AI 模型（如规划、代码生成）和确定性工具（如 git、bash）。
zh.hot: Archon 作为首个开源 AI 编码 harness 构建器，解决了 AI 编码不可预测的问题，吸引了大量开发者。其 star 数已达 23k+，并在 GitHub Trending 周榜上排名第 16，显示出社区对其潜力的认可。
uses: 开发团队希望标准化 AI 辅助开发流程，确保每次代码生成和审查的一致性。
个人开发者想要自动化重复的编码任务，如 bug 修复和功能实现，并集成到 CI/CD 中。
对 AI 代理工作流感兴趣的研究者或开发者，希望探索可组合的工作流设计。

en.tag: Workflow engine for AI coding agents, making AI dev deterministic and repeatable
en.what: Archon is a workflow engine for AI coding agents. It lets you define development processes like planning, implementation, validation, code review, and PR creation as YAML workflows, and run them reliably across all your projects. It's like Dockerfiles for infrastructure or GitHub Actions for CI/CD, but for AI coding workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for Archon, including CLI, Web UI, Slack/Telegram integrations, and example workflow definitions. It supports composable nodes, including deterministic nodes (bash, tests, git ops) and AI nodes (planning, code generation, review).
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, likely leveraging the Bun runtime (as seen in examples with 'bun run'). It integrates AI models for planning/code generation and deterministic tools like git and bash.
en.hot: As the first open-source harness builder for AI coding, Archon addresses the unpredictability of AI coding, attracting many developers. With over 23k stars and ranking #16 on GitHub Trending weekly, it shows strong community recognition of its potential.
uses: Development teams looking to standardize AI-assisted development processes, ensuring consistency in code generation and review.
Individual developers wanting to automate repetitive coding tasks like bug fixes and feature implementation, and integrate them into CI/CD.
Researchers or developers interested in AI agent workflows, exploring composable workflow designs.

zh.tag: React 渲染器，让 Three.js 场景声明式、组件化
zh.what: react-three-fiber 是一个用于 Three.js 的 React 渲染器，允许开发者以声明式、可复用的组件方式构建 3D 场景。它让组件能够响应状态、交互，并融入 React 生态。

需要创建交互式 3D 可视化、产品展示或数据可视化界面的团队

en.tag: A React renderer for Three.js, enabling declarative 3D scenes
en.what: react-three-fiber is a React renderer for Three.js, allowing developers to build 3D scenes declaratively with reusable, self-contained components that react to state, are interactive, and participate in React's ecosystem.

en.hot: With 32k+ stars and 209 added this week, it's popular for bringing React's declarative paradigm to 3D graphics, lowering the barrier to Three.js without performance overhead, continuously attracting developers.
uses: React developers who want to build 3D scenes component-wise without diving into Three.js's imperative API
Teams creating interactive 3D visualizations, product showcases, or data visualization interfaces
Projects aiming to integrate 3D content seamlessly into existing React applications

提示词工程师：学习逆向工程案例，提炼可复用的技能。
产品团队：将提示词作为代码管理，实现工业化生成流程。

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2
en.what: This is a prompt engineering resource library for the GPT-Image2 image generation model, featuring 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, treating prompts as code for management and reuse. Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: 用属性在HTML中直接实现AJAX、CSS过渡、WebSocket和SSE的轻量库
zh.what: htmx 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 库，允许你直接在 HTML 中使用属性（如 hx-post、hx-swap）来发起 AJAX 请求、应用 CSS 过渡、使用 WebSocket 和服务器发送事件。它旨在通过扩展 HTML 的超文本能力，简化现代用户界面的构建，让你无需编写大量 JavaScript 代码即可实现动态交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含 htmx 的源代码、文档网站、示例、扩展（如 ws、sse）以及贡献指南。核心是一个约 14k min.gz'd 的 JavaScript 文件，可通过 CDN 或 npm 安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，无外部依赖。开发依赖包括 Node.js 和 npm，用于本地开发和测试。
zh.hot: htmx 因其极简的编程模型而广受欢迎，让开发者无需编写复杂 JavaScript 即可实现现代交互。尽管今日新增 star 不多（32），但总星数已接近 5 万，反映出其在开发者社区中的持续热度。
uses: 后端开发者希望用简单方式增强 HTML 页面交互，而不想写大量前端 JS
全栈开发者寻求轻量级替代 React/Vue 的方案，用于快速原型或小型项目
喜欢 HATEOAS 和超媒体理念的开发者，希望构建符合 REST 架构的 Web 应用

en.tag: A lightweight library that lets you use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML with attributes
en.what: htmx is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library that allows you to use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML using attributes like hx-post and hx-swap. It aims to simplify building modern user interfaces by extending HTML's hypertext capabilities, enabling dynamic interactions without writing much JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of htmx, documentation website, examples, extensions (like ws, sse), and contribution guidelines. The core is a ~14k min.gz'd JavaScript file that can be installed via CDN or npm.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript with no external dependencies. Development dependencies include Node.js and npm for local development and testing.
en.hot: htmx is popular for its minimalist programming model, allowing developers to implement modern interactions without writing complex JavaScript. Although today's new stars are modest (32), the total star count is approaching 50k, reflecting its sustained popularity in the developer community.
uses: Backend developers who want to enhance HTML page interactions in a simple way without writing lots of frontend JS
Full-stack developers seeking a lightweight alternative to React/Vue for quick prototypes or small projects
Developers who embrace HATEOAS and hypermedia principles to build RESTful web applications

zh.tag: 为雄心勃勃的UI而生的样式系统
zh.what: StyleX 是 Facebook 开源的 JavaScript 样式系统，旨在为大型应用提供高性能、可扩展且类型安全的样式解决方案。它通过编译时优化和原子 CSS 生成，减少运行时开销，同时保持开发体验的简洁性。

zh.hot: 作为 Facebook 官方出品，StyleX 旨在解决大型应用的样式性能问题，star 数已过万，今日新增 49，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第 10，受到前端社区广泛关注。
uses: 大型 React 应用开发者，希望提升样式性能并简化样式管理
对原子 CSS 和编译时优化感兴趣的前端工程师

en.tag: The styling system for ambitious user interfaces
en.what: StyleX is Facebook's open-source JavaScript styling system designed to provide a high-performance, scalable, and type-safe styling solution for large applications. It reduces runtime overhead through compile-time optimization and atomic CSS generation while maintaining a simple developer experience.
en.content: The repository is a monorepo containing the core package @stylexjs/stylex, Babel plugin, ESLint plugin, PostCSS plugin, Rollup plugin, CLI, docs, and examples.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, uses Babel plugin for compile-time transformation, integrates with React and other frameworks.
en.hot: As an official Facebook project, StyleX aims to solve styling performance issues in large applications. With over 10k stars and 49 new stars today, it ranks 10th on the JavaScript trending list, attracting wide attention from the frontend community.

Frontend engineers interested in atomic CSS and compile-time optimization
Teams needing type-safe styling solutions, usable with TypeScript

zh.tag: 让 AI 写作更像人：检测并改写 AI 腔的智能体技能
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的 AI 代理技能，用于审计和重写内容，去除常见的 AI 写作模式（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语等）。它支持重写、检测和原地编辑三种模式，并可选语音风格（casual/professional 等），兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript 实现）、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个规则驱动的检测器，可标记 13 类 AI 写作模式，并执行多轮重写以彻底清除残留。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，采用规则/模式匹配而非机器学习，轻量且可嵌入任何 agentskills.io 兼容的代理。无外部依赖，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 3,598 星且单日新增 133，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。AI 生成内容泛滥，开发者急需让输出“去 AI 味”的工具，而它恰好以 agent skill 形式即插即用。
uses: 内容创作者：用 Claude Code 等代理批量改写文章，去除 AI 腔，提升可读性。
开发者：在 CI 或本地用 Detect 模式审计 AI 生成的文档/提交信息，避免机械感。
团队：统一内容风格，通过 voice profile 定制专业、轻松或温暖等语气。
AI 代理开发者：集成此 skill 到自定义代理，增强文本后处理能力。

en.tag: Audit & rewrite AI-sounding text into natural prose, as a portable agent skill
en.what: A portable skill for AI agents that audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns ('AI-isms'). It offers three modes—rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place—plus optional voice profiles, and works with agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains a portable skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript-based detection engine, a demo GIF, and docs. The core is a rule-driven detector that flags 13 categories of AI patterns and performs multi-pass rewriting to catch leftovers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, using rule/pattern matching rather than ML, so it's lightweight and embeddable in any agentskills.io-compatible agent. No external dependencies, MIT licensed.
en.hot: With 3,598 stars and +133 today, it hit #8 on the JavaScript trending list. As AI-generated content floods the web, developers crave tools to make output sound human, and this skill plugs directly into their favorite agents.
uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的浏览器端 PDF 工具箱
zh.what: BentoPDF 是一个功能强大的 PDF 工具集，完全在浏览器端运行，无需服务器处理，确保文件隐私安全。支持合并、拆分、编辑、转换、加密等多种 PDF 操作。

uses: 注重隐私的用户，希望 PDF 处理完全在本地完成，避免数据泄露。
需要快速处理 PDF 的办公人员，无需安装桌面软件，浏览器即可完成。
开发者和自托管爱好者，可部署到自己的服务器或静态托管平台。

en.hot: Its privacy-first approach (files never leave the browser) and comprehensive features have gained popularity, with 14.9k stars indicating strong demand for local PDF tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want PDF processing entirely on-device to avoid data leaks.
Office workers needing quick PDF handling without installing desktop software, just using the browser.
Developers and self-hosting enthusiasts who can deploy to their own servers or static hosting platforms.

团队希望共享代理记忆，实现知识沉淀和协作效率提升。

Teams looking to share agent memory for knowledge accumulation and improved collaboration efficiency.
Advanced users who want to customize memory strategies, such as compression frequency and context injection methods.

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全快速微型虚拟机
zh.what: Firecracker 是一种开源虚拟化技术，专为创建和管理安全、多租户的容器及函数服务而设计。它通过轻量级虚拟机（microVM）结合硬件虚拟化的安全隔离与容器的速度灵活性，为无服务器计算提供高效运行环境。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Linux KVM 虚拟化技术，支持在 Unix/Linux 系统上通过 Docker 构建。
zh.hot: Firecracker 由 AWS 开发并开源，支撑 AWS Lambda 和 Fargate 等核心服务，凭借极低开销和高安全性在无服务器领域广受关注，目前已有 36k+ stars。
uses: 无服务器平台开发者：需要安全、快速启动的微VM来运行函数或容器工作负载。
容器运行时集成：如 Kata Containers 等，利用 Firecracker 提供更强的隔离性。
云基础设施团队：构建多租户环境，降低资源开销并提高硬件利用率。

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology purpose-built for creating and managing secure, multi-tenant container and function-based services. en.content: The repository contains the core VMM code of Firecracker, which uses KVM to create and run microVMs, along with documentation for building, testing, running, and production host setup.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Rust, relies on Linux KVM for virtualization, and can be built on Unix/Linux systems with Docker.
en.hot: Developed by AWS and open-sourced, Firecracker powers AWS Lambda and Fargate, gaining popularity for its minimal overhead and high security in serverless computing, with 36k+ stars.
uses: Serverless platform developers: need secure, fast-booting microVMs for function or container workloads.
Container runtime integrators: such as Kata Containers, leveraging Firecracker for stronger isolation.
Cloud infrastructure teams: building multi-tenant environments to reduce overhead and increase hardware utilization.
