安全分析师通过可视化工作流和证据回放，审计和复盘安全事件。
开发者或研究者探索 AI 原生安全工具链，集成 MCP 和 RAG 技术。
企业安全运营中心（SOC）用于统一管理漏洞、WebShell 和知识库。

en.tag: AI-native cybersecurity system of action integrating planning, execution, and audit
en.what: CyberStrikeAI is an AI-native cybersecurity platform built in Go that turns intent into governed execution and evidence into operational memory. It connects planning, execution, human oversight, evidence, and replay in one auditable workspace for authorized security operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform code, including dashboard, web console, task management, vulnerability management, WebShell management, MCP management, knowledge base, skills management, and agent management modules. It also includes documentation, security model, and hardening guides.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, integrating Eino-powered agents, MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge, visual workflows, and attack-chain modeling and analysis.
en.hot: As AI and cybersecurity convergence becomes a hot topic, CyberStrikeAI offers a comprehensive AI-driven security operations platform, quickly gaining traction on GitHub with 121 stars today and 6,215 total.
uses: Security teams conducting authorized penetration testing and red team exercises, using AI agents to automate attack chain modeling and execution.
Security analysts auditing and replaying security incidents via visual workflows and evidence replay.
Developers or researchers exploring AI-native security toolchains, integrating MCP and RAG technologies.
Enterprise Security Operations Centers (SOC) for unified management of vulnerabilities, WebShells, and knowledge bases.

zh.tag: 可编程的异构LLM推理路由层，构建混合模型系统
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程的路由层，用于在异构 LLM 基础设施上构建 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它评估请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不硬编码路由逻辑的情况下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私和安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的路由器核心、安装脚本、文档站点（website/）、以及示例和配置。提供在线 Playground 和 Hugging Face 集成，支持 v0.3 Themis 等版本发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 vLLM 生态，可能集成 Hugging Face 模型和云/边缘计算资源。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用多样化，对混合模型路由的需求增长，该仓库提供可编程路由方案，今日新增 28 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 3 名。
uses: 需要优化 LLM 推理成本与延迟的工程团队，通过路由策略动态选择模型。
构建多模型系统（MoM）的开发者，希望根据请求内容智能组合模型输出。
关注数据隐私的企业，利用路由将敏感数据保留在本地或私有云。
研究人员探索信号驱动的路由算法，可基于此进行实验和扩展。

en.tag: Programmable routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference to build Mixture-of-Models systems
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path for each request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based router core, installation scripts, documentation site (website/), examples, and configurations. It offers an online Playground and Hugging Face integration, with releases like v0.3 Themis.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the vLLM ecosystem, with potential integrations with Hugging Face models and cloud/edge compute resources.
en.hot: As LLM applications diversify, the need for Mixture-of-Models routing grows; this repo offers a programmable solution, gaining 28 stars today and ranking #3 on Go trending.
uses: Engineering teams optimizing LLM inference cost and latency by dynamically routing requests to appropriate models.
Developers building Mixture-of-Models systems who want to intelligently compose model outputs based on request content.
Enterprises concerned with data privacy, using routing to keep sensitive data within local or private cloud boundaries.
Researchers exploring signal-driven routing algorithms, can experiment and extend based on this project.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网工具
zh.what: Tailscale 是一个基于 WireGuard 协议的组网工具，旨在让用户轻松创建和管理私有网络。它提供了跨平台的守护进程和命令行工具，支持多种操作系统，并集成了双因素认证（2FA）以增强安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tailscale 的大部分开源代码，包括核心守护进程 tailscaled 和命令行工具 tailscale。此外，还提供了构建脚本和文档，便于用户自行编译和打包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，要求最新的 Go 版本（当前为 Go 1.27）。构建时可以使用官方 Go 分支或标准 Go，并提供了 build_dist.sh 脚本以嵌入版本信息。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的 WireGuard 组网方案之一，Tailscale 凭借其易用性和安全性吸引了大量用户，本周新增 445 个 star，总 star 数达到 36089，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 个人用户：在多台设备间建立私有网络，实现远程访问和文件共享。
开发团队：构建安全的开发环境，简化服务间的通信和部署。
系统管理员：管理跨地域的服务器集群，实现统一的安全访问策略。

en.tag: Zero-config secure networking built on WireGuard
en.what: Tailscale is a networking tool based on the WireGuard protocol, designed to let users easily create and manage private networks. It provides cross-platform daemons and CLI tools, supports multiple operating systems, and integrates two-factor authentication (2FA) for enhanced security.
en.content: This repository contains the majority of Tailscale's open-source code, including the core daemon tailscaled and the CLI tool tailscale. It also includes build scripts and documentation for users to compile and package themselves.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, requiring the latest Go version (currently Go 1.27). Builds can use the official Go fork or standard Go, with a build_dist.sh script to embed version info.
en.hot: As one of the most popular WireGuard-based networking solutions, Tailscale attracts many users due to its ease of use and security, gaining 445 stars this week and reaching 36,089 total stars, continuing to receive developer attention.
uses: Individual users: Create a private network across multiple devices for remote access and file sharing.
Development teams: Build secure development environments, simplifying inter-service communication and deployment.
System administrators: Manage geographically distributed server clusters with unified secure access policies.

zh.tag: 自托管聚合仪表盘，把订阅源集中一处
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量级、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，用于集中展示 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、天气、YouTube 等订阅源。它通过美观简洁的界面，让用户在一个页面中快速浏览所有信息流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务、YAML 配置文件示例、文档（配置、主题、预配置页面）、社区组件目录以及 Docker 部署支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖少量 JavaScript（原生），生成单一可执行文件（<20MB），支持多平台和 Docker 容器。
zh.hot: 凭借极低的资源占用、丰富的组件生态和高度可定制性，Glance 在自托管社区广受欢迎，目前已收获 36,682 颗星，今日新增 22 颗。
uses: 自托管爱好者：搭建个人信息中心，整合 RSS、新闻、天气等订阅源。
开发者和技术爱好者：监控 GitHub、Hacker News、Reddit 等技术社区动态。
追求效率的用户：通过自定义布局和主题，打造专属的极简仪表盘。

en.tag: Self-hosted dashboard aggregating all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates feeds like RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, weather, YouTube, and more. It presents all your information streams in a beautiful, streamlined interface for quick browsing.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, YAML configuration examples, documentation (configuration, themes, preconfigured pages), community widgets directory, and Docker deployment support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with minimal vanilla JavaScript, producing a single binary under 20MB for multiple OS/architectures, and a small Docker container.
en.hot: With its low resource usage, extensive widget ecosystem, and high customizability, Glance has gained popularity in the self-hosting community, amassing 36,682 stars with 22 added today.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: build a personal dashboard to aggregate RSS, news, weather, and more.
Developers and tech enthusiasts: monitor GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, and other tech communities.
Productivity-focused users: create a minimal, personalized dashboard with custom layouts and themes.

zh.tag: 可扩展的覆盖网络工具，兼顾性能、简单与安全
zh.what: Nebula 是一个可扩展的覆盖网络工具，旨在让分布在世界各地的计算机无缝连接。它基于 Noise 协议框架，使用证书认证节点身份，并通过灯塔节点实现 NAT 穿透，支持从少量到数万台设备的组网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nebula 的核心代码，包括证书管理、加密通信、安全组、灯塔节点等模块，以及适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的构建文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Noise 协议框架、椭圆曲线 Diffie-Hellman 密钥交换和 AES-256-GCM 加密。
zh.hot: Nebula 在 GitHub 上拥有 18k+ stars，今日新增 25 个，位列 Go 趋势榜第五，因其高性能、简单易用和安全性受到广泛关注。
uses: 适用于需要跨地域、跨云服务商安全组网的开发者和运维人员。
适合构建分布式系统或边缘计算场景，需要低延迟、高安全性的网络连接。
可用于个人或企业快速搭建虚拟专用网络，替代传统 VPN 方案。

en.tag: A scalable overlay networking tool focusing on performance, simplicity, and security
en.what: Nebula is a scalable overlay networking tool that enables seamless connection of computers worldwide. Built on the Noise Protocol Framework, it uses certificates for node authentication and lighthouse nodes for NAT traversal, supporting networks from a few to tens of thousands of devices.
en.content: The repository contains the core code of Nebula, including modules for certificate management, encrypted communication, security groups, lighthouse nodes, and build files for Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the Noise Protocol Framework, Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and AES-256-GCM encryption.
en.hot: With over 18k stars and 25 new stars today, ranking 5th on the Go trending list, Nebula gains attention for its high performance, simplicity, and security.
uses: For developers and operators needing secure networking across regions and cloud providers.
Ideal for distributed systems or edge computing requiring low-latency, high-security connections.
Can be used to quickly set up virtual private networks for individuals or enterprises, replacing traditional VPN solutions.

zh.tag: 自托管的开源任务管理器，数据完全自主掌控
zh.what: Vikunja 是一个功能全面的任务管理工具，支持看板、列表、表格等多种视图，以及团队协作、时间跟踪、文件附件等特性。它强调用户对数据的完全掌控，可自托管部署，也提供云端托管服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 应用、桌面客户端（Electron）以及移动端应用（通过 Flutter 实现），并提供完整的 API 文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 数据库；前端基于 Vue.js，桌面端使用 Electron，移动端使用 Flutter。
zh.hot: 本周新增 78 星，总星数 5258，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其自托管、数据自主的理念受到关注，且项目活跃，持续迭代。
uses: 个人用户希望完全掌控自己的任务数据，避免依赖第三方云服务
团队需要自建任务管理系统，并希望有看板、时间跟踪等高级功能
开发者想研究 Go 后端与前端分离的完整项目架构

en.tag: Self-hosted open-source task manager with full data ownership
en.what: Vikunja is a feature-rich task manager supporting kanban, list, table views, team collaboration, time tracking, file attachments, and more. It emphasizes full data ownership, allowing self-hosting or using the hosted cloud service.
en.content: The repository includes a backend service written in Go, a frontend web app, a desktop client (Electron), and mobile apps (via Flutter), along with comprehensive API docs and installation guides.
en.stack: Backend in Go with SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL support; frontend built with Vue.js; desktop via Electron; mobile via Flutter.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars this week, total 5258, ranking #19 on the Go weekly trending. Its self-hosting and data ownership philosophy attracts attention, with active development.
uses: Individuals who want full control over their task data without relying on third-party cloud services
Teams needing a self-hosted task management system with advanced features like kanban and time tracking
Developers interested in studying a full-stack project with Go backend and separate frontend

zh.tag: 云边一体的分布式应用可移植运行时
zh.what: Dapr 是一个可移植的运行时，用于构建云和边缘的分布式应用，结合事件驱动架构与工作流编排。它提供构建块 API，简化微服务开发，并支持持久执行和 AI 代理等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dapr 运行时核心代码（用 Go 编写），提供状态管理、发布订阅、服务调用、绑定、工作流等构建块，以及 CLI、文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 gRPC、HTTP、可插拔组件（如状态存储、消息队列），并支持多种语言 SDK。
zh.hot: Dapr 拥有 26k+ stars，作为 CNCF 项目持续活跃，本周新增 36 stars，因其在分布式应用和 AI 代理领域的实用性而备受关注。
uses: 微服务开发者：使用 Dapr 构建块快速实现分布式系统能力，无需关心底层基础设施。
云原生团队：在 Kubernetes 或边缘环境中部署可移植、事件驱动的应用。
AI 应用开发者：利用 Dapr 的持久执行和状态管理支持 AI 代理工作流。

en.tag: Portable runtime for distributed apps across cloud and edge
en.what: Dapr is a portable runtime for building distributed applications across cloud and edge, combining event-driven architecture with workflow orchestration. It provides building block APIs to simplify microservices development and supports durable execution and AI agents.
en.content: The repository contains the core Dapr runtime written in Go, offering building blocks like state management, pub/sub, service invocation, bindings, workflows, along with CLI, docs, and samples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging gRPC, HTTP, and pluggable components (e.g., state stores, message brokers), with SDKs for multiple languages.
en.hot: With over 26k stars, Dapr remains active as a CNCF project, gaining 36 stars this week, popular for its utility in distributed apps and AI agents.
uses: Microservices developers: quickly implement distributed system capabilities using Dapr building blocks without worrying about underlying infrastructure.
Cloud-native teams: deploy portable, event-driven applications in Kubernetes or edge environments.
AI application developers: leverage Dapr's durable execution and state management for AI agent workflows.

zh.tag: 分布式存储系统，支持对象存储、文件系统与 Iceberg 表
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个简单且高度可扩展的分布式文件系统，旨在存储数十亿文件并快速服务。它通过一个统一的二进制文件同时提供 S3 对象存储、POSIX 文件系统和 Iceberg 表（数据湖）功能，所有数据存储在同一套存储之上。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的 weed 二进制文件、文档（wiki）、示例配置、Docker 镜像支持，以及客户端库（如 Java、Go 等）。项目采用 Apache 2.0 许可，并接受 Patreon 赞助。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gRPC 进行通信，支持多种存储后端（如本地磁盘、云存储）。提供 S3 API 兼容接口和 FUSE 挂载支持。
zh.hot: 本周新增 137 颗星，总星数达 34,465，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其独特的 O(1) 磁盘访问设计和多协议支持吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要存储海量小文件并追求高吞吐的场景，如日志存储、图片存储等。
希望同时使用对象存储和文件系统，并需要与 S3 兼容的应用。
构建数据湖或需要 Iceberg 表格式支持的大数据平台。

en.tag: Distributed storage for S3 objects, POSIX FS, and Iceberg tables
en.what: SeaweedFS is a simple and highly scalable distributed file system designed to store billions of files and serve them fast. A single weed binary provides an S3 object store, a POSIX file system, and a lakehouse with Iceberg tables, all over the same data.
en.content: The repository contains the core weed binary, documentation (wiki), example configurations, Docker image support, and client libraries (e.g., Java, Go). It is Apache-2.0 licensed and accepts sponsors via Patreon.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, uses gRPC for communication, supports multiple storage backends (local disk, cloud storage). Provides S3-compatible API and FUSE mount support.
en.hot: Gained 137 stars this week, reaching 34,465 total, ranking 19th on the Go weekly trending list. Its unique O(1) disk access design and multi-protocol support attract significant attention.
uses: Scenarios requiring massive small file storage with high throughput, such as log or image storage.
Applications needing both object storage and a file system with S3 compatibility.
Data lake platforms that require Iceberg table format support.

zh.tag: 为 Ansible、Terraform 等 DevOps 工具提供现代 UI 和 API 的可视化运维平台
zh.what: Semaphore UI 是一个开源的可视化运维平台，为 Ansible、Terraform/OpenTofu/Terragrunt、PowerShell 等 DevOps 工具提供现代 Web 界面和强大 API。它允许用户轻松运行 playbook、Terraform 代码和脚本，接收失败任务通知，并控制部署系统的访问权限。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 后端和前端 UI 代码，提供 Docker 镜像、安装脚本、文档和演示环境。核心概念包括项目、任务模板、任务、调度、库存和变量组，支持通过 Web 界面或 API 管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能采用现代 JavaScript 框架（如 React 或 Vue），依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，支持多种数据库（如 PostgreSQL/MySQL）存储数据。
zh.hot: 随着 DevOps 实践普及，对可视化运维工具需求增长。Semaphore UI 提供简洁现代界面和强大 API，替代传统命令行操作，降低运维门槛。尽管本周新增 star 不多，但总星数 1.4 万表明其长期受欢迎。
uses: DevOps 工程师：通过 Web 界面管理 Ansible/Terraform 任务，替代繁琐的命令行操作。
中小团队：无需搭建复杂 CI/CD，快速实现自动化部署和运维。
需要可视化任务调度和权限控制的运维管理者。

en.tag: Modern UI and powerful API for Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu/Terragrunt, PowerShell and other DevOps tools
en.what: Semaphore UI is an open-source web interface for managing popular DevOps tools like Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu/Terragrunt, PowerShell, and more. It lets you run playbooks, Terraform code, and scripts easily, receive notifications about failed tasks, and control access to your deployment system.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go backend and frontend UI code, with Docker images, installation scripts, documentation, and a live demo. Key concepts include projects, task templates, tasks, schedules, inventory, and variable groups, all manageable via the web UI or API.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a modern JavaScript frontend (likely React or Vue). It uses Docker for containerized deployment and supports databases like PostgreSQL or MySQL for data storage.
en.hot: As DevOps practices grow, demand for visual operation tools rises. Semaphore UI offers a clean modern UI and powerful API, replacing traditional CLI operations and lowering the barrier. Despite modest weekly star gain, its 14k total stars indicate sustained popularity.
uses: DevOps engineers: manage Ansible/Terraform tasks via a web UI instead of CLI.
Small to medium teams: quickly implement automation without complex CI/CD setups.
Operators needing visual scheduling and access control for tasks.

zh.tag: 自托管 Tailscale 控制服务器的开源实现
zh.what: Headscale 是一个开源、可自托管的 Tailscale 控制服务器实现，用于管理 WireGuard 网络。它允许用户在没有第三方服务的情况下，创建和管理自己的私有 overlay 网络（tailnet），实现设备间的安全连接。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的控制服务器源码、文档、Nix 模块、开发构建配置及示例配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 WireGuard 协议，支持多种客户端操作系统，并提供容器镜像和二进制构建。
zh.hot: 随着远程工作和自托管需求的增长，用户寻求对网络基础设施的更多控制。Headscale 提供了 Tailscale 的开放替代方案，吸引了大量关注，Star 数超过 4.3 万，本周新增 302。
uses: 自托管爱好者希望摆脱对第三方 VPN 服务的依赖，建立自己的私有网络。
小型组织或团队需要为内部设备提供安全的远程访问，同时保持数据主权。
开发者希望深入理解 Tailscale 控制服务器的工作原理，或基于其进行二次开发。

en.tag: Open-source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server
en.what: Headscale is an open-source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server, which manages WireGuard networks. It allows users to create and manage their own private overlay networks (tailnets) without relying on third-party services, enabling secure connections between devices.
en.content: The repository contains the control server source code written in Go, documentation, Nix modules, development build configurations, and example configurations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on the WireGuard protocol, supports various client operating systems, and offers container images and binary builds.
en.hot: With the rise of remote work and self-hosting, users seek more control over their network infrastructure. Headscale offers an open alternative to Tailscale, attracting significant attention with over 43k stars and 302 new this week.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts who want to avoid third-party VPN services and establish their own private networks.
Small organizations or teams needing secure remote access for internal devices while maintaining data sovereignty.
Developers interested in understanding how the Tailscale control server works or building upon it.

zh.tag: 用闲置 Mac 构建的隐私保护推理网络
zh.what: Darkbloom 是一个去中心化的私有推理网络，将闲置的 Apple Silicon Mac 转化为 OpenAI 兼容的推理云。它通过硬件级安全措施确保提供商无法读取用户提示或模型响应，实现端到端加密和硬件认证。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的协调器（Go 编写，运行于 GCP 机密 VM）和提供商节点（Swift CLI，使用 MLX 进行进程内推理）的代码，以及消费者快速入门指南、API 接口文档、模型列表和定价说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go（协调器），提供商节点使用 Swift 和 MLX 框架，依赖 Apple Secure Enclave、Hardened Runtime、NaCl Box 加密和 Metal GPU。
zh.hot: 本周新增 64 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 7，因其创新地利用全球超 1 亿台闲置 Mac 提供隐私保护的 AI 推理，解决了去中心化计算中的核心隐私难题。
uses: 希望以低成本获得 AI 推理能力的开发者或企业，可替代传统云服务。
拥有闲置 Apple Silicon Mac 的用户，可通过提供算力赚取收入。
对数据隐私要求高的 AI 应用场景，如医疗、金融等敏感领域。

en.tag: Decentralized private inference network on idle Apple Silicon Macs
en.what: Darkbloom is a decentralized private-inference network that turns idle Apple Silicon Macs into an OpenAI-compatible inference cloud. It leverages hardware-level security to ensure providers cannot read prompts or responses, with end-to-end encryption and hardware attestation.
en.content: The repo contains the full coordinator (Go, running on GCP Confidential VM) and provider node (Swift CLI, using MLX for in-process inference) code, plus consumer quickstart, API surface docs, model list, and pricing.
en.stack: Primarily Go for the coordinator, Swift with MLX for providers, leveraging Apple Secure Enclave, Hardened Runtime, NaCl Box encryption, and Metal GPU.
en.hot: Gained 64 stars this week, ranking #7 on Go trending, due to its novel approach of turning over 100 million idle Macs into a privacy-preserving AI inference network, addressing the core privacy challenge in decentralized compute.
uses: Developers or enterprises seeking low-cost AI inference as an alternative to traditional cloud services.
Owners of idle Apple Silicon Macs who want to earn revenue by contributing compute.
AI applications with high privacy requirements, such as healthcare or finance.

zh.tag: 高性能云原生向量数据库，支撑 AI 非结构化数据检索
zh.what: Milvus 是一个专为大规模向量相似性搜索设计的高性能向量数据库。它能够高效组织和检索文本、图像等多模态非结构化数据，为 AI 应用提供底层数据支撑。支持分布式部署与实时流式更新，可处理数十亿向量和数万级 QPS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Milvus 的完整源代码，采用 Go 和 C++ 编写，提供 Standalone 单机模式和分布式集群模式，并包含 Milvus Lite 轻量版（可通过 pip 安装）以及云服务 Zilliz Cloud 的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 和 C++，利用 CPU/GPU 硬件加速实现高性能向量搜索，架构完全分布式且原生支持 Kubernetes，便于水平扩展。
zh.hot: Milvus 是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的向量数据库之一，拥有 45.8k 星标，今日新增 22 星并登上 Go 语言趋势榜。随着 AI 应用对向量检索需求的爆发，其高性能和云原生特性吸引了大量开发者。
uses: AI 应用开发者：构建 RAG、语义搜索、推荐系统等需要向量检索的功能。
数据工程师：管理大规模非结构化数据，实现实时流式更新和高效查询。
云原生架构师：在 Kubernetes 集群中部署可水平扩展的向量数据库服务。
机器学习工程师：利用 Milvus Lite 快速原型验证，或通过 Zilliz Cloud 免运维使用。

en.tag: High-performance cloud-native vector database for scalable AI search
en.what: Milvus is a high-performance vector database built for large-scale vector similarity search. It efficiently organizes and retrieves unstructured data like text, images, and multi-modal information, powering AI applications. It supports distributed deployment and real-time streaming updates, handling billions of vectors and tens of thousands of queries per second.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Milvus, written in Go and C++, offering Standalone mode for single-machine deployment and distributed cluster mode, along with Milvus Lite (pip installable) and integration with Zilliz Cloud managed service.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go and C++, leveraging CPU/GPU hardware acceleration for high-performance vector search. The architecture is fully distributed and K8s-native, enabling horizontal scaling.
en.hot: Milvus is one of the most popular vector databases on GitHub with 45.8k stars, gaining 22 stars today and trending in the Go category. The surge in AI applications requiring vector search has made its high performance and cloud-native features highly attractive.
uses: AI developers building RAG, semantic search, recommendation systems, and other vector-based features.
Data engineers managing large-scale unstructured data with real-time streaming updates and efficient queries.
Cloud-native architects deploying horizontally scalable vector databases on Kubernetes.
ML engineers prototyping quickly with Milvus Lite or using Zilliz Cloud for zero-ops managed service.

zh.tag: 基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 翻译层，让 Windows 游戏在 Linux 上流畅运行
zh.what: DXVK 是一个基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 翻译层，允许使用 Wine 在 Linux 上运行 3D 应用程序。它将 Direct3D API 调用转换为 Vulkan，从而提供更好的性能和兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DXVK 的源代码、构建脚本和文档。主要组件是 DLL 文件（d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll），用户将其复制到 Wine 前缀中并配置 DLL 覆盖即可使用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API 和 Wine 环境。构建系统采用 Meson，支持多种平台。
zh.hot: DXVK 是 Linux 游戏生态的关键组件，被 Steam Play、Lutris 等工具广泛使用。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期积累的 17972 个 star 反映了其在 Linux 玩家中的高认可度。
uses: Linux 玩家希望通过 Wine 运行 Windows 游戏，获得更好的性能和兼容性。
游戏开发者或测试人员需要在 Linux 上测试 Direct3D 游戏。
使用 Steam Play、Lutris、Bottles 等工具的用户，这些工具自动集成 DXVK。

en.tag: Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D, enabling Windows games on Linux
en.what: DXVK is a Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D 8/9/10/11, allowing 3D applications to run on Linux via Wine. It translates Direct3D API calls to Vulkan, offering better performance and compatibility.
en.content: The repository contains source code, build scripts, and documentation for DXVK. The main components are DLL files (d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll) that users copy into a Wine prefix and configure DLL overrides.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on Vulkan API and Wine environment. Build system uses Meson, supporting multiple platforms.
en.hot: DXVK is a key component in the Linux gaming ecosystem, widely used by Steam Play, Lutris, and other tools. Despite modest daily star growth, its 17,972 stars reflect high recognition among Linux gamers.
uses: Linux gamers who want to run Windows games via Wine with better performance and compatibility.
Game developers or testers who need to test Direct3D games on Linux.
Users of Steam Play, Lutris, Bottles, etc., which integrate DXVK automatically.

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: llama.cpp 高性能分支，新增 SOTA 量化与推理优化
zh.what: 这是 llama.cpp 的一个分支，专注于提供额外的 SOTA 量化类型和更好的 CPU 性能。它率先实现了多项 LLM 推理特性，如 MLA、量化重打包、张量并行等，并持续优化混合 CPU/GPU 推理。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 llama.cpp 代码库及分支特有的优化，如新的量化格式、推理内核和命令行选项。构建系统支持 CMake，提供 CPU 和 CUDA 后端，并包含详细的 README 说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 AVX2/AVX-512 和 ARM_NEON 等 CPU 指令集，以及 CUDA（Turing 及以上）GPU 后端。
zh.hot: 凭借在 llama.cpp 基础上的显著性能提升和领先的量化技术，吸引了大量追求极致推理性能的开发者。本周新增 77 星，总星数达 3166，位列 C++ 周榜第 11 名。
uses: 适合在 CPU 上运行大语言模型的开发者，希望获得比原版 llama.cpp 更高的推理速度。
需要尝试最新量化格式（如 K2_K、Q3_K 等）以在有限内存中运行模型的用户。
对 LLM 推理前沿特性（如 MLA、张量并行）感兴趣的研究者和工程师。

en.tag: llama.cpp fork with SOTA quantizations and better CPU performance
en.what: This is a fork of llama.cpp that offers additional SOTA quantization types and improved CPU performance. It pioneered several LLM inference features such as MLA, quant repacking, and tensor parallelism, and continuously optimizes hybrid CPU/GPU inference.
en.content: The repository contains the full llama.cpp codebase with fork-specific optimizations, including new quantization formats, inference kernels, and command-line options. The build system uses CMake, supports CPU and CUDA backends, and includes detailed README documentation.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, built with CMake, supporting CPU instruction sets like AVX2/AVX-512 and ARM_NEON, as well as CUDA (Turing or newer) GPU backend.
en.hot: With significant performance improvements over llama.cpp and cutting-edge quantization techniques, it attracts developers seeking ultimate inference performance. Gained 77 stars this week, reaching 3166 total, ranking 11th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Developers running LLMs on CPU who want higher inference speed than vanilla llama.cpp.
Users needing the latest quantization formats (e.g., K2_K, Q3_K) to fit models into limited memory.
Researchers and engineers interested in cutting-edge LLM inference features like MLA and tensor parallelism.

zh.tag: 基于MCP的AI语音聊天机器人，支持多终端控制
zh.what: 小智AI聊天机器人是一个基于MCP协议的语音交互入口，利用Qwen/DeepSeek等大模型的AI能力，实现多终端控制。它支持离线语音唤醒、全双工对话、视觉输入等功能，可运行在多种ESP32芯片上。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源码、文档、硬件设计参考，以及用于自定义资源（唤醒词、字体、表情等）的在线生成器。支持Wi-Fi、4G等多种网络连接，并集成了ESP-SR语音识别、OLED/LCD显示等功能。
zh.stack: 基于ESP-IDF（v6.0+）开发，使用C++编写，依赖ESP-SR、MCP协议、WebSocket/MQTT+UDP通信，以及Opus音频编解码。
zh.hot: 近30k星标，本周新增近400，因其将AI聊天机器人落地到低成本硬件，且功能丰富、可玩性高，在GitHub Trending C++榜上排名第四。
uses: 硬件爱好者：DIY一个能语音对话、带视觉的AI机器人，体验全双工交互。
开发者：学习ESP32开发、MCP协议集成，或扩展智能家居控制。
教育者：作为AI+物联网教学项目，展示语音识别、大模型调用等。

en.tag: An MCP-based AI voice chatbot with multi-terminal control
en.what: XiaoZhi AI chatbot is a voice interaction entry leveraging MCP protocol and large models like Qwen/DeepSeek for multi-terminal control. It supports offline wake-up, full-duplex conversation, vision input, and runs on various ESP32 chips.
en.content: The repo includes complete firmware source, docs, hardware design references, and an online generator for custom assets (wake words, fonts, emojis). It supports Wi-Fi/4G networking, ESP-SR speech recognition, OLED/LCD display, and more.
en.stack: Built on ESP-IDF (v6.0+) with C++, using ESP-SR, MCP protocol, WebSocket/MQTT+UDP communication, and Opus audio codec.
en.hot: With ~30k stars and ~400 added this week, it ranks #4 on GitHub Trending C++ because it brings AI chatbots to low-cost hardware with rich features and high hackability.
uses: Hardware enthusiasts: DIY a voice-interactive AI robot with vision and full-duplex conversation.
Developers: Learn ESP32 development, MCP integration, or extend smart home control.
Educators: Use as an AI+IoT teaching project to demonstrate speech recognition and LLM calls.

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Python 3 等开发环境。
zh.hot: 作为进程内分析数据库的标杆，DuckDB 凭借其极简部署和高性能查询，在数据科学领域迅速走红，star 数已突破 4 万，今日新增 69 个。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，希望在 Python 或 R 环境中快速分析大型数据集，无需单独部署数据库服务器。
数据工程师，需要将 CSV/Parquet 文件直接作为 SQL 查询源，简化数据管道。
应用开发者，希望嵌入分析能力到现有应用中，提供轻量级 OLAP 功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database, blazing fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, and supports Python 3 for development.
en.hot: As a benchmark for in-process analytical databases, DuckDB has gained rapid popularity in data science due to its minimal deployment and high-performance queries, with over 40k stars and 69 new today.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who want to quickly analyze large datasets in Python or R without deploying a separate database server.
Data engineers who need to query CSV/Parquet files directly as SQL sources to simplify data pipelines.
Application developers who want to embed analytical capabilities into existing applications for lightweight OLAP functionality.

zh.tag: 强大易用的跨平台截图工具
zh.what: Flameshot 是一款功能强大且易于使用的开源截图软件，支持 GNU/Linux、Windows 和 macOS。它提供丰富的标注、编辑和分享功能，用户可以通过图形界面或命令行快速截取屏幕并添加箭头、文字、高亮等元素。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、安装包配置（如 Snap、Flatpak）以及多语言翻译资源。项目采用 C++ 编写，主要目录包括 src（核心逻辑）、data（图标和预览图）和 docs（用户手册）。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Qt 框架开发，支持跨平台构建，使用 CMake 作为构建系统，并集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 3 万 Star，本周新增 65 个，因其简洁易用且功能丰富而广受好评，是 Linux 用户最喜爱的截图工具之一。
uses: 日常办公或开发中需要快速截图并标注说明的用户
寻找开源、跨平台截图替代品的个人或团队
需要命令行截图和自动化脚本的开发者

en.tag: Powerful yet simple cross-platform screenshot tool
en.what: Flameshot is a powerful yet simple open-source screenshot software for GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS. It offers rich annotation, editing, and sharing features, allowing users to capture the screen and add arrows, text, highlights, and more via GUI or CLI.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, packaging configs (e.g., Snap, Flatpak), and translation resources. Written in C++, key directories include src (core logic), data (icons and previews), and docs (user manual).
en.stack: Built with C++ and Qt framework, cross-platform, using CMake as the build system and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 65 new this week, it's widely praised for its simplicity and rich features, making it one of the most beloved screenshot tools among Linux users.
uses: Users who need quick screenshot capture and annotation for daily work or development
Individuals or teams seeking an open-source, cross-platform screenshot alternative
Developers who require CLI screenshot and automation scripting

zh.tag: 一站式 3D 高斯泼溅工作站
zh.what: LichtFeld Studio 是一个原生的模块化工作站，用于训练、检查、编辑、自动化和导出 3D 高斯泼溅场景。它整合了模型训练、实时可视化、高斯编辑、导出、插件和自动化于一个工具链中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心、GUI 可视化器、Python 插件系统、MCP 支持、文档和示例资源。提供 Windows 下载和源码构建指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 构建，集成 Python 插件和 MCP 协议，支持 COLMAP 数据集和 3D 高斯泼溅技术。
zh.hot: 本周新增 62 星，总星数达 3627，在 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜排名第四。因其一站式解决 3D 高斯泼溅全流程而受到关注。
uses: 3D 重建研究人员和开发者，需要训练和编辑高斯泼溅模型。
视觉特效和游戏开发者，需要导出高质量 3D 场景。
自动化工作流爱好者，希望通过 MCP 或 Python 插件扩展功能。

en.tag: All-in-one workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
en.what: LichtFeld Studio is a native modular workstation for training, inspecting, editing, automating, and exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. It combines model training, real-time visualization, gaussian editing, export, plugins, and automation into one toolchain.
en.content: The repository includes a C++ core, GUI visualizer, Python plugin system, MCP support, documentation, and sample assets. Offers Windows downloads and build-from-source instructions.
en.stack: Primarily built with C++, integrates Python plugins and MCP protocol, supports COLMAP datasets and 3D Gaussian Splatting.
en.hot: Gained 62 stars this week, reaching 3627 total, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending C++ weekly. It attracts attention for its all-in-one workflow for 3D Gaussian Splatting.
uses: 3D reconstruction researchers and developers needing to train and edit Gaussian Splatting models.
VFX and game developers needing to export high-quality 3D scenes.
Automation enthusiasts wanting to extend functionality via MCP or Python plugins.

zh.tag: 轻量高效的机器学习张量库，支持多平台与量化
zh.what: ggml 是一个面向机器学习的张量库，旨在以极简配置实现高效计算。它采用纯 C/C++ 编写，无外部依赖，支持多种硬件架构和量化格式，是许多 AI 推理引擎的基础组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心张量库源码、CMake 构建系统、示例（如矩阵乘法），以及 GGUF 文件格式文档和 Hugging Face 博客介绍等资源。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，无外部依赖；支持 x86、ARM、RISC-V 等架构的 SIMD 优化内核，以及 CPU、GPU、NPU 和浏览器后端。
zh.hot: 作为 llama.cpp 等热门项目的核心依赖，ggml 持续获得关注。本周新增 55 星，总星数达 15293，位列 C++ 周榜第 17，反映出其在 AI 推理领域的重要地位。
uses: AI 推理引擎开发者：希望构建高效、跨平台推理框架的团队或个人。
嵌入式或边缘计算场景：需要在资源受限设备上运行机器学习模型的开发者。
研究量化技术的人员：关注 2-8 位整数量化及 MXFP4/NVFP4 等新格式的学者。

en.tag: Lightweight, portable tensor library for ML with broad backend support
en.what: ggml is a tensor library for machine learning designed for simplicity and efficiency with minimal setup. Written in plain C/C++ with no dependencies, it supports various hardware architectures and quantization formats, serving as a foundational component for many AI inference engines.
en.content: The repository contains core tensor library source code, CMake build system, examples (e.g., matrix multiplication), and documentation for the GGUF file format, along with a Hugging Face blog introduction.
en.stack: Implemented in plain C/C++ with zero dependencies; includes SIMD-optimized kernels for x86, ARM, RISC-V, and supports CPU, GPU, NPU, and browser backends.
en.hot: As a core dependency for popular projects like llama.cpp, ggml consistently garners attention. With 55 new stars this week and a total of 15,293, it ranks #17 on the C++ weekly trending list, highlighting its significance in AI inference.
uses: AI inference engine developers: teams or individuals aiming to build efficient, cross-platform inference frameworks.
Embedded or edge computing scenarios: developers needing to run ML models on resource-constrained devices.
Researchers in quantization: those focusing on 2-8 bit integer quantization and new formats like MXFP4/NVFP4.

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方 UI 框架，WinUI 是 Windows 应用开发的核心，本月新增 140 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 5，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: Windows desktop app developers wanting modern Fluent Design
Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: 单文件分发运行大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: llamafile 将 llama.cpp 与 Cosmopolitan Libc 结合，把大语言模型打包成单个可执行文件，用户无需安装即可在多数操作系统和 CPU 架构上本地运行。它还包含 whisperfile，实现单文件的语音转文字功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 llamafile 的源码、构建系统、文档以及预构建的 llamafile 可执行文件示例。它基于 llama.cpp 和 whisper.cpp，并支持多种模型格式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Cosmopolitan Libc 实现跨平台可执行性，并集成 llama.cpp 和 whisper.cpp。
zh.hot: 凭借单文件运行大模型的极简体验，llamafile 获得近 2.6 万星标，今日新增 48，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 8，深受开发者喜爱。
uses: 开发者：快速分发和测试 LLM 应用，无需配置复杂环境。
终端用户：在个人电脑上轻松运行聊天或语音转文字模型。
教育场景：演示 LLM 能力，降低学习门槛。

en.tag: Distribute and run LLMs as a single cross-platform executable
en.what: llamafile combines llama.cpp with Cosmopolitan Libc to package LLMs into a single executable that runs locally on most OSes and CPU architectures without installation. It also includes whisperfile, a single-file speech-to-text tool.
en.content: The repo contains source code, build system, docs, and pre-built llamafile executables. It's based on llama.cpp and whisper.cpp, supporting multiple model formats.
en.stack: Primarily C++, leveraging Cosmopolitan Libc for cross-platform executables, integrating llama.cpp and whisper.cpp.
en.hot: With its minimalist single-file LLM execution, llamafile has gained ~26k stars, +48 today, ranking #8 on C++ trending, beloved by developers.

End users: easily run chat or speech-to-text models on personal computers.
Educational: demonstrate LLM capabilities with low barrier to entry.

zh.tag: 智能家居互操作标准 Matter 的官方开源 SDK
zh.what: Matter（原 Project CHIP）旨在统一智能家居设备通信协议，让不同品牌设备能无缝协作。该仓库提供完整的参考实现，帮助制造商快速开发兼容 Matter 的设备，同时提升消费者的设备兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Matter 协议栈的 C++ 实现、多平台示例（如 ESP32、EFR32、Android 等）以及丰富的文档和测试仪表盘。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，支持多种嵌入式平台和操作系统，依赖 Zephyr/FreeRTOS 等 RTOS，并集成 CI 自动化构建与测试。
zh.hot: 作为智能家居互操作标准的官方实现，持续获得关注，当前 8.9k star 且每日新增，反映了 Matter 生态的活跃。
uses: 智能家居设备制造商：快速实现 Matter 兼容，缩短产品上市时间。
嵌入式开发者：学习参考协议栈实现，适配新硬件平台。
测试与认证机构：利用测试用例和仪表盘验证设备互操作性。

en.tag: Official open-source SDK for Matter, the smart home interoperability standard
en.what: Matter (formerly Project CHIP) unifies smart home device communication protocols, enabling seamless interoperability across brands. This repository provides a full reference implementation, helping manufacturers build Matter-compatible devices and improving consumer compatibility.
en.content: The repo contains the Matter protocol stack in C++, multi-platform examples (e.g., ESP32, EFR32, Android), plus extensive docs and test dashboards.
en.stack: Primarily C++, supporting various embedded platforms and OSes, with dependencies on RTOS like Zephyr/FreeRTOS, and integrated CI for automated builds and tests.
en.hot: As the official implementation of the smart home interoperability standard, it maintains steady attention, with 8.9k stars and daily additions, reflecting the vibrant Matter ecosystem.
uses: Smart home device manufacturers: quickly achieve Matter compliance and shorten time-to-market.
Embedded developers: study the reference stack and port to new hardware platforms.
Testing and certification bodies: use test suites and dashboards to verify interoperability.

zh.tag: 原生集成AI代理的Windows终端
zh.what: Intelligent Terminal是Windows Terminal的实验性分支，原生集成了AI代理功能。它支持任何符合Agent Client Protocol (ACP)的代理CLI，如GitHub Copilot CLI，让用户在命令行中直接与AI交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端源代码、构建脚本、文档和示例配置。主要功能包括代理状态栏、代理面板、代理管理、错误检测和命令面板，并提供Microsoft Store和WinGet安装方式。
zh.stack: 基于C++开发，依赖Windows Terminal代码库和Agent Client Protocol (ACP)。支持Windows 10 2004及以上版本，默认集成GitHub Copilot CLI。
zh.hot: 本周新增119星，总星数达1919，登上GitHub C++周榜。作为微软官方出品，将AI代理无缝集成到日常终端，引发开发者关注。
uses: 开发者希望在命令行中直接使用AI辅助编程，如代码生成、错误排查
Windows用户想要一个原生支持AI代理的终端，无需切换应用
对Windows Terminal功能熟悉，希望扩展AI能力的用户

en.tag: Windows Terminal fork with native AI agent integration
en.what: Intelligent Terminal is an experimental fork of Windows Terminal with native agent integration. It works with any Agent Client Protocol (ACP)-compatible agent CLI, such as GitHub Copilot CLI, enabling direct AI interaction in the command line.
en.content: The repository contains the full terminal source code, build scripts, documentation, and sample configurations. Key features include an agent status bar, agent pane, agent management, error detection, and command palette, with installation via Microsoft Store and WinGet.
en.stack: Developed in C++, built on the Windows Terminal codebase and the Agent Client Protocol (ACP). Requires Windows 10 2004 or later, with GitHub Copilot CLI as the default agent.
en.hot: Gained 119 stars this week, reaching 1919 total, ranking #18 on GitHub's C++ weekly trending. As an official Microsoft project, it integrates AI agents seamlessly into the daily terminal, attracting developer attention.

Windows users seeking a terminal with native AI agent support without switching apps
Users familiar with Windows Terminal who want to extend it with AI capabilities

zh.tag: 跨平台深度相机 SDK，支持深度与彩色流
zh.what: RealSense SDK 2.0 是一个用于 RealSense 深度相机的跨平台库，支持深度和彩色流，并提供内参和外参校准信息。它允许开发者访问相机的硬件功能，进行实时深度感知和图像处理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SDK 的源代码、示例、文档和构建脚本，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#）和平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 USB 和网络连接，集成 librealsense 核心库及各种后端。

uses: 机器人开发者：用于导航、避障和物体识别，实现实时深度感知。
计算机视觉研究者：获取高质量深度数据，进行算法开发和验证。
AR/VR 应用开发者：利用深度摄像头实现手势识别和环境交互。

en.tag: Cross-platform SDK for RealSense depth cameras with depth and color streaming
en.what: RealSense SDK 2.0 is a cross-platform library for RealSense depth cameras, enabling depth and color streaming and providing intrinsic and extrinsic calibration info. It allows developers to access camera hardware features for real-time depth sensing and image processing.
en.content: The repository contains SDK source code, examples, documentation, and build scripts, with bindings for multiple languages (e.g., Python, C#) and platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, supports USB and network connections, integrating the librealsense core library and various backends.

AR/VR app developers: to enable gesture recognition and environment interaction using depth cameras.

zh.tag: 离线语音AI全家桶，跨平台多语言支持
zh.what: sherpa-onnx 是一个基于下一代 Kaldi 和 onnxruntime 的离线语音处理工具包，支持语音识别、语音合成、说话人分离、语音增强、声源分离和 VAD 等功能。它无需互联网连接即可在本地运行，适用于嵌入式系统、移动端、桌面和服务器等多种平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 核心库、多种编程语言的 API 绑定（如 Python、Java、Go、Rust 等），以及针对 Flutter 和 Tauri 的预构建 demo 应用。还提供对多种 NPU（如 Rockchip、Qualcomm、Ascend）的支持，并附带详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 实现，依赖 onnxruntime 和下一代 Kaldi 技术。支持多种硬件架构（x86, ARM, RISC-V）和 NPU 加速，并提供跨语言绑定。
zh.hot: 本周新增 157 星，总星数达 1.46 万，位列 C++ 周榜第 21。其强大的离线能力和广泛的平台支持吸引了大量开发者，尤其是嵌入式与移动端场景。
uses: 嵌入式开发者：在 Raspberry Pi、RISC-V 等设备上实现离线语音识别与合成
移动应用开发者：为 Android/iOS 应用集成语音功能，无需网络连接
桌面与服务器应用：利用多语言 API 快速部署语音处理服务
AI 研究者：测试和评估多种语音任务模型，支持 NPU 加速

en.tag: Offline speech AI toolkit: ASR, TTS, VAD, diarization, etc., cross-platform & multi-language
en.what: sherpa-onnx is an offline speech processing toolkit built on next-gen Kaldi and onnxruntime, supporting speech-to-text, text-to-speech, speaker diarization, speech enhancement, source separation, and VAD. It runs locally without internet, targeting embedded systems, mobile, desktop, and servers.
en.content: The repo includes a C++ core library, API bindings for 12+ languages (Python, Java, Go, Rust, etc.), and pre-built demo apps for Flutter and Tauri. It also supports various NPUs (Rockchip, Qualcomm, Ascend) with comprehensive docs and examples.
en.stack: Implemented in C++, leveraging onnxruntime and next-gen Kaldi. Supports multiple architectures (x86, ARM, RISC-V) and NPU acceleration, with bindings for many languages.
en.hot: Gained 157 stars this week, reaching 14.6k total, ranking #21 on C++ weekly. Its robust offline capabilities and broad platform support attract developers, especially for embedded and mobile use.

Mobile app developers: integrate speech features into Android/iOS apps without internet.
Desktop/server developers: deploy speech services using multi-language APIs.
AI researchers: evaluate models for various speech tasks with NPU acceleration.

zh.tag: 命令行多协议高速下载利器
zh.what: aria2 是一款轻量级、多协议、多来源的命令行下载工具，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、FTP、SFTP、BitTorrent 和 Metalink。它能从多个来源或协议同时下载文件，并充分利用带宽，甚至支持将 HTTP/FTP 下载的数据上传至 BitTorrent 群。
zh.content: 仓库包含 aria2 的完整源代码、构建配置、文档（在线手册）以及测试用例。核心是一个 C++ 编写的命令行程序，可运行于多种平台，并支持 JSON-RPC/XML-RPC 接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenSSL、libxml2 等库，支持跨平台（Linux、Windows、macOS 等）。构建系统采用 Autotools 或 CMake。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 4.1 万 star，是下载工具领域的经典开源项目。尽管本周新增 star 不多，但长期稳定增长，因其功能强大且持续维护，在开发者中口碑极佳。
uses: 开发者或高级用户需要快速下载大文件或批量下载时，可用 aria2 命令行工具。
需要从多种协议（如 HTTP、FTP、BT）同时下载同一文件以加速的场景。
在服务器或嵌入式环境中作为下载组件，通过 JSON-RPC 接口集成到自动化脚本。

en.tag: A lightweight command-line download utility supporting multiple protocols and sources
en.what: aria2 is a lightweight, multi-protocol, multi-source command-line download utility supporting HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, BitTorrent, and Metalink. It can download files from multiple sources or protocols simultaneously to maximize bandwidth usage, and even supports uploading data downloaded via HTTP/FTP to a BitTorrent swarm.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build configuration, documentation (online manual), and test cases for aria2. The core is a command-line program written in C++, running on multiple platforms, with JSON-RPC/XML-RPC interface support.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depending on libraries like OpenSSL and libxml2, with cross-platform support (Linux, Windows, macOS). Build system uses Autotools or CMake.
en.hot: With over 41k stars, it's a classic open-source download utility. Despite modest weekly growth, its long-term steady increase reflects its powerful features and active maintenance, earning high praise among developers.
uses: For developers or power users needing fast downloads of large files or batch downloads via command line.
When you need to download the same file from multiple protocols (HTTP, FTP, BT) simultaneously to accelerate speed.
For integrating aria2 as a download component in servers or embedded environments via JSON-RPC for automation.

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。

希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.

Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: 自改进递归语言模型智能体，面向编码与长时自主任务
zh.what: Prime Agent 是一个开源的编码与研究智能体，专为通用和长期运行的任务设计。它基于递归语言模型（RLM）和持续框架（Continual Harness）两个核心抽象，使智能体能在持久会话中自我改进。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心智能体包、文档、CI 配置和二进制构建脚本。核心是持久化 Python REPL 环境，支持文件操作、shell 命令、子代理调用和上下文管理。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，但核心控制环境是 Python。依赖包括持续框架、RLM 实现和相关验证器。
zh.hot: 本月新增近 2 万 star，位居 GitHub Trending 月榜第三，因其创新的自我改进机制和面向长时任务的实用性而备受关注。
uses: 开发者用于自动化编码工作流，如代码生成、重构和测试。
研究人员用于长期自主研究任务，如数据收集和实验运行。
需要持久化上下文和可复用子代理的复杂任务场景。

en.tag: Self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks
en.what: Prime Agent is an open-source coding and research agent designed for general and long-running tasks. It is built around two core abstractions: the Recursive Language Model (RLM) and the Continual Harness, enabling self-improvement within persistent sessions.
en.content: The repository contains core agent packages, documentation, CI configs, and binary build scripts. The core is a persistent Python REPL environment supporting file operations, shell commands, subagent calls, and context management.
en.stack: Primary language is TypeScript, but the core control environment is Python. Dependencies include the Continual Harness, RLM implementation, and related verifiers.
en.hot: With nearly 20k stars added this month, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending monthly, it gains attention for its innovative self-improvement mechanism and practicality for long-running tasks.

Researchers conducting long-running autonomous tasks such as data gathering and experiment runs.
Complex scenarios requiring persistent context and reusable subagents.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源 Palantir，图原生上下文与可问责基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它支持企业数据接入、上下文图与知识图谱构建，并提供图分析与因果推理，内置完整的决策溯源，确保可解释、可追踪和可信赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档与示例，支持 RDF 和 LPG 多语言图存储，遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理与决策智能模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.8+，依赖图数据库（如 RDF 三元组存储和属性图数据库），集成知识图谱与因果推理库，遵循 W3C 标准，提供开放 API 与 PyPI 分发。
zh.hot: 本月新增超 1 万 star，位居趋势榜第二，因其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，切中高监管领域对可解释、可溯源 AI 的迫切需求，同时强调开放、治理与零厂商锁定。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统提供可靠上下文与决策溯源，满足合规审计要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用 RDF/LPG 标准构建可互操作的知识模型，并进行图分析与推理。
高监管行业（金融、医疗、政务）：要求 AI 决策可解释、可追踪，降低风险并提升信任。
AI 基础设施研究者：探索图原生架构与因果推理在 AI 系统中的应用，构建可问责的智能体。

en.tag: Open-source Palantir for AI agents: graph-native context & accountable AI infrastructure
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds context and knowledge graphs, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance baked in, making AI explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, and examples, supporting polyglot graph storage with RDF and LPG, W3C standards, ontology management, and decision intelligence modules.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.8+, leveraging graph databases (RDF triple stores and property graphs), integrating knowledge graph and causal reasoning libraries, following W3C standards, with open APIs and PyPI distribution.
en.hot: With over 10k stars added this month and ranking #2 on the trending list, it's hot because it positions as the 'open-source Palantir for AI agents', addressing the urgent need for explainable and traceable AI in regulated domains, while emphasizing openness, governance, and zero vendor lock-in.
uses: Enterprise AI teams needing reliable context and decision provenance for agent systems to meet compliance and audit requirements.
Knowledge graph developers looking to build interoperable knowledge models using RDF/LPG standards with graph analytics and reasoning.
Regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government) requiring explainable and traceable AI decisions to reduce risk and build trust.
AI infrastructure researchers exploring graph-native architectures and causal reasoning for accountable intelligent agents.

en.hot: Gained 190 stars today and hit the trending list, as the Claude plugin ecosystem is rapidly growing and developers need an official source for plugins.
uses: Claude Code users: quickly install community plugins via CLI to extend functionality.
Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.
Enterprise teams: use security-reviewed plugins in controlled environments.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 用知识图谱增强的代码库 RAG 引擎
zh.what: Code-Graph-RAG 是一个面向多语言代码库的 RAG 系统，利用 Tree-sitter 解析代码并构建知识图谱，支持用自然语言查询、理解和编辑代码。它统一了混合语言 monorepo 的图模式，让 AI 能深入理解代码结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心解析器、图构建模块、查询接口、Agentic QA 基准测试工具，以及重复代码检测功能。提供 CLI 和 Python API，支持与主流 LLM 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Tree-sitter 进行代码解析，Memgraph 作为图数据库，支持多种 LLM 后端。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手普及，开发者需要更精准的代码理解工具。该项目将知识图谱与 RAG 结合，解决多语言仓库的复杂查询问题，上线不久即获近 5000 star，日增 20，登上 Python 趋势榜。
uses: 大型 monorepo 的开发者，需要快速定位和理解跨语言代码依赖。
AI 编程工具团队，希望增强代码检索和编辑的准确性。
代码质量工程师，利用重复代码检测和知识图谱分析架构。

en.tag: Knowledge-graph-powered RAG engine for codebases
en.what: Code-Graph-RAG is a RAG system for multi-language codebases. It parses code with Tree-sitter, builds a knowledge graph in Memgraph, and lets you query, edit, and optimize code in plain English. It unifies mixed-language monorepos under a single graph schema.
en.content: The repo includes core parser, graph builder, query interface, agentic QA benchmark harness, and duplicate code detection. It offers CLI and Python API, with integrations for major LLMs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, using Tree-sitter for parsing, Memgraph as the graph database, and supports multiple LLM backends.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants proliferate, developers need more precise code understanding. This project combines knowledge graphs with RAG to solve complex queries in multi-language repos, gaining nearly 5k stars quickly and trending on Python daily.
uses: Developers in large monorepos needing to quickly locate and understand cross-language dependencies.
AI coding tool teams aiming to enhance code retrieval and editing accuracy.
Code quality engineers using duplicate detection and graph-based architecture analysis.

zh.tag: X 平台 For You 信息流核心算法开源
zh.what: 该仓库包含 X（原 Twitter）For You 信息流中决定用户看到哪些帖子的核心代码。它结合用户关注的内容（网络内）和通过机器学习检索发现的内容（网络外），经过过滤和排序后，使用 Transformer 模型对帖子进行排名。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统架构文档、请求路径和标注路径说明，以及多个组件目录，如 home-mixer（含评分器、过滤器、参数）、可见性过滤、模型训练代码和合成数据生成代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，涉及机器学习模型（如 Transformer）、参数配置、过滤逻辑和实验框架。依赖包括用于模型训练的 Phoenix 模型相关代码。
zh.hot: 作为 X 平台核心算法的开源实现，吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标超过 3.2 万，月榜第 11 名。其透明化举措和近期更新（如巴西选举过滤）引发热议。
uses: 对推荐系统、信息流排序感兴趣的开发者，可研究其架构和实现细节。
希望了解 X 平台内容过滤和排名机制的研究者或记者。
需要参考大规模生产级算法工程实践的工程师。

en.tag: Open-source core algorithm powering X's For You feed
en.what: This repository contains the core code that determines which posts a viewer sees in the For You feed on X. It combines in-network content from followed accounts with out-of-network content discovered via ML-based retrieval, filters based on various inputs, and ranks posts using a transformer model.
en.content: The repo includes system architecture docs, request and labeling path explanations, and component directories like home-mixer (with scorers, filters, params), visibility filtering, model training code, and synthetic data generation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, involving ML models (e.g., Transformer), parameter configuration, filtering logic, and experimentation frameworks. Dependencies include Phoenix model training code and synthetic data generation.
en.hot: As the open-source implementation of X's core algorithm, it has attracted significant attention with over 32k stars, ranking 11th on the monthly trending. Its transparency and recent updates (e.g., Brazil election filter) spark discussions.
uses: Developers interested in recommendation systems and feed ranking can study its architecture and implementation details.
Researchers or journalists wanting to understand X's content filtering and ranking mechanisms.
Engineers seeking reference for large-scale production-grade algorithm engineering practices.

zh.tag: 企业级 AI 代理工作台，基于 Cloudflare Workers
zh.what: Cloudflare OS 是一个面向企业内部的 AI 生产力环境，员工可以通过代理聊天界面让 AI 代理执行任务，并利用沙箱环境创建和分享小型应用。它提供安全框架 Gatekeepers，确保非技术用户也能安全使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 v2 重写代码，提供本地运行和部署到 Cloudflare 账户的选项。包含代理聊天 UI、应用开发沙箱、安全框架等核心组件，以及文档和示例工作区。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Cloudflare Workers 和 workerd 运行时，通过 pnpm 管理依赖，支持本地开发与云端部署。
zh.hot: 本月新增近万 star，因其将 AI 代理与安全沙箱结合，为企业提供可定制的 AI 工作系统，吸引大量关注。
uses: 企业内部员工日常使用 AI 代理辅助工作，如生成幻灯片、修复文档错误。
开发者基于此框架构建定制化的公司级 AI 操作系统。
技术团队评估和部署安全的 AI 代理环境。

en.tag: Enterprise AI agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers
en.what: Cloudflare OS is an AI productivity environment for enterprises, where employees can delegate tasks to AI agents via chat and build/share small apps in a sandbox. It includes a security framework called Gatekeepers to keep non-technical users safe.
en.content: The repo contains the full v2 rewrite, with options to run locally or deploy to your Cloudflare account. It includes the agent chat UI, app development sandbox, security framework, plus docs and sample workspaces.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Cloudflare Workers and workerd, managed via pnpm, supports local dev and cloud deployment.
en.hot: Gained ~9.5k stars in a month, as it offers a customizable AI agent workspace with security, appealing to enterprises.
uses: Enterprise employees using AI agents for daily tasks like slide creation and doc fixing.
Developers building customized company AI OS on this framework.
Tech teams evaluating secure AI agent deployment.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 自托管分布式 Durable Objects 守护进程
zh.what: celld 是一个开源守护进程，让你在自己的机器上运行 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects。每个对象是一个 cell，即一个带有独立 SQLite 数据库的命名服务器。它使用你拥有的对象存储（如 S3）保存长期状态，无需控制平面或共识服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 celld 的 Rust 源码、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置、文档（包括 guarantees.md）以及示例。核心是一个嵌入 V8 的节点进程，执行 Wrangler bundles，并通过条件写入和签名 HTTP 实现分布式协调。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，嵌入 V8 引擎执行 JavaScript/Workers。依赖 SQLite 进行本地存储，LTX 格式用于复制，支持 S3、GCS 和 Azure Blob 存储。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4433 星，总星数达 4487，说明开发者对自托管 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects 的需求强烈。它提供了无需共识协议的分布式持久化方案，成本低且架构新颖。
uses: 希望摆脱 Cloudflare 锁定、自建边缘计算平台的开发者
需要在自有基础设施上运行 Durable Objects 的团队
对分布式系统设计感兴趣、想研究无共识复制方案的技术爱好者

en.tag: Self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects daemon
en.what: celld is an open-source daemon that runs Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects on your own machines. Each object is a cell: a named server with its own SQLite database. It stores long-term state in a bucket you own (S3-compatible, GCS, or Azure Blob) and requires no serving control plane or consensus service.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for celld, installation scripts, Docker image configuration, documentation (including guarantees.md), and examples. The core is a node process embedding V8 to execute Wrangler bundles, using conditional writes and signed HTTP for distributed coordination.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, embedding the V8 engine to execute JavaScript/Workers. Uses SQLite for local storage, LTX format for replication, and supports S3, GCS, and Azure Blob storage.
en.hot: With 4,433 stars added this month (total 4,487), it shows strong demand for self-hosting Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects. It offers a distributed persistence solution without consensus protocols, low cost, and a novel architecture.
uses: Developers who want to avoid Cloudflare lock-in and self-host edge computing platforms
Teams needing to run Durable Objects on their own infrastructure
Tech enthusiasts interested in distributed systems design and consensus-free replication

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上原生多 token 预测加速的本地 LLM 运行器
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个原生 Mac 应用和命令行工具，用于在 Apple Silicon 上运行本地大语言模型。它利用模型内置的多 token 预测（MTP）头，通过自推测解码和精确拒绝采样，在保持输出分布不变的情况下显著加速生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Mac 应用（DMG 下载）和命令行工具（brew/pip 安装），提供模型推荐、自动下载、引擎配置、风扇控制等功能。内置针对 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的优化版本，并附有详细的 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，使用 MLX 框架，依赖 Apple Silicon 的 Metal 性能。应用层采用原生 Mac 技术，CLI 支持 Homebrew 和 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 本月新增 714 星，总星数 1824，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（Python）第 18 名。其宣称的 2 倍加速和无需外部草稿模型的特性，吸引了大量 Apple Silicon 用户的关注。
uses: 在 Mac 上本地运行 LLM 的开发者，希望获得更快的推理速度而不牺牲输出质量。
需要离线或隐私保护的 AI 编码助手，特别是使用 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的场景。
对推测解码技术感兴趣的研究者，希望参考其实现或进行二次开发。

en.tag: Native multi-token prediction LLM runner for Apple Silicon, ~2x faster
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI for running local LLMs on Apple Silicon. It leverages built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) heads to speculatively draft and verify multiple tokens per step, achieving up to 2.24x speedup while preserving the exact output distribution.
en.content: The repo provides a full Mac app (DMG) and CLI (brew/pip), featuring hardware checking, model recommendation, auto-download, engine setup, and fan control. It includes optimized builds for models like Qwen 3.8 27B, along with comprehensive docs.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+ with the MLX framework, leveraging Apple Silicon's Metal performance. The app uses native Mac technologies, and the CLI is installable via Homebrew or pip.
en.hot: Gained 714 stars this month (total 1824), ranking #18 on GitHub Trending (Python) monthly. Its claimed ~2x speedup and no-external-drafter design have attracted significant attention from Apple Silicon users.
uses: Developers running LLMs locally on Macs who want faster inference without compromising output quality.
AI coding assistants needing offline/private operation, especially with models like Qwen 3.8 27B.
Researchers interested in speculative decoding techniques for reference or further development.

zh.tag: 一个菜单栏图标，替代十几个付费 Mac 应用
zh.what: Vorssaint 是一个免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具包，将音量控制、系统监控、窗口管理等多种实用功能整合到一个菜单栏图标中。它旨在替代多个付费应用，提供简洁统一的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Swift 项目源码，包括菜单栏面板（如混音器、系统监控、窗口控制）、文档、CI 配置和发布资源。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，面向 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon，采用 GPL-3.0 许可证，并依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1.1 万星，总星数达 1.5 万，因其免费开源、功能强大且替代多个付费应用而广受欢迎，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 希望减少付费 Mac 应用数量、追求性价比的用户
需要快速访问音量、系统监控和窗口管理的效率工作者
对开源和隐私保护有要求的 macOS 用户

en.tag: One menu bar icon replacing a dozen paid Mac apps
en.what: Vorssaint is a free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume control, system monitoring, window management, and other utilities into a single menu bar icon. It aims to replace multiple paid apps with a clean, unified experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full Swift project source, including menu bar panels (mixer, system monitor, window controls), documentation, CI config, and release assets.
en.stack: Built with Swift, targeting macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon, licensed under GPL-3.0, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: Gained 11k stars this month, reaching 15k total, popular for being free, open-source, and replacing multiple paid apps, trending on GitHub.
uses: Users wanting to reduce paid Mac apps and seek cost-effectiveness
Productivity workers needing quick access to volume, system monitoring, and window controls
macOS users who value open-source and privacy

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。

zh.tag: 在 Cloudflare 上给 AI 代理一个虚拟文件系统与执行环境
zh.what: Cloudflare Computer 是一个位于 Durable Object 内的虚拟文件系统，通过 SQLite 保存权威状态，并暴露统一的执行接口。它提供多种后端（容器、隔离 shell、隔离 JavaScript），让代理可以像操作真实文件系统一样运行命令或代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心包 @cloudflare/computer、可运行示例（容器、worker-shell、worker-javascript、egress）以及说明设计意图的 docs/ 目录。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Cloudflare Durable Objects、SQLite、Workers RPC、capnweb 协议，并集成 just-bash 和容器技术（FUSE 挂载）。
zh.hot: 本月新增近 9000 star，因为它是 Cloudflare 官方推出的‘给代理一台电脑’方案，将文件系统与执行环境无缝融入边缘平台，引发开发者对 AI 代理基础设施的想象。
uses: 开发者希望在 Cloudflare 上构建可执行代码的 AI 代理，快速原型验证。
需要为代理提供持久化、类文件系统存储，并支持多种执行后端的场景。
对边缘计算与 AI 结合感兴趣，想探索未来代理运行环境的技术爱好者。

en.tag: Give your agent a virtual filesystem & execution surface on Cloudflare
en.what: Cloudflare Computer is a virtual filesystem inside a Durable Object, with authoritative state in SQLite and a pluggable execution surface via workspace.runtime. It ships multiple backends (container, isolate shell, isolate JavaScript) so agents can run commands or code against a filesystem-like workspace.
en.content: The repo contains the core package @cloudflare/computer, runnable examples (container, worker-shell, worker-javascript, egress), and a docs/ directory describing forward-looking design intent.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging Cloudflare Durable Objects, SQLite, Workers RPC, capnweb protocol, and integrating just-bash and container tech (FUSE mounts).
en.hot: Gained ~9k stars this month as Cloudflare's official 'give your agent a computer' approach, seamlessly blending filesystem and execution into the edge platform, sparking excitement about AI agent infrastructure.
uses: Developers building AI agents on Cloudflare that need to execute code and prototype quickly.
Scenarios requiring persistent, filesystem-like storage for agents with multiple execution backends.
Tech enthusiasts exploring edge computing + AI and future agent runtime environments.

zh.what: Distilly 是一个本地优先的工具，用于将一个人的原始材料、工作习惯、判断力和表达风格转化为带版本管理的“Agent 人物档案”。这些档案可以在运行期间临时调用，也可以作为长期的主机技能安装，存储权始终保留在本地，无需额外的模型 API 密钥。

zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，要求 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，构建后通过 CLI 与 MCP 协议集成到 Codex 等宿主。
zh.hot: 24k+ stars，本月新增 3741，因其将个人知识蒸馏为 Agent 技能的理念新颖，且本地优先、无需额外 API key，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 希望将个人工作方法沉淀为 AI 助手可复用技能的开发者或知识工作者
需要为团队或客户创建定制化 Agent 行为档案的 AI 应用构建者
对本地优先、数据自主可控的 AI 工具链感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: Distill how people think into reusable Skills for any Agent or Bot
en.what: Distilly is a local-first tool that turns a person's source material, working habits, judgment, and voice into a versioned 'Person Profile for Agents'. The profile can be recalled temporarily during a run or installed as a long-lived host Skill, with storage authority staying local and no extra model API key required.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool, plugin system, and compatibility layers for multiple hosts (Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes). The default branch is distilly-plugin, offering a Developer Preview with five MCP tools and multi-language docs.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js 22.19+ or 24, uses pnpm for dependencies, and integrates with hosts like Codex via CLI and MCP protocol.
en.hot: With 24k+ stars and 3,741 added this month, it's hot for its novel concept of distilling personal knowledge into Agent skills, plus local-first design and no extra API key needed.
uses: Developers or knowledge workers who want to turn personal working methods into reusable AI assistant skills
AI application builders who need to create customized agent behavior profiles for teams or clients
Tech enthusiasts interested in local-first, data-sovereign AI toolchains

zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.

Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: 隐私优先的开源简历生成器
zh.what: Reactive Resume 是一款免费开源的简历生成器，简化了创建、更新和分享简历的流程。它提供多种模板，用户填写信息后即可导出为 PDF，无需注册账户即可使用基本功能。该应用以隐私为核心，用户完全拥有自己的数据，且支持自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（apps/web）、后端服务（apps/server）以及相关文档，采用 monorepo 结构。支持 Docker 部署，提供多语言界面，并集成了赞助商展示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端基于 React（Next.js），后端使用 NestJS，数据库支持 PostgreSQL 和 MongoDB，使用 Docker 进行容器化部署。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有超过 4 万星标，今日新增 255 星，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（TypeScript）第 5 名。其隐私保护、开源免费和自托管特性吸引了大量用户，且持续更新维护。
uses: 求职者：快速制作专业简历并导出 PDF，无需注册。
注重隐私的用户：希望完全掌控个人数据，可自托管部署。
开发者：可定制和扩展简历生成器，或贡献代码。

en.tag: Privacy-first open-source resume builder
en.what: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies creating, updating, and sharing resumes. It offers templates, lets you fill in details and export to PDF, no account required for basic use. Built with privacy as a core principle, it gives users complete ownership of their data and can be self-hosted.
en.content: The repository contains a frontend app (apps/web), backend server (apps/server), and documentation, structured as a monorepo. It supports Docker deployment, offers multi-language UI, and includes sponsor showcases.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, frontend built with React (Next.js), backend with NestJS, databases support PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and Docker for containerized deployment.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 255 new stars today, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its privacy-first, open-source, free, and self-hostable features attract many users, and it is actively maintained.
uses: Job seekers: quickly create professional resumes and export to PDF without registration.
Privacy-conscious users: want full control over personal data and can self-host.
Developers: can customize and extend the resume builder or contribute code.

zh.tag: 开源低代码平台，构建内部工具与AI代理
zh.what: ToolJet 是一个开源的低代码平台，用于快速构建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用和工作流。它提供可视化拖拽界面，支持连接数据库、API 和 SaaS 应用，并集成了 AI 能力，可生成应用和智能代理。

需要快速搭建业务应用的非技术用户
希望利用 AI 生成应用和自动化工作流的开发者
寻求自托管低代码解决方案的企业

en.tag: Open-source low-code platform for building internal tools and AI agents
en.what: ToolJet is an open-source low-code platform for rapidly building internal tools, dashboards, business applications, and workflows. It offers a visual drag-and-drop interface, connects to databases, APIs, and SaaS apps, and integrates AI capabilities for app generation and intelligent agents.

en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built with React and Node.js. Supports deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, and integrates with various databases and APIs.
en.hot: Popular among developers for its powerful low-code capabilities and AI integration. Gained 241 stars today, reaching 38.5k total, ranking 5th on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: Teams building internal tools and admin panels
Non-technical users needing to quickly create business apps
Developers looking to leverage AI for app generation and workflow automation
Enterprises seeking self-hosted low-code solutions

zh.what: PLANKA 是一款看板风格的项目管理工具，提供直观的拖拽界面来管理项目、看板、列表和卡片。它支持实时同步、Markdown 编辑和灵活的通知，适合团队协作。

zh.hot: 拥有 12k+ 星标，本周新增 102，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜。其自托管、实时协作和丰富功能吸引了大量用户。

个人任务管理，自托管部署保护数据隐私
需要实时协作和 Markdown 支持的项目团队
希望替代商业看板工具的开源用户

en.tag: Open-source Kanban project management with real-time collaboration
en.what: PLANKA is a Kanban-style project management tool with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for managing projects, boards, lists, and cards. It features real-time sync, Markdown editing, and flexible notifications for team collaboration.

en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Node.js and React, uses PostgreSQL for database, supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 102 added this week, it's on GitHub Trending weekly. Its self-hosted, real-time collaboration and rich features attract many users.

Personal task management with self-hosted deployment for data privacy
Teams needing real-time collaboration and Markdown support
Open-source users looking to replace commercial Kanban tools

zh.what: 这是一份从英语学习出发，写给普通人持续成长、重新掌握人生主动权的开放指南。它涵盖了英语学习系统、AI学习方法以及人生复盘样本，帮助用户建立长期训练系统。

zh.tag: 开源模块化智能魔镜平台，把镜子变成个人助理
zh.what: MagicMirror² 是一个开源的模块化智能镜子平台，允许用户将普通镜子（如玄关镜或浴室镜）改造成个人助理。它基于 Electron 封装，无需额外安装 Web 服务器或浏览器即可运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心平台代码、模块系统、安装文档和贡献指南。核心采用模块化插件架构，支持大量可安装的第三方模块来扩展功能。

智能家居玩家：将魔镜集成到家庭自动化系统中，作为信息中心或控制面板。
开发者：学习模块化架构和 Electron 应用开发，或贡献自己的模块。

en.tag: Open-source modular smart mirror platform turning mirrors into personal assistants
en.what: MagicMirror² is an open-source modular smart mirror platform that lets you turn a regular mirror (e.g., in a hallway or bathroom) into a personal assistant. It is built on Electron as an application wrapper, so no separate web server or browser installation is needed.
en.content: The repository contains the core platform code, a modular plugin system, installation documentation, and contribution guidelines. The core uses a modular plugin architecture, supporting a growing list of installable third-party modules to extend functionality.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Electron, leveraging the Node.js ecosystem. Dependencies include npm for package management and GitHub Actions for automated testing.
en.hot: Gained 129 stars this month, reaching 23.8k total, ranking 19th on the JavaScript monthly trending. It's a popular choice for smart home and DIY projects, with an active community and many contributors.
uses: DIY enthusiasts: personal projects to build a smart mirror displaying weather, calendar, news, etc.
Smart home hobbyists: integrating the mirror into home automation as an info hub or control panel.
Developers: learning modular architecture and Electron app development, or contributing custom modules.
