en.what: is-a.dev is a service that offers developers free .is-a.dev subdomains for their personal websites. Users register by submitting a PR, and once merged, DNS records are published within minutes, managed by Cloudflare.

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: drawDB 是一个在浏览器中运行的免费数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器，用户无需注册即可快速绘制数据库图表、导入导出 SQL 脚本、生成迁移脚本并自定义编辑器。它旨在简化数据库设计流程，让开发者可以直观地可视化和操作数据库结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 drawDB 前端应用源码，包括 React 组件、状态管理、样式和构建配置。还提供了本地开发、生产构建和 Docker 部署的脚本，以及可选的分享功能（需要配套的 drawdb-server）。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 React 构建，使用 npm 进行依赖管理和构建，支持 Docker 容器化部署。主要依赖包括 React 生态、状态管理库（如 Redux 或 MobX）以及代码编辑器组件（如 Monaco）。
zh.hot: drawDB 因其免费、无需注册、直接在浏览器中使用的便捷性而广受欢迎，star 数已达 38k+，今日新增 48 个，在 GitHub 趋势榜 JavaScript 类别中排名第 10。它解决了数据库设计中的常见痛点，提供了简洁直观的界面和强大的 SQL 生成功能。
uses: 数据库开发者：快速可视化数据库结构，生成 SQL 脚本和迁移文件。
软件架构师：在项目初期设计 ER 图，便于团队协作和沟通。
教育场景：用于教学演示数据库设计概念，无需安装复杂软件。
全栈开发者：在开发过程中快速原型化数据库模型，并导出为 SQL 语句。

en.tag: Free, simple, intuitive online database ER diagram editor and SQL generator
en.what: drawDB is a free, browser-based database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that lets users quickly build diagrams, import/export SQL scripts, generate migrations, and customize the editor without creating an account. It simplifies database design by providing an intuitive visual interface for structuring and manipulating database schemas.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the drawDB frontend application, including React components, state management, styles, and build configuration. It provides scripts for local development, production build, and Docker deployment, along with optional sharing features that require a companion drawdb-server.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript and React, using npm for dependency management and build, with Docker support for containerized deployment. Key dependencies include React ecosystem, state management libraries (e.g., Redux or MobX), and code editor components (e.g., Monaco).
en.hot: drawDB has gained popularity for being free, requiring no sign-up, and working directly in the browser, amassing 38k+ stars with 48 new stars today, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending for JavaScript. It addresses common pain points in database design with a clean, intuitive interface and powerful SQL generation capabilities.
uses: Database developers: quickly visualize database schemas and generate SQL scripts and migrations.
Software architects: design ER diagrams in early project phases for team collaboration and communication.
Educational settings: demonstrate database design concepts without installing complex software.
Full-stack developers: prototype database models quickly during development and export to SQL statements.

zh.tag: 高效开源广告拦截器，专注隐私与性能
zh.what: uBlock Origin 是一款轻量级、高效的浏览器扩展，用于拦截广告、跟踪器和恶意域名。它通过 CPU 和内存占用极低的方式，为用户提供更干净、更快的网页浏览体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含扩展的完整源代码，包括核心拦截引擎、过滤列表管理、用户界面（如弹出面板和设置页）、以及针对不同浏览器的构建配置。

uses: 注重隐私的普通用户，希望拦截广告和跟踪器以加快浏览速度并保护隐私。
技术爱好者，希望自定义过滤规则或研究广告拦截技术。
开发者和维护者，需要参考或贡献于开源广告拦截解决方案。

en.tag: Efficient open-source ad blocker focused on privacy and performance
en.what: uBlock Origin is a lightweight and efficient browser extension that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains. It provides a cleaner and faster browsing experience with minimal CPU and memory usage.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the extension, including the core blocking engine, filter list management, user interface (popup panel and settings pages), and build configurations for various browsers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with HTML/CSS for the UI, and leverages browser extension APIs like webRequest and declarativeNetRequest for network request blocking.
en.hot: As major browsers phase out Manifest V2, uBlock Origin remains a crucial tool for users to fight ads and tracking. Its efficiency and reliability keep it popular on GitHub, gaining 890 stars this month.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to block ads and trackers for faster browsing and privacy protection.
Tech enthusiasts who want to customize filter rules or study ad-blocking techniques.
Developers and maintainers looking to reference or contribute to an open-source ad-blocking solution.

zh.hot: 本月新增 623 星，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）第 19 名。其模块化技能设计降低了构建 AI 办公助手的门槛，且提供免费试用的 Raccoon 平台，吸引开发者快速体验。

en.tag: Modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows
en.what: This repository provides a set of modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows. Each skill lives in its own directory and declares triggers, capabilities, and execution flow via a SKILL.md file, following the Agent Skills convention. Skills cover image generation & visualization, slide-deck (PPT) generation, Excel data analysis, and deep research, usable standalone or composed into end-to-end workflows.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill directories, each with a SKILL.md defining metadata, plus documentation examples (like the sn-infographic Gallery showcasing nearly 100 generation cases) and integration guides. Skills are available out-of-the-box in the Raccoon platform.

en.hot: Gained 623 stars this month, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). Its modular skill design lowers the barrier to building AI office assistants, and the free-trial Raccoon platform attracts developers to try it quickly.

Teams building custom AI assistants or workflows, who can reuse ready-made skill modules
AI application developers interested in SenseNova models, who can reference the skill implementations

zh.tag: 跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，支持多协议
zh.what: electerm 是一款免费开源的终端模拟器，支持 SSH、SFTP、FTP、Telnet、串口、RDP、VNC 和 Spice 等多种远程连接协议。它可在 Linux、Mac、Windows、Android、HarmonyOS 和 iOS 上运行，并提供网页版和在线演示。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面客户端源码（基于 Electron）、移动端（Android/HarmonyOS/iOS）实现、网页版（electerm-web）以及 Docker 部署方案。还提供主题定制、AI 集成（electerm AI）和云同步等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/Electron 构建桌面应用，支持跨平台。移动端可能使用 React Native 或类似框架，网页版基于 Web 技术。依赖 Node.js 和 npm 生态。
zh.hot: 本月新增 379 星，总星数近 1.5 万，因其跨平台支持和多协议集成而受欢迎，尤其对老旧系统和国产 Linux 发行版的兼容性使其在特定用户群中备受青睐。
uses: 系统管理员和运维人员需要远程管理多台服务器，使用 SSH/SFTP 等协议。
开发者在不同操作系统间切换，需要一个统一的终端工具。
对国产操作系统（如统信 UOS、麒麟）有需求的用户，寻找兼容的终端客户端。

en.tag: Cross-platform terminal & remote connection client with multi-protocol support
en.what: electerm is a free and open-source terminal emulator supporting multiple remote connection protocols including SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice. It runs on Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS, and iOS, with web and online demo versions available.
en.content: The repository contains desktop client source code (Electron-based), mobile implementations (Android/HarmonyOS/iOS), a web version (electerm-web), and Docker deployment options. It also offers theme customization, AI integration (electerm AI), and cloud sync features.
en.stack: Primarily built with JavaScript/Electron for desktop, enabling cross-platform support. Mobile versions likely use React Native or similar frameworks, and the web version is based on web technologies. It relies on Node.js and npm ecosystem.
en.hot: With 379 new stars this month and nearly 15k total, its popularity stems from cross-platform support and multi-protocol integration, especially its compatibility with older systems and Chinese Linux distributions, making it a favorite among specific user groups.
uses: System administrators and DevOps professionals who need to remotely manage multiple servers via SSH/SFTP and other protocols.
Developers who switch between different operating systems and require a unified terminal tool.
Users who need a terminal client compatible with domestic Chinese OS like UOS and Kylin.

zh.tag: React 组件库，实现 Google Material Design
zh.what: Material UI 是一个全面的 React 组件库，实现了 Google 的 Material Design 系统。它被全球顶级产品团队广泛使用，经过十年以上的开发和数千名开源贡献者的严格测试。

zh.stack: 基于 React 和 TypeScript，使用 Emotion 进行样式处理，支持自定义主题。

企业级应用开发，需要成熟稳定的组件库
需要高度定制主题的团队

en.tag: React component library implementing Google's Material Design
en.what: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design system. It is trusted by top product teams worldwide and has been rigorously tested over a decade by thousands of open-source contributors.
en.content: The repository contains the core components, styling solutions, theme customization tools, along with documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built on React and TypeScript, uses Emotion for styling, supports custom theming.

Enterprise application development requiring a mature, stable component library
Teams needing highly customizable theming

zh.tag: 拒绝白板面试的友好公司清单
zh.what: 这是一个收集不使用白板面试的公司的开源清单，旨在推广更贴近实际工作的招聘方式。它列出了那些采用真实问题讨论、结对编程或家庭作业等面试形式的公司，并鼓励社区贡献和反馈。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个按字母顺序排列的公司列表，每个条目附有地点和面试流程描述。此外还有推荐指南、讨论链接和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，但内容以 Markdown 格式存储，依赖 GitHub 的协作功能。

uses: 求职者：寻找不采用白板面试的公司，了解其招聘流程。
招聘者：参考清单中的公司实践，改进自己的面试方式。
技术社区成员：贡献或移除公司条目，维护清单的准确性。

en.tag: A list of companies that don't do whiteboard interviews
en.what: This is an open-source list of companies that avoid whiteboard interviews, promoting hiring practices that resemble real work. It includes companies that use real-world problem discussions, pair programming, or take-home assignments, and encourages community contributions and feedback.
en.content: The repository contains an alphabetically ordered list of companies with location and interview process descriptions. It also includes recommendation guidelines, discussion links, and contribution instructions.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, but content is stored in Markdown format, leveraging GitHub's collaboration features.
en.hot: With over 51k stars, it remains popular among developers as it reflects dissatisfaction with traditional tech interviews and a desire for fairer hiring practices.
uses: Job seekers: Find companies that avoid whiteboard interviews and learn about their hiring processes.
Recruiters: Reference the listed companies' practices to improve their own interview methods.
Tech community members: Contribute or remove company entries to keep the list accurate.

zh.tag: 自托管监控工具，界面美观，功能强大
zh.what: Uptime Kuma 是一个易于使用的自托管监控工具，用于监控 HTTP(s)、TCP、Ping、DNS 等服务的在线状态。它提供美观、响应式的界面，并支持多种通知方式，如 Telegram、Discord 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的监控工具源代码，包括前端界面（Vue.js）、后端服务（Node.js）、Docker 部署配置，以及多语言翻译文件和通知组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，前端基于 Vue.js，后端使用 Node.js，支持 Docker 部署，并集成了多种通知服务。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 9 万 star，因其自托管、开源免费且功能丰富而广受欢迎，今日新增 51 星，持续活跃。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队自建监控服务，无需依赖第三方平台
需要监控多个网站或 API 并希望自定义通知方式的用户
对数据隐私敏感，希望数据完全掌握在自己手中的用户

en.tag: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool with a beautiful UI
en.what: Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use self-hosted monitoring tool for tracking the uptime of HTTP(s), TCP, Ping, DNS, and other services. It features a fancy, reactive UI and supports notifications via Telegram, Discord, and 90+ other services.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the monitoring tool, including the frontend UI (Vue.js), backend service (Node.js), Docker deployment configs, and translation files and notification components.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with a Vue.js frontend and Node.js backend, Docker deployment support, and integration with numerous notification services.
en.hot: With over 90k stars, it's popular for being self-hosted, open-source, and feature-rich, gaining 51 stars today and remaining highly active.

Users who need to monitor multiple websites or APIs and want customizable notifications
Users who are privacy-conscious and want full control over their data

zh.tag: 互联网最大免费资源合集，持续更新的百科式清单
zh.what: FMHY 是一个由社区维护的免费资源百科，收录了互联网上几乎所有的免费工具、网站、软件和内容，涵盖流媒体、下载、学习、安全等众多分类。它本身不托管任何文件，只提供链接和索引，并通过网站、Markdown 备份和 JSON API 分发。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个巨大的 Markdown 格式的链接清单（按分类组织），以及用于生成网站和 API 的脚本。目录结构清晰，每个分类有对应的 .md 文件，并配有表情符号图例方便导航。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 进行数据处理和网站生成，可能涉及 Node.js 和静态网站生成器。内容以 Markdown 存储，通过 GitHub Actions 自动化更新。
zh.hot: 作为长期维护的免费资源索引，它拥有超过 1.1 万 star，本月新增 618，说明持续受到社区欢迎，因为人们总是需要寻找免费替代品和实用工具。
uses: 寻找免费软件、流媒体网站、学习资料等资源的普通用户
希望节省开支、探索免费替代品的消费者
内容创作者或研究者需要收集免费素材和工具
对互联网资源整理感兴趣的贡献者

en.tag: The largest collection of free stuff on the internet, an ever-updating wiki-style list
en.what: FMHY is a community-maintained wiki of free resources, indexing nearly all free tools, websites, software, and content on the internet, covering categories like streaming, downloads, learning, security, and more. It hosts no files itself, only links and indexes, distributed via its website, Markdown backups, and JSON API.
en.content: The repo contains a massive Markdown list of links organized by category, plus scripts to generate the website and API. The directory structure is clear, with each category having its own .md file, and an emoji legend for easy navigation.
en.stack: Primarily uses JavaScript for data processing and site generation, likely with Node.js and a static site generator. Content is stored in Markdown and updated automatically via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As a long-maintained index of free resources, it has over 11.5k stars with 618 added this month, showing sustained community popularity because people constantly seek free alternatives and useful tools.
uses: General users looking for free software, streaming sites, learning materials, etc.
Consumers who want to save money and explore free alternatives.
Content creators or researchers needing free assets and tools.
Contributors interested in curating internet resources.

zh.tag: 编排多个编码代理CLI，按车道委派任务，自己审阅并提交
zh.what: delegate-skills 是一个用于编排多个编码代理CLI的工具，允许你发现已安装的代理CLI，将它们组织成车道（如feature、tests、ui），然后按车道或直接委派编码任务。你保留审阅和提交的最终控制权。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能（skills）目录，如delegate-setup用于发现和配置车队，以及针对不同CLI的委派技能（如codex-delegate、aider-delegate等）。每个技能都有详细的SKILL.md文档和配置schema。
zh.stack: 基于JavaScript/Node.js，通过npx安装，依赖skills.sh生态。支持多种编码代理CLI，如Aider、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor等。
zh.hot: 随着AI编码代理的普及，开发者需要统一编排多个代理。该项目提供了灵活的车道委派模式，让开发者保持控制权，因此迅速获得关注，今日新增32星，登上JavaScript日榜第三。
uses: 使用多个AI编码代理（如Codex、Aider）的开发者，希望统一管理并委派任务。
团队希望为不同任务类型（如功能、测试、UI）配置专用代理，并保持代码审阅流程。
喜欢手动控制提交的开发者，希望代理只负责实现，自己负责审阅和合并。

en.tag: Orchestrate multiple coding agent CLIs, delegate by lanes, review and commit yourself
en.what: delegate-skills is a tool for orchestrating multiple coding agent CLIs. It lets you discover installed agent CLIs, organize them into lanes (e.g., feature, tests, ui), and delegate coding tasks by lane or directly. You retain final control over review and commit.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill directories, such as delegate-setup for discovering and configuring fleets, and delegation skills for different CLIs (e.g., codex-delegate, aider-delegate). Each skill has detailed SKILL.md docs and a configuration schema.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, installed via npx, leverages the skills.sh ecosystem. Supports multiple coding agent CLIs like Aider, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need unified orchestration. This project offers a flexible lane-based delegation model while keeping control, gaining 32 stars today and ranking #3 on the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Codex, Aider) who want unified management and delegation.
Teams that want to configure dedicated agents for different task types (e.g., feature, tests, UI) while keeping review workflow.
Developers who prefer manual commit control, letting agents implement while they review and merge.

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 超快 Rust PDF 检测与文本提取库
zh.what: pdf-inspector 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能 PDF 处理库，能快速检测 PDF 是扫描版还是文本版，并提取带位置信息的文本，转换为干净的 Markdown。它内置智能分类功能，可在几十毫秒内判断 PDF 类型，并支持选择性 OCR，从而避免不必要的昂贵 OCR 服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、Python/Node.js 绑定、浏览器 WebAssembly 版本，以及 CLI 工具。提供文本提取、Markdown 转换、表格检测、多栏布局处理、CID 字体支持等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，依赖 PDFium 和 ONNX Runtime（用于 OCR），支持 Python、Node.js 和 WebAssembly。OCR 集成使用 PP-OCRv6 Small 模型。
zh.hot: 本月新增 15341 星，总星数达 17007，位居 GitHub 趋势榜第二。其极快的速度和智能分类能力解决了 PDF 处理中的痛点，且由 Firecrawl 团队开发，信誉度高。
uses: 开发者需要快速将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或提取文本，用于 RAG 或数据管道。
处理大量 PDF 的文档管理系统，需要区分扫描件和文本件以优化流程。
需要本地化、低延迟 PDF 解析的浏览器应用或边缘计算场景。

en.tag: Ultra-fast Rust library for PDF inspection and text extraction
en.what: pdf-inspector is a high-performance Rust library for PDF processing that quickly detects whether a PDF is scanned or text-based, extracts position-aware text, and converts it to clean Markdown. It features smart classification in tens of milliseconds and supports selective OCR to avoid unnecessary expensive OCR services.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library, Python/Node.js bindings, browser WebAssembly build, and a CLI tool. It offers text extraction, Markdown conversion, table detection, multi-column layout handling, CID font support, and more.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with PDFium and ONNX Runtime for OCR, and bindings for Python, Node.js, and WebAssembly. OCR uses PP-OCRv6 Small model.
en.hot: Gained 15,341 stars this month, reaching 17,007 total, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending. Its blazing speed and smart classification solve a common pain point, backed by the reputable Firecrawl team.
uses: Developers needing fast PDF-to-Markdown conversion or text extraction for RAG or data pipelines.
Document management systems processing large volumes of PDFs, needing to distinguish scanned vs text-based for workflow optimization.
Browser or edge applications requiring local, low-latency PDF parsing without server round trips.

zh.tag: 本地优先的极速微虚拟机运行时，秒级启动隔离环境
zh.what: Microsandbox 是一个用 Rust 编写的轻量级微虚拟机运行时，能在本地快速启动隔离环境，用于运行不可信代码，如 AI 代理、用户脚本、CI 任务等。它提供硬件级隔离，同时保持 Docker 类似的工作流，启动时间平均低于 100 毫秒。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、示例、Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器集成，以及用于构建和发布的配置。核心是一个可嵌入的库，允许在代码中直接生成虚拟机，无需守护进程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编程语言，依赖微虚拟机技术（如 Firecracker 或类似），支持 OCI 容器镜像，跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和不可信代码执行需求的增长，开发者需要快速、安全的隔离方案。Microsandbox 提供了低于 100 毫秒的启动时间和硬件级隔离，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，本月新增 959 星，总星数达 8021。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供安全的沙箱环境，执行用户代码或插件。
CI/CD 工程师：在隔离环境中运行测试或构建任务，防止恶意代码影响主机。
安全研究人员：分析不可信二进制或脚本，利用硬件隔离降低风险。
平台工程师：将微虚拟机嵌入应用，实现多租户隔离或动态代码执行。

en.tag: Fast, local-first microVM runtime for untrusted workloads
en.what: Microsandbox is a lightweight microVM runtime written in Rust that quickly launches isolated environments locally for untrusted workloads like AI agents, user code, CI jobs, and automation. It offers hardware-level isolation with Docker-like workflows and average boot times under 100 milliseconds.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, examples, integrations for Agent Skills and MCP server, and build/release configurations. The core is an embeddable library that spawns VMs directly in code without a daemon.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging microVM technology (like Firecracker), supports OCI container images, and is cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and untrusted code execution, developers need fast, secure isolation. Microsandbox offers sub-100ms boot times and hardware-level isolation, quickly gaining traction with 959 stars this month, reaching 8,021 total.
uses: AI agent developers: provide secure sandboxes for agents to execute user code or plugins.
CI/CD engineers: run tests or build tasks in isolated environments to prevent malicious code from affecting the host.
Security researchers: analyze untrusted binaries or scripts with hardware isolation to reduce risk.
Platform engineers: embed microVMs into applications for multi-tenant isolation or dynamic code execution.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心、Python 扩展、文档、示例、recipes 和容器镜像，并提供设计提案和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 实现高性能，Python 提供可扩展性；依赖推理引擎如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 285 星，总星数 7813，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）月榜第 20 名。作为 NVIDIA 支持的开源项目，它填补了推理引擎之上的编排层空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 基础设施团队：构建大规模多节点推理服务，优化 GPU 利用率和成本。
模型部署工程师：需要为 LLM、多模态或视频生成模型设计高吞吐、低延迟的服务架构。
平台开发者：希望扩展或定制推理编排逻辑，利用 Rust 和 Python 的混合开发。
研究与实验：在数据中心规模下测试分离式推理、KV 缓存等先进技术。

en.tag: Datacenter-scale distributed inference serving orchestration layer
en.what: Dynamo is an open-source, datacenter-scale inference serving framework that acts as an orchestration layer above inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, turning them into a coordinated multi-node inference system. It uses disaggregated serving, intelligent routing, multi-tier KV caching, and automatic scaling to maximize throughput and minimize latency for LLM, reasoning, multimodal, and video generation workloads.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility; relies on inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM.
en.hot: With 285 stars added this month and 7,813 total, it ranks #20 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an NVIDIA-backed open-source project, it fills the orchestration gap above inference engines, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI infrastructure teams: building large-scale multi-node inference services to optimize GPU utilization and cost.
Model deployment engineers: designing high-throughput, low-latency serving architectures for LLMs, multimodal, or video generation models.
Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台
zh.what: NautilusTrader 是一个基于 Rust 的高性能量化交易平台，采用确定性事件驱动架构，专为生产环境设计。它提供低延迟、高吞吐量的交易执行和回测能力，同时支持 Python 接口，便于策略开发和集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心交易引擎、回测模块、市场数据适配器、策略框架以及多种交易所连接器。代码主要用 Rust 编写，同时提供 Python 绑定，包含完整的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.12-3.14，兼容 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。依赖包括 PyO3 用于 Python 绑定，以及 Arrow 等用于数据处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 25.9k 星标和今日新增 120 星，NautilusTrader 因其生产级 Rust 性能、确定性架构和活跃社区而备受关注，成为量化交易领域的热门选择。
uses: 量化交易员和算法工程师：用于构建低延迟交易策略和执行系统。
金融科技公司：作为交易基础设施的核心组件，支持回测和实盘交易。
研究人员：利用其高性能回测引擎进行策略研究和数据分析。
开发者：通过 Python API 快速原型设计，或使用 Rust 进行深度定制。

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading platform
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture, designed for production use. It offers low-latency, high-throughput execution and backtesting capabilities, with a Python API for strategy development and integration.
en.content: The repository contains the core trading engine, backtesting module, market data adapters, strategy framework, and various exchange connectors. The code is primarily in Rust with Python bindings, including comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings for 3.12-3.14, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Dependencies include PyO3 for Python bindings and Arrow for data handling.
en.hot: With 25.9k stars and 120 new stars today, NautilusTrader gains attention for its production-grade Rust performance, deterministic architecture, and active community, making it a popular choice in algorithmic trading.
uses: Quant traders and algo engineers: for building low-latency trading strategies and execution systems.
Fintech companies: as a core component of trading infrastructure for backtesting and live trading.
Researchers: leveraging its high-performance backtesting engine for strategy research and data analysis.
Developers: rapid prototyping via Python API or deep customization with Rust.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，支持多语言
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供惰性/急切执行、查询优化和流式处理，支持超出内存的数据集。它提供 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 绑定，并可选 GPU 加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库、多语言绑定（Python、Node.js、R）、用户指南、文档和插件接口，以及用于扩展的 I/O 和表达式插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 实现，利用多线程和 SIMD 向量化执行，采用 Apache Arrow 列式格式进行零拷贝数据共享，支持 GPU 加速（NVIDIA）。
zh.hot: Polars 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性在数据科学社区广受欢迎，star 数接近 4 万，今日新增 13 个，持续活跃。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师：处理大型数据集，进行快速数据清洗和转换。
数据工程师：构建高效的数据管道，处理超出内存的数据。
Python/R/Node.js 开发者：在各自语言环境中利用高性能 DataFrame 操作。
需要 GPU 加速查询的用户：利用 NVIDIA GPU 加速数据处理。

en.tag: Ultra-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring lazy/eager execution, query optimization, and streaming for larger-than-RAM datasets. It offers bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL, with optional GPU acceleration.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust library, multi-language bindings (Python, Node.js, R), user guide, documentation, and plugin interfaces for I/O and expression extensions.
en.stack: Built on Rust with multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, uses Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Polars is highly popular in the data science community for its outstanding performance and ease of use, with nearly 40k stars and 13 new stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Data scientists and analysts: for fast data cleaning and transformation on large datasets.
Data engineers: building efficient data pipelines handling larger-than-RAM data.
Python/R/Node.js developers: leveraging high-performance DataFrame operations in their preferred language.
Users needing GPU acceleration: accelerating data processing with NVIDIA GPUs.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持多智能体协作
zh.what: OpenPencil 是全球首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持并发智能体团队。用户可以用自然语言描述界面，实时生成到无限画布上，并通过对话修改设计。它采用 Design-as-Code 理念，是 Pencil 的现代替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心引擎、桌面应用（op-host-desktop）、内置 MCP 服务器、多模型支持，以及多语言 README 和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架用于桌面应用，集成 MCP 服务器和多模型 AI 能力。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，概念新颖，结合 AI 代理团队和实时生成，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 32 星，总星数达 4772，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。
uses: 设计师和开发者：快速将想法转化为 UI 原型，提升设计效率。
产品经理：用自然语言描述需求，即时生成界面方案。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体协作在创意工具中的应用。
开源社区：参与开发，扩展 MCP 服务器和模型集成。

en.tag: Open-source AI-native vector design tool with concurrent agent teams
en.what: OpenPencil is the world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent agent teams. Users can describe UI in natural language and watch it appear on an infinite canvas in real-time, then modify designs through chat. It embraces Design-as-Code and serves as a modern alternative to Pencil.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust-based core engine, desktop app (op-host-desktop), built-in MCP server, multi-model intelligence, along with multilingual READMEs and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar for the desktop app, integrating MCP server and multi-model AI capabilities.
en.hot: As the first open-source AI-native vector design tool, its novel concept combining AI agent teams and real-time generation attracts attention. With 32 stars today and 4772 total, it ranks #3 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Designers and developers: quickly turn ideas into UI prototypes, boosting design efficiency.
Product managers: describe requirements in natural language and get instant interface proposals.
AI enthusiasts: explore multi-agent collaboration in creative tools.
Open-source community: contribute to development, extend MCP server and model integrations.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 零配置的终端 IDE，融合 VS Code 与 Sublime 的体验
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能全面的终端文本编辑器，主打零配置，提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，无需学习曲线。它专为处理超大文件而优化，性能卓越。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器核心代码、安装脚本、文档和演示 GIF，涵盖命令面板、多光标编辑、主题定制、LSP 支持、Orchestrator 多任务等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 协议实现，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 607 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 榜第 14 名。其零配置、易用性和高性能吸引了大量开发者，尤其是对终端编辑器感兴趣的用户。
uses: 适合喜欢在终端中工作但不想学习复杂快捷键的开发者，如 Vim/Emacs 新手。
需要处理超大文件（如日志文件）的开发者，Fresh 能高效加载。
希望获得 IDE 级功能（如 LSP、多光标）但偏好轻量级工具的用户。
对 Rust 和终端 UI 开发感兴趣的贡献者。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE blending VS Code & Sublime UX
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor with zero configuration, offering familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features without a learning curve. It is optimized for handling huge files with high performance.
en.content: The repository includes the editor's core code, installation scripts, documentation, and demo GIFs, featuring command palette, multi-cursor editing, themes, LSP support, and the Orchestrator for multitasking.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP protocol, cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 607 stars this month, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending Rust. Its zero-config, ease of use, and high performance attract developers, especially terminal editor enthusiasts.
uses: Developers who prefer terminal work but dislike steep learning curves, e.g., Vim/Emacs beginners.
Those handling huge files (e.g., logs) that need efficient loading.
Users wanting IDE-level features (LSP, multi-cursor) in a lightweight tool.
Contributors interested in Rust and terminal UI development.

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的编程语言，让代理少犯错
zh.what: BAML 是一种专为 AI 代理设计的编程语言，外观类似 TypeScript，但内置了类型系统、错误处理和测试框架，旨在让代理更可靠。它支持从 Python、TypeScript 等语言调用，可独立运行或增量采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 BAML 编译器、CLI 工具、IDE 扩展、示例代码和文档。核心是用 Rust 编写的编译器，支持类型检查、代码生成和内置测试框架。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Python、TypeScript、Go、C#、Java 等语言的绑定。依赖包括 PyPI 包和 Homebrew 安装方式。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理开发火热，BAML 提供了专门的语言层，减少代理出错，吸引了大量关注。本月新增 366 星，总星数达 9139，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 18 名。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要构建可靠、可测试的代理逻辑，避免输出垃圾数据。
团队希望用强类型语言定义代理工作流，并集成到现有 Python/TS 项目中。
对编程语言设计感兴趣，想了解如何为特定领域（AI）设计语言。

en.tag: A programming language for AI agents, designed to reduce mistakes
en.what: BAML is a programming language designed for AI agents, with a TypeScript-like syntax but a Rust-like type system, built-in error handling, and testing framework to make agents more reliable. It can be called from Python, TypeScript, and other languages, and can be used standalone or adopted incrementally.
en.content: The repository contains the BAML compiler, CLI tools, IDE extensions, examples, and documentation. The core is a Rust-written compiler with type checking, code generation, and built-in testing framework.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with bindings for Python, TypeScript, Go, C#, Java, etc. Distributed via PyPI and Homebrew.
en.hot: As AI agent development surges, BAML offers a dedicated language layer to reduce agent mistakes, gaining significant attention. With 366 new stars this month and 9,139 total, it ranks #18 on the Rust trending list.
uses: AI agent developers who need reliable, testable agent logic and avoid garbage outputs.
Teams wanting to define agent workflows in a strongly-typed language and integrate into existing Python/TS projects.
Language design enthusiasts interested in domain-specific languages for AI.

zh.tag: 开源多协议下载管理器，Rust 引擎，免费无广告
zh.what: FluxDown 是一款由 Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接以及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，提供智能多线程加速和浏览器无缝集成。它拥有精美界面和极致性能，永久免费且零广告。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的原生引擎（native/engine）、Flutter 编写的跨平台 UI（lib）、以及 MCP 服务器等组件，提供 Windows/macOS/Linux/NAS/Android 多平台安装包。
zh.stack: 核心引擎使用 Rust 和 Tokio 异步运行时，UI 采用 Flutter，支持多平台桌面与移动端，并集成 MCP 服务器。
zh.hot: 本月新增约 1475 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 月榜第 15 名，作为免费开源的 IDM 替代品，凭借 10 倍提速和多协议支持迅速吸引用户。
uses: 需要高速下载 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 资源的普通用户，替代付费的 IDM
希望集成浏览器下载管理、提升流媒体下载体验的开发者或重度用户
在 NAS 或服务器上部署自托管下载服务的用户，支持 Docker 等部署方式

en.tag: Open-source multi-protocol download manager with Rust engine, free & ad-free
en.what: FluxDown is a Rust-powered multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent magnet links and HLS/DASH streaming, with intelligent multi-threading acceleration and seamless browser integration. It offers a polished UI and top-tier performance, completely free with no ads.
en.content: The repository contains a native engine written in Rust (native/engine), a cross-platform UI built with Flutter (lib), and an MCP server, offering installers for Windows/macOS/Linux/NAS/Android.
en.stack: Core engine built with Rust and Tokio async runtime, UI in Flutter, supporting multi-platform desktop and mobile, with MCP server integration.
en.hot: Gained ~1,475 stars this month, ranking #15 on GitHub Trending (Rust monthly), as a free open-source IDM alternative with 10x speedup and multi-protocol support.
uses: General users needing high-speed downloads over HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent, as a free IDM replacement
Developers or power users wanting browser-integrated download management and improved streaming downloads
Users deploying self-hosted download services on NAS or servers, with Docker support

zh.tag: 默认 HTTPS 的极速可扩展 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个快速、可扩展、跨平台的 Web 服务器，支持 HTTP/1.1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3，并默认启用 TLS，自动为站点配置 HTTPS 证书。它旨在让 HTTPS 成为每个网站的默认配置，简化部署和运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置和构建脚本。核心是一个基于 Go 的模块化服务器，通过 Caddyfile 或 JSON 配置，支持丰富的插件和中间件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 CertMagic 库进行自动 HTTPS 证书管理，支持多种平台（Windows、macOS、Linux 等）。
zh.hot: Caddy 因其自动 HTTPS 和易用性而广受欢迎，本月新增近千 star，总 star 数超过 7.4 万，在 Go 语言趋势榜中名列前茅。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速部署静态网站或反向代理，无需手动配置证书
需要自动 HTTPS 和 HTTP/3 支持的生产环境 Web 服务器
作为微服务或容器化应用的反向代理和负载均衡器
学习和研究 Go 语言高性能服务器开发的参考项目

en.tag: Fast, extensible web server with automatic HTTPS by default
en.what: Caddy is a fast, extensible, multi-platform web server supporting HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, with TLS enabled by default and automatic HTTPS certificate management. It aims to make HTTPS the default for every site, simplifying deployment and operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, and build scripts for Caddy. The core is a modular Go-based server configured via Caddyfile or JSON, supporting a rich ecosystem of plugins and middleware.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the CertMagic library for automatic HTTPS certificate management, and supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Caddy is popular for its automatic HTTPS and ease of use, gaining nearly a thousand stars this month and over 74k total, ranking high on the Go trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly deploying static sites or reverse proxies without manual certificate setup
Production web servers requiring automatic HTTPS and HTTP/3 support
Reverse proxy and load balancer for microservices or containerized applications
Reference project for learning high-performance server development in Go

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，支持通过 Homebrew、Docker、Go 或二进制安装，并可集成到 pre-commit 钩子或 GitHub Action 中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖正则表达式库和熵计算，支持多种平台和容器化部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 215 星，总星数达 28786，位列 GitHub 周榜（Go）第一。其功能完善且维护者宣布转向新项目，引发关注。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描代码泄露
安全团队审计历史提交中的敏感信息
个人开发者本地检查仓库泄露风险

en.tag: Scan git repos for secrets, passwords, API keys, and tokens
en.what: Gitleaks is a tool for detecting secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repos, files, and stdin. It uses regex and entropy analysis to identify potential leaks and outputs detailed reports including file, line, commit, and more.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool, installable via Homebrew, Docker, Go, or binaries, and can be integrated into pre-commit hooks or GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging regex and entropy calculation, with support for multiple platforms and containerized deployment.
en.hot: Gained 215 stars this week, total 28,786, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its feature-complete status and maintainer's shift to a new project drew attention.
uses: Developers scanning for leaks in CI/CD pipelines
Security teams auditing historical commits for sensitive data
Individual developers checking repos locally for exposure

zh.tag: 本地运行 GitHub Actions 的命令行工具
zh.what: act 是一个用 Go 编写的命令行工具，让你在本地运行 GitHub Actions。它读取 .github/workflows 中的工作流，利用 Docker 容器模拟 GitHub 的运行环境，提供快速反馈，并可作为本地任务运行器替代 Makefile。
zh.content: 仓库包含 act 的源代码、文档、示例以及用于构建和测试的配置文件。主要目录有 cmd、pkg 和 integration 等，同时提供用户指南和快速入门示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Docker API 来拉取和运行容器，支持 GitHub Actions 的多种事件和功能。
zh.hot: 拥有 71.7k stars，本月新增 536，位列 Go 趋势榜第五。它解决了开发者在本地测试 CI 工作流的痛点，节省时间并提升效率。
uses: 开发者在提交前快速验证 .github/workflows 中的改动，避免反复 push 等待 CI 结果。
将 GitHub Actions 用作本地任务运行器，替代 Makefile 等传统工具，统一自动化流程。
CI 配置维护者或团队希望在不触发远程资源的情况下调试和优化工作流。

en.tag: Run GitHub Actions workflows locally with Docker
en.what: act is a Go-based CLI tool that runs GitHub Actions locally. It reads workflows from .github/workflows, uses Docker containers to simulate the GitHub environment, providing fast feedback and serving as a local task runner alternative to Makefile.
en.content: The repository contains act's source code, documentation, examples, and build/test configs. Key directories include cmd, pkg, and integration, along with a user guide and quickstart demos.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on Docker API to pull and run containers, supporting various GitHub Actions events and features.
en.hot: With 71.7k stars and +536 this month, ranking #5 in Go trending. It solves the pain point of testing CI workflows locally, saving time and boosting productivity.
uses: Developers quickly validate changes to .github/workflows before commit, avoiding repeated pushes and CI wait times.
Use GitHub Actions as a local task runner, replacing Makefile and other tools to unify automation.
CI config maintainers or teams want to debug and optimize workflows without triggering remote resources.

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，hub 基于 PocketBase，agent 独立运行。支持 Docker/Podman，可通过 Docker 镜像部署，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队，需要轻量级服务器监控且不想部署重量级方案
使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史
需要设置告警（如 CPU、内存、磁盘）并及时收到通知的运维人员
希望通过 OAuth 集成现有身份认证系统的企业用户

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container
Ops personnel who need to set alerts (e.g., CPU, memory, disk) and receive timely notifications
Enterprise users who want to integrate existing authentication via OAuth

zh.tag: 云原生应用代理，自动发现服务并动态配置路由
zh.what: Traefik 是一个现代 HTTP 反向代理和负载均衡器，旨在简化微服务的部署。它能够与 Docker、Kubernetes 等基础设施组件集成，自动且动态地配置自身，无需手动维护路由规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Traefik 的源代码、文档、示例配置以及 Web UI 资源。主要目录包括 docs（文档）、pkg（核心代码）、cmd（入口命令）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种后端集成库（如 Docker、Kubernetes、Consul 等），并支持 ACME 自动 HTTPS 证书。
zh.hot: 拥有 64k+ star，是云原生领域最受欢迎的反向代理之一。其自动服务发现和动态配置特性极大简化了微服务路由管理，因此持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 微服务架构中作为入口网关，自动路由到 Docker/Kubernetes 等服务
需要动态更新路由规则的场景，如频繁扩缩容或服务变更
希望简化 HTTPS 证书管理的开发者，利用内置 ACME 自动签发证书
边缘代理或 API 网关，支持多种协议和中间件

en.tag: Cloud-native application proxy with automatic service discovery and dynamic routing
en.what: Traefik is a modern HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer that simplifies microservices deployment. It integrates with infrastructure components like Docker and Kubernetes, automatically and dynamically configuring itself without manual route management.
en.content: The repository contains Traefik's source code, documentation, example configurations, and Web UI assets. Key directories include docs, pkg (core code), and cmd (entry commands).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with integrations for various backends (Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, etc.) and support for automatic HTTPS via ACME.
en.hot: With 64k+ stars, it's one of the most popular reverse proxies in cloud-native. Its automatic service discovery and dynamic configuration greatly simplify microservice routing, keeping it in the spotlight.
uses: As an ingress gateway in microservices, automatically routing to services in Docker/Kubernetes
Scenarios needing dynamic route updates, such as frequent scaling or service changes
Developers wanting simplified HTTPS management with built-in ACME auto-certificates
Edge proxy or API gateway supporting multiple protocols and middleware

zh.tag: 自建私有搜索引擎，索引浏览记录与本地文件
zh.what: Hister 是一个注重隐私的搜索引擎，可以索引你访问过的网页和本地文件的内容，支持全文搜索。它提供 Web 界面、终端界面和 MCP 接口，方便你随时找回信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI（基于 Svelte）、浏览器扩展（Firefox/Chrome）以及终端客户端。支持多用户、语义搜索、爬虫和浏览器历史导入。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 CGO（需要 C 编译器），Web 前端使用 npm 和 Svelte。
zh.hot: 今日新增 142 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4。在隐私担忧加剧的背景下，自托管搜索引擎需求上升，Hister 提供完整功能且易于部署。
uses: 注重隐私的个人用户，希望本地搜索自己的浏览历史和文件。
团队或组织，需要内部文档和网页的私有搜索解决方案。
开发者，希望集成 MCP 到 AI 助手，实现个性化信息检索。

en.tag: Self-hosted private search engine for your browsing history and local files
en.what: Hister is a privacy-focused search engine that indexes the full content of pages you visit and files you keep, enabling full-text search. It offers web, terminal, and MCP interfaces for easy information retrieval.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend, a web UI (Svelte-based), browser extensions for Firefox/Chrome, and a terminal client. It supports multi-user, semantic search, crawler, and browser history import.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with CGO dependencies (requires C compiler), and npm/Svelte for the web frontend.
en.hot: Gained 142 stars today, ranking #4 on Go trending. Amid growing privacy concerns, self-hosted search engines are in demand, and Hister offers full features with easy deployment.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to search their browsing history and files locally.
Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器，让 AI 直接操作仓库与工作流
zh.what: GitHub MCP Server 是 GitHub 官方的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，允许 AI 代理、助手和聊天机器人通过自然语言直接与 GitHub 平台交互。它支持读取仓库和代码文件、管理 issue 和 PR、分析代码以及自动化工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 MCP 服务器实现，提供远程托管版本和本地运行版本，并附带详细的文档、配置示例和策略治理指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 MCP 协议，支持多种 MCP 宿主（如 VS Code、Claude Desktop、Cursor 等）。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方项目，它迅速获得 3.2 万+ Star，本月新增 854，跻身 Go 趋势榜前十，反映了 AI 编程助手与 GitHub 深度集成的强烈需求。
uses: 开发者希望让 AI 助手直接管理仓库、issue 和 PR，提升日常开发效率。
团队利用 AI 自动化 CI/CD 流程，监控构建失败并分析代码质量。
AI 工具开发者需要将 GitHub 功能集成到自定义代理或聊天机器人中。

en.tag: GitHub's official MCP server connecting AI to repositories and workflows
en.what: The GitHub MCP Server is GitHub's official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI agents, assistants, and chatbots to interact directly with the GitHub platform through natural language. It supports reading repositories and code files, managing issues and PRs, analyzing code, and automating workflows.
en.content: The repository contains a Go implementation of the MCP server, offering both a remote hosted version and a local version, along with comprehensive documentation, configuration examples, and policy governance guides.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, built on the MCP protocol, and compatible with various MCP hosts such as VS Code, Claude Desktop, and Cursor.
en.hot: As an official GitHub project, it quickly amassed over 32k stars, with 854 new stars this month, ranking in the top 10 Go trending repos, reflecting the strong demand for deep AI coding assistant integration with GitHub.
uses: Developers who want AI assistants to directly manage repositories, issues, and PRs to boost daily productivity.
Teams leveraging AI to automate CI/CD pipelines, monitor build failures, and analyze code quality.
AI tool builders integrating GitHub capabilities into custom agents or chatbots.

zh.tag: 进程溯源 CLI/TUI，回答“它为什么在运行”
zh.what: witr 是一个命令行工具，用于回答“为什么这个进程在运行？”它通过追踪进程、端口、容器或文件的启动链，揭示其背后的因果关系。它整合了系统各层信息，让用户无需手动关联多个工具的输出。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的 CLI 和 TUI 二进制，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 FreeBSD。提供交互式 TUI 模式、机器可读的 JSON 输出，以及浏览器内的模拟环境供试用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖系统调用和进程信息库（如 psutil 或类似），支持多种包管理器分发。
zh.hot: 该工具解决了系统诊断中的常见痛点，提供直观的因果链展示，上线后迅速获得 2.2 万星标，本月新增 3500+，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 系统管理员排查异常进程或端口占用，快速定位源头。
开发者在容器或微服务环境中追踪服务启动链，辅助调试。
安全分析师调查可疑进程的启动来源，分析攻击路径。

en.tag: Trace any process/port/container/file back to its origin — CLI + TUI
en.what: witr is a command-line tool that answers 'Why is this running?' by tracing the startup chain of any process, port, container, or file. It reveals the causal chain behind running entities, integrating information from various system layers so users don't have to manually correlate outputs from multiple tools.
en.content: The repository contains Go-written CLI and TUI binaries supporting Linux, macOS, Windows, and FreeBSD. It offers an interactive TUI mode, machine-readable JSON output, and a browser-based sandbox for trial.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging system calls and process information libraries (like psutil or similar), distributed via multiple package managers.
en.hot: The tool addresses a common pain point in system diagnostics with intuitive causal chain visualization, quickly amassing 22k stars with 3.5k+ added this month, trending on GitHub.
uses: System administrators troubleshooting abnormal processes or port usage to quickly locate the origin.
Developers tracing service startup chains in container or microservice environments for debugging.
Security analysts investigating the origin of suspicious processes to analyze attack paths.

zh.tag: GitHub 官方命令行工具，将 PR、Issue 等带到终端
zh.what: gh 是 GitHub 官方推出的命令行工具，让你在终端中直接管理仓库、PR、Issue、Actions 等。它与 git 无缝协作，支持 GitHub.com、GitHub Enterprise Cloud 和 Server。
zh.content: 仓库包含 gh 的完整源码、安装脚本、文档以及用于编码代理的 Agent skill。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 多种安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 git 和 GitHub API。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方 CLI，拥有 45k+ Star，是开发者日常高频使用的工具。今日新增 16 Star，持续活跃。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中快速管理 GitHub 仓库、PR、Issue 等
DevOps 工程师 —— 集成到 CI/CD 脚本中自动化 GitHub 操作
编码代理 —— 通过 Agent skill 让 AI 代理直接调用 gh 命令

en.tag: GitHub's official CLI, bringing PRs, issues, and more to your terminal
en.what: gh is GitHub's official command-line tool that lets you manage repositories, pull requests, issues, Actions, and more directly from your terminal. It works seamlessly with git and supports GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Cloud, and Server.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and an Agent skill for coding agents. It supports multiple installation methods on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, depends on git and the GitHub API.
en.hot: As the official GitHub CLI, it has over 45k stars and is a daily essential for developers. It gained 16 stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Developers — manage GitHub repos, PRs, issues quickly from the terminal
DevOps engineers — automate GitHub operations in CI/CD scripts
Coding agents — use the Agent skill to let AI agents invoke gh commands

zh.tag: 开源 RAG 引擎，融合 Agent 能力，为 LLM 提供上下文层
zh.what: RAGFlow 是一个开源的检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，将先进的 RAG 技术与 Agent 能力相结合，为大型语言模型（LLM）提供高质量的上下文层。它支持深度文档理解、基于知识的问答和自动化工作流，帮助企业构建可靠的 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RAGFlow 源代码，包括后端服务（Go）、前端界面（React）、文档和部署配置。支持多种文档格式解析、知识库管理、Agent 编排和 API 接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发后端，前端采用 React，依赖 Docker 进行部署。集成了深度学习模型和向量数据库，支持多种 LLM 接口。
zh.hot: 凭借近 9 万 Star 和月增 3530 的热度，RAGFlow 成为 RAG 领域的明星项目。其融合 Agent 的创新设计和对企业级应用的专注，吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 企业知识库问答：利用 RAGFlow 构建基于内部文档的智能问答系统，提升信息检索效率。
AI 应用开发：开发者可基于 RAGFlow 快速搭建具备 RAG 和 Agent 能力的应用，减少重复工作。
文档智能处理：适用于需要深度解析 PDF、Word 等格式并提取结构化信息的场景。
研究实验：学术研究者可借助其开源特性进行 RAG 相关算法的验证与改进。

en.tag: Open-source RAG engine fusing RAG with Agent capabilities for LLM context
en.what: RAGFlow is an open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that combines advanced RAG techniques with Agent capabilities to provide a superior context layer for LLMs. It enables deep document understanding, knowledge-based Q&A, and automated workflows for building reliable AI applications.
en.content: The repository contains the full RAGFlow source code, including backend services (Go), frontend interface (React), documentation, and deployment configs. It supports multiple document formats, knowledge base management, agent orchestration, and API endpoints.
en.stack: Backend is primarily in Go, frontend uses React, and deployment is Docker-based. It integrates deep learning models and vector databases, supporting multiple LLM interfaces.
en.hot: With nearly 90k stars and 3,530 new stars this month, RAGFlow is a star project in the RAG domain. Its innovative Agent fusion and enterprise focus attract many developers.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base Q&A: Build intelligent Q&A systems on internal documents to boost information retrieval efficiency.
AI application development: Developers can quickly build apps with RAG and Agent capabilities, reducing repetitive work.
Intelligent document processing: Ideal for deep parsing of PDFs, Word, and other formats to extract structured information.
Research experiments: Academics can leverage its open-source nature to validate and improve RAG algorithms.

zh.tag: App Store Connect 的极速脚本化 CLI，自动化发布全流程
zh.what: 这是一个用 Go 编写的命令行工具，用于与 App Store Connect API 交互。它允许开发者从终端、IDE 或 CI/CD 管道自动化 iOS、macOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用的发布流程，包括 TestFlight、构建、提交、签名、分析、截图和订阅管理等。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个名为 `asc` 的二进制文件，支持 Homebrew 安装和脚本安装。它还包含 `asc install-skills` 命令，用于安装 23 个 agent skills，这些 skills 可以自动化构建、TestFlight、元数据同步等任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store Connect API。支持 Homebrew 和脚本安装，并集成 agent skills 功能。
zh.hot: 该工具在 GitHub 上获得 6324 颗星，本周新增 295 颗，位列 Go 语言周榜第 6。其受欢迎的原因在于它简化了 App Store 发布流程，提供了脚本化和可自动化的解决方案，深受独立开发者和 CI/CD 用户的喜爱。
uses: 独立开发者或小团队希望自动化 App Store 发布流程，减少手动操作。
需要将 TestFlight 分发、构建上传和元数据同步集成到 CI/CD 管道中的开发团队。
喜欢用命令行工具管理多个应用或频繁发布的应用开发者。

AI agent developers: leverage CLI stages to build automated video processing pipelines.
Localization teams: use terminology replacement and context-aware translation for accuracy.

General users looking up basic info on unknown numbers

Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures
